notes.title: Update 62 Released - Vehicle Logs, Quality of Life and UI Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]TWEAKS AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h1][h2]VEHICLE LOGS[/h2][p]This long-requested feature allows players to view a timeline of events for a vehicle—similar to the system already in place for structures. Each vehicle now has a unique, world-wide ID that is visible in its log, which records a wide range of actions such as locking/unlocking, wrenching, region travel, production or stockpile retrieval, and more. This is part of our ongoing efforts to deter malicious behaviour from players.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/5ccbe619c0a6c45a338e6fd052feef386fbf111e.png"][/img][/p][h2]300MM CHANGES[/h2][p]To help address pacing issues in recent wars, a new mechanic is being introduced to 300mm platforms: Barrel Heating. Firing the gun now costs Heat, and after enough shells are fired, the cannon must cool down before it can be used again. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/ab9874800efb9627857ae85ab59bc64b094a5267.png"][/img][/p][h2]CONSTRUCTION EQUIPMENT TWEAKS[/h2][p]We've also received a lot of feedback on the Construction Equipment and have made some tweaks and improvements to it, including a cost reduction and other QOL changes: It can now be placed on top of bunkers, build Emplaced Weapons and be flagged for Disruptive Placement.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/ec2d3e7002d4235b6b3c79c10c69f0f87dc4560d.png"][/img][/p][h2]OTHER CHANGES[/h2][p]This update contains dozens of other small improvements, some which are highlighted below. Besides what's shown here, there are also balance tweaks and over a hundred bug fixes.  [/p][list][*][p]New map UI element on regions undergoing Maintenance[/p][/*][*][p]Improved map readability of which regions are available[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Trench Connector visuals and fixed placement bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Builders now have more time to claim and demolish their Bunkers[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Engine Room construction cost[/p][/*][*][p]Emplacements can now be reserved with "Reserve Multiple" and restricts packaging[/p][/*][/list][h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1][p]There are many other changes and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url="https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-62-release-notes"]release notes[/url] for the details. [/p][p][/p][h1]COMMUNITY UPDATE VIDEOS[/h1][p]For a more comprehensive walkthrough of news and changes in Update 62, here are some community videos highlighting the update. [/p][previewyoutube="kctrJYnvmsg;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="G3ZUffiM0vA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ"]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url="https://twitter.com/foxholegame"]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.[/p]

notes.title: Update 61 Released - Builder Features, Bunker Breaching, Underground Fortress
notes.content:
[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1][p]Update 61 includes a broad range of new bunker and builder features as well as improvements across the entire game. Below is a highlight of the more prominent changes.  
[/p][h2]NEW BUILDING OPTIONS[/h2][p]Several new Bunker and Trench related content has been added. First, Tripod mounts can now be fitted inside bunkers, which increases these weapon's survivability and flexibility.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/02feb28535df8433654d207b2db39ef113f3d752.gif"][/img]New garrison types have been added, with Artillery and Anti-Tank defensive options now being available from Tier 1 to 3, as well as the Observation Bunker, giving builders more low tier options.    

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/7dab2d69021b5bd031338152427a16d7b0974a3c.png"][/img] [/p][p]New trench variants have also been added, which expand builders' choices when designing their Bunker-Trench systems. These include the new Trench Intersection piece, the new Trench Hard-Point and updated Trench Sandbags.  
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/4f1f99574fbc2dde75b120cd58d19d3d23a178bd.png"][/img][/p][p]On top of that, new Bunker Modifications are available, bringing further depth and gameplay options to Bunker building, such as the Artillery Shelter modification which increases bunker resistance to artillery bombardment and the Fire Prevention System, which automatically helps players put out fires.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/46dd2c67cc039f6ee70ce73ee4ca5cc4a91b4634.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/359dae1adb79e10f781e54113495e0d49d075652.png"][/img][/p][p]Together, we hope these changes and additions give builders the tools to push the limits of creativity and strategy like never before in Foxhole.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/d1519d67947a20c7fe4041d795b1160459ef27e2.png"][/img][/p][h2]BUNKER BREACHING[/h2][p]Bunkers pieces can now be individually breached, allowing infantry to storm inside and engage in close-quarters combat. Bunkers become breached when they drop below a health threshold called Breachable Health, determined in part by its Structural Integrity.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/61b74efa4b21284bf89f1717e167d65459b28987.gif"][/img][/p][h2]NEW LARGE STRUCTURE FOUNDATION[/h2][p]Large Structures are now built in Shippable parts at Facilities. which must be shipped and assembled by a Crane at a Large Structure Foundation. This allows Large Structures to be made stronger and more valuable, and they have received buffs as a result.   

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/4d1e1977b0854d64383b8c408f037df6507683ba.gif"][/img][/p][h2]NEW CONSTRUCTION EQUIPMENT[/h2][p]The Construction Equipment is a new shippable built at the Small Assembly Station that automatically submits construction materials into nearby Build Sites. It facilitates large construction projects for smaller groups.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/3e9533f655542de9990fd2a4ea56951b6ae8c0e9.gif"][/img][/p][h2]UNDERGROUND FORTRESS[/h2][p]The Underground Fortress is a new Large Structure that serves as a strongpoint and can only be destroyed by explosives placed inside. It features an additional underground floor, which provides infantry with a safe spawn point protected from artillery.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/417d1eefcaa4640559d8e9aef314541bcc7fc267.png"][/img][/p][h2]OTHER FEATURES[/h2][p]A bunch of other Quality of Life and balancing changes have been introduced as well, summarized below. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/69bc3e589bd1313a717c026bc243529d816ecc27.png"][/img][/p][h1]HIT REGISTRATION IMPROVEMENTS[/h1][p]Update 61 also focuses on improving the shooting experience, with the Server-side hit detection system being upgraded to include network lag reconciliation. This should reduce the amount of sudden ‘warping’ of players under extreme latency conditions.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/404b3bf9a64bca21303dddd7fde62328a3d921c4.png"][/img]    [/p][h1]NEW EQUIPMENT[/h1][h2]NAVAL UNIFORMS[/h2][p]New Uniforms have been added to both factions, intended to be used in the high-seas. These provide gameplay benefits to sailors fighting floods and leaks aboard Large Ships. 
 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/94a18849ba6d82a45bcbf426673c5a0dd1c9e8e2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/cc14585235d42580bf0ad8e96840700fe68cc9a4.png"][/img][/p][h2]COLONIAL HEAVY CANNON[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/5877ff717834a1ee10963f5d727e541b8a3da266.png"][/img][/p][h2]WARDEN BUNKER BUSTER SCOUT TANK[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/bf4f8cda82a7063422844b735512cdd87d12ac6b.png"][/img][/p][h2]WARDEN HE ROCKET ARMORED CARD [/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/03ddce60fd8138d86e4cbf07bdbea8c28c8e4397.png"][/img][/p][h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1][p]There are many other features and bug fixes in this update, including the Power System Unification and Pipe Fluid mechanics overhaul. Read the full [url="https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-61-release-notes"]release notes[/url] for the details. [/p][p][/p][h1]COMMUNITY UPDATE VIDEOS[/h1][p]For a more comprehensive walkthrough of all the new features in Update 61, here are some community videos highlighting the update. [/p][previewyoutube="ZjfTuQpxzgw;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="66lvxEeOi_M;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ"]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url="https://twitter.com/foxholegame"]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.[/p]

notes.title: Update 60 Released - New Wars Have Begun
notes.content:
[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]

Update 60 includes a broad range of small features and improvements across the entire game. Below is a highlight of the more prominent changes.

[h2]FACILITIES[/h2]

Several new Facilities improvements have been made. First, a new Facility modification, the [i]Heavy Munitions Foundry[/i] has been added, which is used to produce ammunition for tanks and heavy infantry weapons outside of logistics towns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/45c6ec699dc87f0dafae67c2b19348bf70988a67.jpg[/img]

A new form of Map Posts have been added to help builders highlight public Facilities to other players in the world. They communicate what can be produced and what is stockpiled at a given Facility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/ceb1a7b10532f4566bf6953d26424a9170cb1e12.jpg[/img]

Besides that, many other tweaks to gameplay have been made to Facilities gameplay. Watch the [url=https://youtu.be/ueN1YdXOglg?si=lu6kjB8gtww_s6j3]devstream[/url] for details.

[h2]SQUAD OFFICERS[/h2]

A new Squad Officer rank has been added, allowing Squad Leaders to better manage their Squads. Officers are next in line for promotion to Leader if requested, if the Leader becomes AFK, or if the Leader goes offline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/56d9ae65db8bdd9a88dc34dad07f49a3bda2cad9.jpg[/img]

[h2]OPTIMIZATION[/h2]

A large portion of development in this update was spent on optimizing both the server and client code for improved performance across the board. Some of those improvements are highlighted below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/d834837c13e250934cf1d480cc2a163b0027ae1d.jpg[/img]

[h2]OTHER FEATURES[/h2]

A bunch of other quality of life changes have been introduced as well, summarized below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/dac971bf1e6002c81bfcb5469067f0d6e5fe19fb.jpg[/img]

[h1]ENVIRONMENT LORE[/h1]

Two environmental set pieces have been added to the world. The first is in the form of a revamp of the [i]Stlican Shelf[/i] region, which features a large ruined relic ship on the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/532494eccac70ae7ca04c5482359e850dd4edbc6.jpg[/img]

The second is the [i]Velian Temple[/i], a new type of Garrisoned House featured in the southern part of the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/5d741f4714b32f1215e44a8e6fd7491df4c4778c.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW EQUIPMENT[/h1]

[h2]DEPLOYABLE BANNERS[/h2]

New Banner items can be carried (as large items) and deployed on the battlefield. Each faction has a unique design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/db94ff90fa33a48a1e8a8c078bd5df67499c71cb.jpg[/img]

[h2]COLONIAL FIELD MORTAR[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b318b46f0d61e65c79d4b75546c8ff7b9ea9a347.jpg[/img]

[h2]WARDEN ANTI-TANK RPG[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/bd2f0bb6ad6d8a3b8f8bdd60a0c325d597e4b444.jpg[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There many other features and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-60-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

[h1]I SAW A BEAR UPDATE VIDEO[/h1]
For a more comprehensive walkthrough of all the new features in Update 53, check out community veteran [i]I Saw A Bear[/i]'s video below.

[previewyoutube=0dJYrtrg85E;full][/previewyoutube]

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

notes.title: Huge WW2 MMO becomes so deadly and realistic that the dev is forced to intervene
notes.content:
There are some frighteningly realistic games out there. Battlefield 1 sticks in my mind, primarily for its sound effects and destruction physics. Hell Let Loose is similar, and then there's Escape From Tarkov and the controversial SWAT simulator Ready Or Not. But when it comes to the brutal attrition of war, where both sides suffer horrible casualties and neither can truly be called a winner, WW2 MMO Foxhole has just become the perfect metaphor. So drawn-out and deadly is the latest in-game battle that developer Siege Camp has been forced to intervene.

notes.title: Huge WW2 MMO is like a more realistic Battlefield V, and it's exploding on Steam
notes.content:
The greatest war games are all about scale. Perhaps you remember Medal of Honor Allied Assault, the superlative FPS from 2002. By today's standards it may look antiquated, but back then, the Omaha Beach level was bigger and more alive than anything you'd seen before - it really felt like a huge-scale battle, with thousands of soldiers and vehicles. Battlefield V can also feel suitably expansive. Likewise Hell Let Loose. But there's one unique MMO that is bigger than all of them, and still, somehow, manages to slip beneath the radar. A combination of Civilization's building and logistics and the co-op tactics of Commandos, it's just gotten an enormous new update, and now, Foxhole is close to breaking its all-time record on Steam.

notes.title: Infantry Update & The Biggest War of the Year
notes.content:
[h1]INFANTRY UPDATE[/h1]

Foxhole's annual update has arrived! Prepare for a major revision in Foxhole's infantry gameplay, designed to be more team-oriented and tactical. This update introduces deeper suppression gameplay, weapon shouldering mechanics, and a stamina overhaul, alongside other features to make the entire infantry playspace more impactful on the persistent battlefield. Watch the official [i]Infantry Update Launch Trailer[/i] below for a summary of what's new.

[previewyoutube=aZ4-5yPQNKk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]INFANTRY COMBAT OVERHAUL[/h1]

Experience a more dynamic infantry game with refined suppression, weapon shouldering, and stamina mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/8887713f656c8cc649ed4d0e6d7e9e6086c4a1e9.gif[/img]

[h1]INFANTRY ANTI-TANK WEAPONRY[/h1]
Infantry forces are now equipped to counter armor with the introduction of specialized anti-tank rifles for suppressing enemy armour advances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/0cde8a57b9522fa99809ece7b4e9336e4e7535f8.gif[/img]

[h1]CLOSE QUARTERS COMBAT[/h1]
Fight at close quarters with a new melee combat system that allows for both quick and charged attacks, blocking, and knock down mechanics. Charge through the trenches with new melee weapons, including the [i]Eleos Infantry Dagger[/i] and [i]Falias Raiding Club[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/ed5f3ea79c9f52d8aeeb53e53e73dfae8cc1ff27.jpg[/img]

Shotguns have also been updated with new mechanics, giving them a more unique role on the battlefield. New faction specific variants have also been added: The [i]KRF1-750 Dragonfly[/i] and the [i]No.4 The Pillory Scattergun[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/8fb89a8e53d4a33cc98d4a9065ced4c688c06b5f.gif[/img]

[h1]MEDIC UPDATE[/h1]
Medics have been upgraded with an expanded role, making ambulances and hospitals a more crucial part of the war effort. Medical Rooms can now be built directly inside bunker networks, enabling wounded soldiers to recover directly at the trench lines. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a4f6e5597339f34accf9d4e537233b0e10352cfa.jpg[/img]

Finally, medical forces have been bolstered with the all new First Aid Train, a mobile field hospital that traverses the battlefield on rail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f1d1f86aa2113f9a2ab88d660596b9f2236c1425.gif[/img]

[h1]INFANTRY ARMS FACTORY[/h1]
New facilities have been added for producing crates of equipment and specialized weapons for infantry. To support this new production chain, a new [i]Small Container Train Car[/i] has been added as well as the new [i]Crate Transfer Station[/i], which allows disassembled crates of equipment to be stored at Facilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f4a2018591e74aeb92aae6ad60dba7b91695c6e2.jpg[/img]

[h1]INFANTRY BATTLEGROUNDS[/h1]
A more engaging infantry battleground with the addition of ruined fortifications and other features,  offering cover and a more dynamic combat environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/9bb1fc10c102ab4186a41ea4dc69482d242e7f68.jpg[/img]

[h1]PERSISTENT MINE FIELDS[/h1]
Large scale, persistent mine fields can now be deployed to permanently bolster fortification lines. Mine fields can be constructed with either [i]Anti-Tank[/i] or [i]Anti-Infantry[/i] Mines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/e8c8e55c9823f27ecac31f8f7759c3d4bc7fe6f5.jpg[/img]

[h1]CUSTOM INFANTRY LOADOUTS[/h1]
Infantry can now build custom loadouts, enabling mission specific gear to be easily assembled deploying to the front.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/7b7f0bb1814ff9c372da9d23e7c90139c8b06aec.gif[/img]

[h1]MAP SEARCH TOOL[/h1]
As the persistent world has expanded over the years, there are now hundreds of locations on the map. To help players navigate this vast geography, a new search tool has been added to the map interface, allowing any location to be easily identified.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/5c3106bb02fc5444ffc028241c840587ba45ad64.gif[/img]

[h1]90T-V "NEMESIS"[/h1]
With immense off-road capabilities, the 90T-v “Nemesis” is a highly versatile armoured vehicle. While it may not boast the defensive capabilities of its more heavily armoured cousins, the “Nemesis” shatters enemy formations with its deadly 68mm cannon and auxiliary grenade launcher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/4575de75007897c0dd9b886d5b617a3d95844c37.jpg[/img]

[h1]GALLAGHER BRIGAND MK. I[/h1]
The first of Colm Gallagher’s mid-sized tanks, the Brigand is a true brute on the battlefield. Not quite as sturdy as its younger siblings, the Brigand compensates with higher mobility, which, when paired with a mounted machine gun and 30mm repeater cannon, is a deadly force in any armour division.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/0e72cb44195e2964968f70d3ab78732b85816433.jpg[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There numerous other features, content, and bug fixes in this annual update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-59-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

notes.title: Huge WW2 MMO Foxhole deserves more love, because it's only getting better
notes.content:
The main thing that stops me from getting interested in MMOs or MMORPGs is how they - by their nature - lack a kind of consequence, or a permanence. There are raids, bosses, and world events, but ultimately everything resets and no matter what happens, the in-game universe remains largely the same. I like games where it feels like things matter - where you get a sense of ardor, bitter loss, and hard-fought victory. Combining the huge-scale WWII combat of Battlefield V, the production and building systems of Factorio, and the persistent sandbox world of WoW, Foxhole is still an MMO that resets every few weeks, but there are some novel ideas to make it feel more weighty, more meaningful. It ought to be one of the biggest games on Steam, and the upcoming Airborne update will hopefully push it closer to the top.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Airborne and Infantry Updates Announced
notes.content:
Two new updates have been announced, [i][b]Foxhole: Airborne[/b][/i] which arrives next summer and the [b][i]Infantry Update[/i][/b] which releases on [b]Nov 18th![/b]

[h1]FOXHOLE: AIRBORNE[/h1]

[i]Airborne[/i] is the next chapter of Foxhole that expands the massively played online war game from land and sea to air. [i]Foxhole Airborne[/i] is currently under development and is slated for a Summer 2025 release. More features, content, and details are to be revealed next year. Visit the official Airborne [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/airborne]webpage[/url] for more screenshots and information.

[previewyoutube=i-DTKFrJ6Qc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Air Warfare[/b] - Foxhole’s online persistent war takes to the skies, expanding the massive player driven conflict from land and sea to air.

[b]Combined Sandbox[/b] - Ground, naval, and now airborne players all converge in the same playable world to create a seamless online battlefield.

[b]Paratroopers[/b] - Paradrop with your squad behind hostile lines to cripple supply chains and sabotage enemy equipment.

[b]Logistics[/b] - The logistics chain has expanded to support aircraft production and supply, with player ground crews vital for rearming and preparing aircraft for their next mission.

[b]Every Pilot is a Player[/b] - Climb into the cockpit as a pilot or gunner in a variety of aircraft, from nimble fighters to powerful bombers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/013bae3319a66c987d0d22b8a347f94713a00b60.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/1f1654213f78a4b6bd89a6567e20de43111ddafd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/d0f5f11991ff209d53f85001d369dcb98297db97.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/488e36b8db157a675e8866ecc9d891561abbac76.jpg[/img]

[h1]INFANTRY UPDATE[/h1]

The Infantry update is a major revamp of Foxhole's infantry gameplay, designed to be more team-oriented and tactical. notes.title: Now's the best time to try out newly updated war MMO Foxhole
notes.content:
Foxhole has always been one of the most unique games in the MMO space. Unlike genre mainstays World of Warcraft, Final Fantasy 14, or Lost Ark, Foxhole looks outside of the fantasy realm for inspiration, basing its online play on a grim chapter of real world history, with enormous clashes between armies fought in a setting that resembles World War II battlefields. This has always made it a compelling concept, but, thanks to a new patch that further refines and adds onto the base game and its Naval Warfare update, Foxhole is drumming up even more interest on Steam.

notes.title: Update 57 Released - Weather Revamp, New Logistics Ship, Quality of Life
notes.content:
[h1]WEATHER REVAMP[/h1]

Update 57 revisits the weather systems that were added over three years ago in [i]Winter Army[/i]. The goal of these changes were to address major player feedback, make weather have more of an interesting impact on gameplay, and adapt weather to all the new content that has been added over the years.

[h2]SNOW STORMS[/h2]

Rivers and lakes can now freeze over again. This was a feature that was removed in [i]Naval Warfare[/i] but not only is it back, but it's been expanded upon. Frozen bodies of water can now crack and break when vehicles drive over them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f7b05f108226db5cc787ec6ccc913628b1e8f558.gif[/img]

The heavier the vehicle, the more quickly the ice is damaged. Large Ships like Destroyers can also crash through ice while Submarines can traverse beneath. Broken ice will refreeze over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f57da5c2d5018d0a37cfafe0e949d89953f96964.gif[/img]

[h2]RAINSTORMS[/h2]

Rainstorms have been overhauled with more interesting mechanics, giving players more agency with how they are impacted. Infantry are no longer automatically encumbered by Rainstorms when walking over certain surfaces but rather are only impacted when walking over discreet pools of water that accumulate dynamically on the ground, in trenches, and artillery craters. These pools of water can be removed with a [i]Shovel[/i] or [i]Water Bucket[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/96f2f40e80c3caeb4c79a1d4e9b265412bfb698c.gif[/img]

[h1]WEATHER STRUCTURES[/h1]

New structures have been introduced to help armies deal with and strategize around weather events.

[h2]BUNKER HEARTH[/h2]
The keystone to any bunker, this simple hearth functions both as oven and warmth in the coldest weather, heating a fair area around it when built on solid foundations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a59d6609256bc46ef77929531177c7357a241db5.jpg[/img]

[h2]FIELD RANGE[/h2]
This easy-to-construct range is perfect for keeping warm in the cold, while being sturdier than a simple firepit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/1237301548088c58c7ff365224d394f5e4024fca.jpg[/img]

[h2]WEATHER STATION[/h2]
A high-tech weather module built on solid foundations within a bunker network. These stations help operators predict weather patterns. Multiple Weather Station modules may be chained together to make more accurate predictions, allowing armies to prepare for the worst conditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/cc802e7083cd07a6154f306c715224bdfaa3733e.jpg[/img]

[h2]WIND SOCK[/h2]
A sturdy fabric cylinder mounted on a tripod that’s designed to help nearby operators determine the speed and direction of wind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/e78a0854465e0cf71b3b9a0eed89377af2226b66.jpg[/img]

[h1]LARGE RESOURCE SHIP[/h1]

[h2]BMS - BOWHEAD[/h2]
[i]This BMS shipping vessel, the Bowhead, is specially designed to carry large quantities of resource containers and fitted with compartments for resource Harvesters. Named for a great whale, the Bassett Motor Society ensures that resources get delivered to the front lines where they’re needed and when they’re needed due to efficient loading bay design and a sturdy frame.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/7c448908bdacbc15c2914b55640ac4e2bcbbfea4.gif[/img]

[h2]BMS - IRONSHIP (REFRESH)[/h2]
[i]The Bassett Motor Society’s Ironship-class shipping vessel is used to freight shippable goods and heavy vehicles.[/i]

The Freighter has been updated to be more consistent in scale and features with the other vessels introduced in [i]Naval Warfare[/i]. It has a redesigned chassis, a walkable deck, an extra passenger seat, and a spotter position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/7f18333e47918055d122e8eba72da3a43804db32.gif[/img]

[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE[/h1]

[b]INVENTORY TOOLS[/b]

The inventory has been upgraded with new quality of life changes. New features include sorting functionality, custom stack splitting, smart stacking, equipment slot tooltips, and inventory access as passengers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/090dfd4421e381fbe2ed51a64727a1f922ecdf0e.gif[/img]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

There are numerous other quality of life changes, some shown below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/7c1e872ed468f4d69720e44847added50081d041.jpg[/img]

[h1]OTHER CHANGES[/h1]

This update contains dozens of other improvements including Facility Husks, a Sniper Rifle rework, new player UX improvements, and much more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/3dafe7fb07d07c0099fef126bd4833b19b160605.jpg[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There many other features and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-57-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

[h1]I SAW A BEAR UPDATE VIDEO[/h1]
For a more comprehensive walkthrough of all the new features in Update 53, check out community veteran [i]I Saw A Bear[/i]'s video below.

[previewyoutube=BVlieR0mc6w;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: After two years, huge realistic war MMO has thousands more players
notes.content:
Between Baldur's Gate 3, Diablo 4, Balatro, and then upcoming surefire hits like GTA 6, it's been a busy era for new games. Some have staying power. Some, unfortunately, do not. Even great games can get swept away by the passage of time and advent of new releases - what seems like a modern classic one month can be forgotten by the next. But it's not always this way. Years, even a decade later, some games suddenly find themselves super popular again, with a teeming player base either discovering them for the first time, or coming back for another waltz. A huge-scale, super realistic, war-based MMO, originally launched in 2022, is one such example. It might have slipped your mind by now, or perhaps passed you by entirely, but with thousands more players in the past week, this is proof that some games just keep living.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Update 56 Released - Frigates, Submarines, & Facilities Overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]WARDEN LIGHT FRIGATE - BLACKSTEELE[/h1]
Named for the unpainted look of an early prototype, the Blacksteele-Class Frigate is a highly manoeuvrable, albeit small-statured vessel. Deployment of “Trident” Submarines by the Republic Coastal Legion saw the Caoivish Naval Command respond in kind with the Blacksteele.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/620261031d95e6b5944310a2365013fa5a8435ed.jpg[/img]

Designed as a sub-hunter escort, the Blacksteele excels at thwarting submersible assaults against larger, ungainly ships. The head shipwright on the project was none other than Conor O’Brien’s top protégé, Rory Boyd, who, in his later years became known as a master shipwright, and largely recognised as the man behind the Caoivish Naval Command’s world-class reputation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a9ef1431bbc96ddbfc835e91e79f319427eb1904.gif[/img]

Primary armaments include two 120mm turrets and 68mm turrets. Secondary armaments include a Quad Depth Charge Launcher and two Heavy Machine Guns. The Blacksteele supports a large crew complement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/744075727a67825695137249f62954aa22fb2fcd.jpg[/img]

[h1]COLONIAL SUBMARINE - AC-B “TRIDENT” [/h1]

The AC-b or “Trident”-class submersible brings much-needed versatility to the Republic Coastal Legion. Featuring a quick-loading ammo bay, the “Trident” is capable of quickly re-arming and returning to the hunt. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/e730a3877f280519cd7e0f1252d41ac836c8371b.jpg[/img]

Combat Magister Curia commissioned the skilled engineers out of Dimiourg to develop a submersible to help counter the rapidly progressing naval technology deployed by the Wardens and Nevish Alliance. Much of the senate criticised Curia for this decision, as they believe it more prudent to invest resources into airborne warfare innovations. After witnessing the return and redeployment of several successful trial AC-b operations, it wasn’t hard to convince the Senate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/4073bd1b657148d605720b3a52eed5af541605d7.gif[/img]

Primary armaments include two Torpedo Tubes and a 120mm Deck Turret that can be used against surface targets. The AC-b “Trident” features a unique [i]Ammo Bay Hatch[/i] that allows for rearming without returning to [i]Dry Dock[/i]. This vessel supports a medium crew complement. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/298de392e92b486e16ff69d0b66e2c967c234145.jpg[/img]

[h1]NAVAL[/h1]

[h2]OCEAN TRAVEL[/h2]
The naval game has been expanded with many key updates. First, is the addition of [i]Ocean Border Travel[/i], which allows ships to travel from an East or West Ocean border to the other side of the world. This allows for many more opportunities for naval engagements in all wars, especially those with East-West oriented starting conditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b8d2343a82e320cdcc61dabb846d62c4bbb2ba8f.gif[/img]

[h2]TORPEDO REVAMP[/h2]
Torpedo gameplay has been completely revamped to give Submarines a more unique hit-and-run role out at seas. Direct Torpedo hits to enemy vessels now causes the target to roll from the force of the impact, kills crew near to the impact, and creates a [i]Large Leak[/i], which requires a [i]Dry Dock[/i] for repair.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/6485eeaac0487bd6fac09ce8d8fd231578d74ab4.gif[/img]

[h2]DRY DOCK UPGRADES[/h2]
The [i]Dry Dock[/i] has also been upgraded both visually and gameplay wise. The model has been updated to include more details, new animations for ship building has been added, and water now visually drains and fills up when a ship is being constructed or repaired. In addition to cosmetic improvements, [i]Material Pallet[/i] and [i]Shipping Container[/i] contents can now be directly transferred from the [i]Dry Dock Loading Area[/i] to a specific stockpile on a docked vessel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b7c4ec200cb4b79687232f4e3680bd21fef1e262.gif[/img]

[h1]FACILITIES OVERHAUL[/h1]

[h2]PRODUCTION PARALLELIZATION[/h2]
Facilities have been overhauled to make the more approachable to new players and to encourage collaboration in the spirit of Foxhole. Production Facilities can now produce items in parallel, allowing them to be shared with public players who can queue up their own private orders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/ac286bb7100af08e22e4b415c40c725e69c8ab59.jpg[/img]

[h2]POWER SCALING[/h2]
Power mechanics have been improved to make Facilities easier to manage. Power Plants and Power Stations consume fewer resources when less Power is being consumed on the grid than is being generated. Production Facilities no longer turn off when insufficient Power is being supplied. Finally, in low Power situations, production speed is scaled down proportional to demand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/d1ef6718ccfcfb9dc76b9d356bf15c0dbb4951d6.jpg[/img]

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

This update contains dozens of other improvements, including more voice chat settings, colour customization on more Container structures, interface improvements, and much more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/09bbdddedfeb394b42ba91306fa5db4a166f43f3.jpg[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There many other features and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-56-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

[h1]I SAW A BEAR UPDATE VIDEO[/h1]
For a more comprehensive walkthrough of all the new features in Update 53, check out community veteran [i]I Saw A Bear[/i]'s video below.

notes.title: Update 55 - Improvements & Game Balance
notes.content:
[i]Note: Most of the content of this post is taken from our recent [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/devblog-update-55]Devblog[/url].[/i]

As 2023 winds down, we wanted to give everyone a final update on development for the year, including information on the next minor update as well as an early look at what's to come beyond that.

The team has worked tremendously hard this year shipping four updates including Naval Warfare and needs some down time to be with their family and friends over the holidays. While our live and moderation teams will still be supporting the game throughout this time, most the dev team will be taking some well deserved time off for rest and recuperation. If we are quiet, rest assured that we'll be heads down looking at feedback and working hard on the next update when the new year rolls around.

We hope everyone has a safe and happy holidays. See you all in 2024!

[h1]ROADMAP[/h1]
As mentioned previously, the plan was to do one more minor update before the end of the year. 

After Update 55, we will continue to expand on the Naval game that was introduced back in October. In the new year, Update 56 will arrive and will add new naval vehicles for each faction. A Frigate class ship will be added to the Warden navy and a Submarine class vessel will be added to the Colonial fleet. We’re excited to provide each faction with the gameplay that is currently only accessible to one side or the other.

Throughout next year, the plan is to go back and refine various parts of the game, iterating on existing features rather than building entirely new systems. We know that QoL is a top priority for the community so that’s something we’re also going to be working on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/78ee44117dcda77991b0c42ac940ea2c9ed873ae.png[/img]

In terms of the bigger picture, up until now we’ve been working off of an internal roadmap that included Trains, Facilities, Towing, and a Naval revamp. It was extremely challenging pulling off major updates year after year but we really wanted to get Naval Warfare in to complete the roadmap as it’s always been to us a foundational part of the persistent war, not to mention one of the most highly requested features from the community. With that final piece of the puzzle in place and the internal roadmap complete, the team will be taking a break from major updates to focus on refreshing, but not reinventing existing systems for awhile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/e6273a0669084ef4ae5438db9785c9ebd112efa5.png[/img]

Make no mistake though, we are developing a brand new roadmap for the next phase of development but it will take some time. Major updates will be part of that next phase and we're in the early stages of planning some big exciting things but don’t expect that to arrive any time soon. The Foxhole development team will continue to grow and updates will continue to be delivered for many years to come.

[h1]UPDATE 55[/h1]

There is some important context to keep in mind for the changes going into Update 55. First of all, this will probably be one of our smallest updates of the year. Between supporting Update 54 and the work that will come in Update 56 in the new year, the scope of Update 55 had to be small.

The main focus has been on addressing an internal backlog of fixes and tweaks that have accumulated over the last while as we focused on the naval update. It's important to understand that the changes that end up in updates like this aren't always based on what is deemed the highest priority feedback to action but rather on current team resources available and other circumstantial factors.

Update 55 will have game balance changes, a lot of bug fixes, and a handful of small improvements such as those shown below. For a complete list of the changes in this update, read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-55-release-notes]release notes[/url].

We understand that there are many other changes the community is requesting based on the current war. We also know there have been requests for more QoL features. We are looking into addressing more of these issues in the updates coming in the new year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/4086f09c9d46665e0890453c1097305891ba5a26.png[/img]

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

notes.content: Foxhole is a sandbox-style war MMO and, while it officially released last year, it's been available in early access since 2017. Its schtick is one persistent and gigantic war game where thousands of players simultaneously battle for one of two factions, both seeking domination over a gigantic map, but with the twist that, as in a real conflict, the logistics, resource and supply side of the armies is just as important, if not more so, than the soldiers firing guns and piloting vehicles... notes.title: Foxhole Naval Warfare is LIVE
notes.content:
[h1]NAVAL WARFARE[/h1]
Foxhole’s next major update has arrived and expands the persistent online war from land to sea, enabling thousands of concurrent players to join player built fleets and engage in full fledged naval battles. In this massive overhaul, players will step onto the decks of battleships, invade distant shores in high stakes beach landings, conquer new island-based territories, and more.

[previewyoutube=W_X2TcrDBqY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]NAVAL WARFARE[/h1]

[h2]FLEETS OF SHIPS[/h2]
Build and deploy impressive fleets of Gunboats, Destroyers, and massive, screen-spanning Battleships with dozens of players on deck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/19e171480db782eaec4d4f5421d9ab134e7cde4a.gif[/img]

[h2]MASSIVELY MULTIPLAYER CREWS[/h2]
Operate new classes of large naval vessels with crews that must work in tandem above and below deck, taking control of engine rooms, sonar, navigation, and other ship systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/13316f68ab0f2f2656cb4cf22cdda03c4652b448.png[/img]

[h2]NAVAL TACTICS & STRATEGY[/h2]
Coordinate with shipmates to deliver and load ammunition, launch depth charges, and deploy sea mines in nail biting, tactical naval battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/081d7ce683dc7e51c899f8c2530daa464813dbdb.gif[/img]

[h2]IN-DEPTH SHIP SIMULATION[/h2]
Ship subsystems can be individually destroyed and compartments may become flooded. Seawater must be bailed out and leaks repaired to stay afloat during naval engagements. In critical moments of battle, players must decide between sealing off flooded rooms or risking the total loss of a ship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/9d5551f1fcc74eb123516e7f6db09df64ed52de3.png[/img]

[h2]SUBMARINES[/h2]
A new threat emerges from the depths. Invisible to conventional intelligence equipment, Submarines can traverse the seas undetected, ambushing convoys and thwarting naval invasions before they begin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b47ad347ec2a4e0e8df2901f15136602624eb689.gif[/img]

[h1]INVADE FROM THE SEA[/h1]

[h2]BEACH LANDINGS[/h2]
Naval landings have been redesigned from the ground up, enabling armies to land on distant beaches and fight their way through enemy bunkers, trenches, and emplacements. New base ships allow players to deploy directly at sea to stage coastal invasions. Dedicated landing ships can be launched from these bases to ferry infantry, armour, and field weapons to shore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/6816734ae787a2c9b4b56245759d3cea8916a66b.png[/img]

[h2]WATER LOGISTICS[/h2]
Colossal cargo ships are essential for any invading armada to resupply troops during landings, allowing for sustained long term operations at sea. Once the beachhead is secured, field piers allow logistics to continue supplying engaged forces as they push inland to secure enemy territory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/8d6d91836228b24142aaf260787ca57c49ad3275.gif[/img]

[h2]ISLAND WARFARE & OIL PLATFORMS[/h2]
The world of Foxhole has been expanded with new water-based regions. Complete with strategic islands and offshore oil platforms, these new territories set the stage for thrilling new naval campaigns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/d12c12375bc2e1325c200b697d0f431d3ad9ee42.gif[/img]

[h1]TOWING[/h1]

[h2]TOWABLE VEHICLES[/h2]
Logistics forces have been upgraded with vehicle towing. Trucks, Half-Tracks, and other specialized vehicles are now capable of towing field weapons and other equipment on the battlefield. Towing enables brand new field weapon mechanics, including heavy field guns that are difficult to move with infantry and require deployment before usage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b16256d7e8b351b2ee94f1d110a87cbc360af544.gif[/img]

[h2]TRANSPORT TRAILERS[/h2]
Logistics units can now produce one of several transport trailers, allowing additional resources, materials, and fuel to be hauled on cargo runs to the front.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a57083ee44f31d70432b488384cbd5f9a2c6a325.png[/img]

[h2]HEAVY DUTY TRUCK CLASS[/h2]
Towing the heaviest payloads will require a new class of vehicles. The [i]Heavy Duty Truck[/i] is equipped with a high-powered engine and includes a manual transmission to meet the demands of challenging terrain on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/1d6f66c454b3c72676dd9a4765eaf775b08e6408.png[/img]

[h1]SELF PROPELLED ARTILLERY[/h1]

Rocket Sites require the coordination of many players to produce and operate, requiring an Intelligence Center for targeting. With the capability of levelling entire towns, they represent one of the most devastating weapons in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/261eb91c13ee2ecebf980b335caeecbccf704630.png[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]

notes.title: Spring Update - New West Coast Maps, Cross Faction Voice, and more!
notes.content:
[i]For a more in-depth look at features coming in Update 53, check out the latest [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/devblog-spring-update-2023]devblog[/url].[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/9dd352882bd374f82c4147b0fb3486ee0a4ce0cc.gif[/img]

[h1]NEW WEST COAST  MAPS[/h1]
Significant changes have been made to the world map. The west coast of [i]Caoiva[/i] has been redesigned with two new regions: [i]King's Cage[/i] and [i]Sableport[/i]. These changes are being made as a pre-requisite for other map changes coming in [i]Update 54[/i], which will be the next big annual update for Foxhole.

[h2]KING'S CAGE[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/0d4aa04d97cee5bef64702d8600cf5d0ca1c4126.jpg[/img]
[i]A split river region that once housed a prison for Caoiva’s greatest hero. His shackled march from the Heartlands of Caoiva is the stuff of legends. It was his tenacity in the face of ridicule and imminent death that eventually won over his captors, and that tenacity extends down to the very soil of the region. From the cascading cliffs of The Manacle to ever-blooming Bloodfields, King’s Cage will forever represent a turning point in Caoiva’s history and independence. [/i]

[h2]SABLEPORT[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/ed9accc4539c2b1912cdf47eb80808e0678092a2.jpg[/img]
[i]Once a checkpoint along the Bulwark in the west, Sableport was later taken over as a base of operations by Jon Barrony. During a period of peace following one of Barrony’s several victories, his constituents settled inside the walls of the base, transforming it into a bustling town. Much of the strategic importance of Sableport lies in its dense woods south of the Bulwark, and the port town of Light’s End.[/i]

[h1]DEDICATED AMMO SLOTS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/445716b216717914e0a2951af862045e4b8a5fb1.jpg[/img]

Vehicles now have dedicated slots for shells and clips, which will allow weapons to have more diverse ammunition capacities. Furthermore, without the need to share ammunition with other slots, certain vehicles can now have additional generic slots for storing extra equipment. These slots also have a new UI that indicates the type of ammo a vehicle uses, which is informative for new players.

[h1]CROSS FACTION VOICE CHAT[/h1]
Local voice chat has always been a foundation feature of Foxhole. As far back as the early Pre-Alpha builds, being able to talk to players spatially around you has been essential for teamwork and occasionally engaging with the enemy. The latter also allowed for a lot of fun sandbox scenarios and role playing opportunities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/7e1711c34ec9b8cf184743149a93ae1d1d7fcb2c.jpg[/img]

Due to technical limitations, cross faction voice chat was disabled over two years ago. Since then, the community has been regularly asking for it's return. After a long search for solutions, cross faction voice chat is finally being reimplemented in the game. Players will finally be able to talk to their enemies across the battlefield once again!

[h1]NEW RIFLES[/h1]
While it's still very much a goal for each faction to have unique content, there has been an ongoing low key effort to fill in some gaps in weaponry for each side. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/60a3c7aba4d347c358525f35dc01ae9eb57d63ce.jpg[/img]

First, we have the Colonial Catena rt.IV Auto-Rifle, which is an automatic rifle and counterpart to the Warden Sampo Auto-Rifle 77. Then we have the Warden No.2B Hawthorne, which is a secondary slot rifle and counterpart to the Colonial “The Pitch Gun” mc.V.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/24c5ee75186b1ba09c57901c04f0f90a758556f6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Rocket Artillery Update[/h1]
This update will revisit Rocket Artillery once again with the ongoing goal of making them useful while still having a unique role on the battlefield that's distinct from conventional artillery. The maximum range on all Rocket Artillery has been significantly increased, with accuracy being lower at the longer range and flight time extended.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a1fbea93482a70b60166b9a0b14fb2aefc513186.jpg[/img]

In addition, new early war vehicles have been added to allow both factions to produce and utilize both types of rockets. Previously, only Wardens could use 4C-Fire Rockets and only Colonials could use 3C-High Explosive Rockets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/5514cccf14115887e354e36f0a6ffabf3d4f8997.jpg[/img]

[h1]ASSEMBLY SPEED BONUS[/h1]
Assembly times are now dynamic to reduce the overall amount of time productive players spend retrieving items from stockpiles while still discouraging uninformed or uncooperative players from taking too much. Players will now receive a speed bonus when assembling items, which will be diminished as more items are retrieved. Over time the bonus will be replenished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b4e0b75ee642beaad4c06de1af3a4099eb568fa8.gif[/img]

[h1]OTHER IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
This update contains dozens of other small improvements, quality of life changes, and minor visual enhancements that have been in the development pipeline for awhile but never got a chance to be completed until now. Many of these changes were based on lower profile feedback received from the community or internal issues that never quite seem to be high enough in priority to work on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/831bad5f888d368ccb4885871143654c962300a5.png[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There many other features and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-53-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

[h1]I SAW A BEAR UPDATE VIDEO[/h1]
For a more comprehensive walkthrough of all the new features in Update 53, check out community veteran [i]I Saw A Bear[/i]'s video below.

[previewyoutube=kzCgsh9ytNg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 52 - Dragons Teeth, Havoc Charges, Railway Maps, and More!
notes.content:
[i]For additional details on Update 52 check out our latest [url=https://youtu.be/iOh3EnmbJi4]Devstream[/url].[/i]

[h1]DRAGON'S TEETH[/h1]
An anti-tank obstacle that prevents vehicle access to an area, and is resistant to most types of damage. Dragon's Teeth are built in rows, which can be dynamically scaled in length when placed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a50cd2fcf2a64f2c3af9944bf4c20b22d5738e8e.png[/img]

[h1]HAVOC REMOTE CHARGE[/h1]
A high-powered explosive charge that requires a detonator to deploy. The Havoc Charge is highly effective at demolishing large structures. The charge must be detonated via gunshot. The Havoc Charge’s true potential is unleashed when executing strategic demolitions at safe distances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f42dc333d804cc81aa9df9b4f9e12aecf34e549d.png[/img]

[h1]FACILITY UPGRADES[/h1]
New Facility features have been added to provide additional options for power generation and to streamline liquid transport. These upgrades are summarized in the image below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b27c332fb8b9e0462180a4d51695ce3061e483e1.png[/img]

[h1]ADVANCED CONTRUCTION VEHICLE[/h1]
An advanced variant of the Universal Assembly Rig, the BMS - Fabricator is fitted with a unique kit designed to handle advanced or specialized construction and excavation jobs. The Fabricator can fill in certain trench types and can construct a variety of Bunkers and other defensive structures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/94b15abf1d61c939f8c67e5ea5dcfc5950e586c9.png[/img]

[h1]RAILROAD MAPS[/h1]
Player built train networks can now be visualized on the world map, giving logistics the ability to collaborate and plan their train routes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f9301ae8976e49e0ae45e9964300e9556b9692ec.png[/img]

[h1]FACTION BALANCE[/h1]
This update contains several key game balance changes. The Colonial's have had their Grenade Launcher significantly upgraded, with it's anti-structure damage increased by 100%. Their Super Heavy Tank class vehicle has also had it's range increased to a full 40m, giving it the range to devastate structures from a distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/53173309790a0284a3f7696f292c06c773e4b117.png[/img]

The Wardens now have a mobile 94.5mm armoured vehicle (that isn't a Super Heavy Tank class), bolstering their end war anti-tank capability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/4d6ef09bf2b97ed8ddf46a5f561afcad30d02b9f.png[/img]

[h1]TIER 2 STORAGE ROOMS[/h1]
Storage Rooms are now available at Tier 2 Bunkers, enabling artillery shells, large tank ammo, and other large munitions to be stockpiled at frontline bases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/43bd886d7c1fde2b0a2f373e716c24ffd9bb974d.png[/img]

[h1]STRUCTURE DECAY OVERHAUL[/h1]
Decay mechanics have been completely overhauled, giving builders a much higher degree of control over structure maintenance. Supplies needed to prevent decay can now be produced at [i]Mass Production Factories[/i] and Facilities. In addition, decayed structures can now be automatically/passively repaired by [i]Maintenance Tunnels[/i] over time, removing a previously time consuming activity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/66114f91c85d28675e4a2e70d53c80cc34e6b7ae.png[/img]

[h1]30+ QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
This update has dozens of other quality of life changes and small improvements. Below is a small subset of those changes, but there are many more in the release notes.

[list]
[*] Redesigned map legend with new filters and customization options
[*] Reservable storage for combat vehicles
[*] Transportable concrete
[*] New Track Switch interface
[*] Structure event logs
[*] Bandwidth usage for high player activity events reduced by 80-90%
[*] Many new anti-griefing and moderation features
[*] Dozens of other improvements
[/list]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There many other features and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-52-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

[h1]I SAW A BEAR UPDATE VIDEO[/h1]
For a more comprehensive walkthrough of all the new features in Update 52, check out community veteran [i]I Saw A Bear[/i]'s video below.

[previewyoutube=u2w1smF3iKA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 51 - Fire Engines, Caboose, Facility Upgrades, and Quality of Life
notes.content:
[i]Update 51 is focused on iterating on Inferno features, with new quality of life changes, optimizations, and content to support existing features like trains and fire. For further details on this update, please check out our latest [url=https://youtu.be/4bxCTk-Z8tA]Devstream[/url].[/i]

[h1]FIRE ENGINES[/h1]
In the last update, fire weapons were introduced which allows structures and entire towns to be set towns ablaze. Fire Engines have now been added to help players fight fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/2f4640490d2dbb00f33d108df9ecf46718c26b4c.gif[/img]

Each faction has their own unique Fire Engine variant, with the Colonials getting the [i]R-12b - “Salva” Flame Truck[/i] and the Wardens getting the [i]Dunne Dousing Engine 3r[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/0f37d21dcab33b6aa06193c70a4b01b1fcd6909d.png[/img]

[h1]CABOOSE[/h1]
One of the biggest pieces of feedback we got for Update 50 was how difficult it was to maintain railroad networks. To help alleviate this, the [i]Caboose[/i] car is being introduced, which will automatically repair tracks when driving over them, removing the need for [i]Maintenance Tunnels[/i] or [i]Bases[/i] for maintenance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/92fb12bbf8384b2a33f7c0e259b05bfbe4a2a75c.gif[/img]

The Caboose can be attached to any train and consumes either [i]Construction Materials[/i] or [i]Garrisoned Supplies[/i] to repair decayed tracks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/6f583c1e34d24df19fc9d57b210fb4625fee8df6.png[/img]

[h1]FACILITY UPGRADES[/h1]
Facilities have been expanded with new upgrades and structures to help players overcome challenges and to add additional utility to them. They are summarized in the image below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a5fc48d3f2f66643b18114d09ca82b19562aaeae.png[/img]

[h1]FIRE UPDATE[/h1]
A comprehensive pass was done on fire mechanics to address various player feedback. The summary is that infantry flamethrowers have been buffed, fire rockets have been tempered, and the experience of putting out fires has been improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/4a21ae1770dcc26d809b5d0abd1930cdefdb71cc.gif[/img]

There are a lot more under the hood changes to fire that's worth noting. For full details, please watch this timestamped portion of the [url=https://youtu.be/4bxCTk-Z8tA?t=1521]Devstream[/url].

[h1]OTHER NEW CONTENT[/h1]

[h2]Lance-25 “Hasta”[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/693e3a9e634db3d7f6332451bec4d1a5b4976f2a.png[/img]

[h2]Flood Juggernaut Mk. VII[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/4c01a17b4163fff070b70799732d82a6285cd6e7.png[/img]

[h2]Fissura gd.I[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/c04b1cab919aa6b9d2c183f9e60c0e8ffeeb2b36.png[/img]

[h2]O’Brien v.190 Knave[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b2e0f46e6353d026fac7ea98281f94de30ba2106.png[/img]

[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE[/h1]
Many quality of life features have been added based on player feedback, including the following

[list]
[*] Large items can be removed from Pallets directly without opening the UI
[*] Trench Connectors can now be built underneath Tracks and Provisional roads
[*] Build menu has been sorted for easier navigation
[*] One click reservations for power networked Facilities is now available
[*] Demolish times have been increased, providing greater flexibility for builders
[*] Interact menu now shows upgrades, making it easier to select a specific structure
[*] Tunnel UI now shows Garrisoned Supplies consumption rate
[*] Equipment tooltips now include extra details such as where it is produced from
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a9b3d845d8609b9f3096ef02b4baa203ee09276b.gif[/img]

[h1]OPTIMIZATIONS[/h1]
Update 51 introduces many optimizations to the servers and networking infrastructure which should amount to an overall smoother experience, especially for vehicle gameplay. For details, watch this timestamped portion of the [url=https://youtu.be/4bxCTk-Z8tA?t=281]Devstream[/url].

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There many other features and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-51-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

notes.title: Foxhole's massively multiplayer war has now left early access
notes.content:
Massively multiplayer games rapidly calcified around a specific set of design ideas (eg. World Of Warcraft) and so many other attempts to jam a load of players onto a single server quickly disappeared (eg. most games by Improbable or Amazon).

Foxhole is one of the few to do it successfully: a single, massive World War 2 battlefield in which players don't just fight at the frontlines, but form supply routes, build defenses, and otherwise take the reigns of the logistics of war. After five years in early access, Foxhole released version 1.0 today.

Read more

notes.title: Strategy MMO Foxhole leaves Early Access with huge Inferno update
notes.content:
As a hybrid MMORPG and RTS game, Foxhole has chosen for itself a unique set of challenges. Perhaps the biggest of these is the question of getting players to run the logistics side of a massive war - how do you make it fun and interesting to do the 'boring' work of producing and transporting the gear that the frontline soldiers need to keep fighting? Surprisingly, Foxhole seems to pull that off, and the massive Inferno Update that arrives alongside its departure from Early Access on September 28 makes the logistics game even more compelling.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
MMO war game Foxhole gets huge update with new content and 3,000-player wars
Players are recording Foxhole's Eve Online-like wars through radio documentaries
Win a copy of new, impressive online RTS game Foxhole on Steam!

notes.title: Foxhole 1.0 Inferno is LIVE
notes.content:
[h1]INFERNO[/h1]
Foxhole finally exits Early Access with [i]Inferno[/i], a massive update that adds many highly anticipated features including trains, player built logistics bases, fire weapons, rocket artillery, and much more. With tons of new content, now is the time to return to the world of Foxhole or check it out for the first time!

[previewyoutube=S6c_NsuTZSs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]FACTORY BUILDING[/h1]
Inferno introduces player built Facilities, which is a full fledged factory building game. Construct and manage industrial bases that can be developed into mass production centers or shipping ports servicing hundreds of logistics players every day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/e60e4cdda20813392689e9bca664ac6b4eb272e2.png[/img]

Maintaining efficiency for Facilities will require the careful management of power grids, oil pipelines, and mining operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/925145a31837be11aa57c182be66fe21de91d81f.gif[/img]

Facilities can also be used to lay down new infrastructure in the world, upgrading their logistics operations with minecart systems, concrete foundations, docks, and sky scraping cranes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/5ac1cca8924c9dffb97e69b528ad7617bd53ea22.png[/img]

[h1]TRAINS[/h1]
After years of anticipation, Inferno finally brings Trains to the world of Foxhole. Players can design and build large scale railway systems, enabling supplies, vehicles, and other equipment to be hauled over long distances across the persistent world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/e4aa987a667b989236f4ca984c2bdb4d0142d237.png[/img]

Elaborate train networks can be assembled, complete with forks, switches, and elevated tracks for traversing difficult landscapes. Basic trains can consist of Locomotives, Coal Cars, and Freight for delivering supplies. Combat trains can include Infantry Transport for delivering reinforcements and Armoured Combat Cars for increased firepower at the front.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/c50f76f0bc11198cd3fbf99cd4537e926790f0c9.gif[/img]

With enough infrastructure in place, players can assemble and deploy a mobilized long range artillery on rails capable of wiping out enemy fortifications from a distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/608bd3968c16cf8c4007ee8530d14a0dcfaec28c.png[/img]

[h1]FIRE WEAPONS[/h1]
Flamethrowers, Flame Tanks, and incendiary rockets will be able to torch buildings, burn down fortifications, and incinerate enemy infantry. Fire can dynamically spread across towns and interact with other environmental elements like rain and snow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a390528a3bae3ef8be84b083326f56795834f448.png[/img]

[h1]ROCKET ARTILLERY[/h1]
Mounted on Truck, Half-Track, and Field Weapon chassis, such artillery will be capable of delivering rapid fire barrages over long distances at the expense of accuracy and reload time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/30ea911f3723cd0943b39949621884931814cdb2.gif[/img]

[h1]ADVANCED VEHICLE VARIANTS[/h1]
Armoured forces have been upgraded with new advanced tank variants, including the return of the fan favourite Battle Tank class.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/83d13acf88a90ecfb308e0a4053483a7cf0219e8.png[/img]

[h1]HEAVY TANK CLASSES[/h1]
Inferno introduces the Super Tank class. Requiring massive amounts of logistics effort to produce and deploy, Super Tanks represent the ultimate armoured threat on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/5ea29add3b1aa76d1520f05bacdafd5974d8703c.png[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There many other features, content, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-50-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

notes.title: It's finally time to try Foxhole, the tremendous war MMO hitting 1.0 tomorrow
notes.content: On my first night in Foxhole, I didn't fire a gun for hours. Instead, I wandered around a town until I ran into a fellow Colonial (my faction) and asked how I could be useful. He put me to work in the scrap fields, where I harvested bits of discarded metal that we'd then load into a big container, crane into the back of a truck, and deliver to the local refinery. Our scrap became basic materials (or "bmats") used to craft guns, ammo, vehicles, tools, clothes, explosives, sandbags—anything and everything that our actual (virtual) comrades a dozen miles away needed on the frontline... Read more.

notes.title: Update 49 - Quad RPG Tank, Dual 20mm Cruiser, Optimizations
notes.content:
[i]Update 49[/i] is a smaller maintenance update that focuses on low key improvements like optimization, bug fixes, balance, and other incremental changes. For a more information about this update and the state of development check out the latest [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/devblog-spring-update]Devblog[/url]. [i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks![/i]

[h1]New Tanks[/h1]
There are two new tanks coming to the late Tech Tree. They are based on the new tank chassis introduced in [i]Entrenched[/i] last fall.

[h2]Colonial Quad R.P.G. Tank[/h2]
This evolution of the “Bardiche” is fitted quad-mounted RPG launchers paired with a high-velocity 12.7mm cannon. The “Ranseur” indicates progress in Kraunian design as they continue to leverage outdated equipment to create deadly, modern armour.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/8a5b5725ceefca7f2cf44d92bb828a92dacf6dab.gif[/img]

[h3]86K-c “Ranseur”[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/01a86c8cc0ff03b833632a3bae24bb26c0c9af64.png[/img]

[h2]Warden Dual 20mm Cruiser Tank[/h2]
Colm Gallagher’s engineers designed a variation of the Outlaw that features an independently rotating MG turret sitting atop the main armament of twin anti-tank cannons. What it lacks in raw firepower compared to its older sibling, the Highwayman more than makes up for it with versatility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/61c6cdd1ffc37b8257407485af54f3eb7661d8a3.gif[/img]

[h3]Gallagher Highwayman Mk. III[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/396da858209f2fe475f9d3952fdecf09a65531a5.png[/img]

[h1]Vehicle Physics[/h1]
Many improvements and optimizations have been made to vehicle physics. This includes more accurate collision and suspension modelling and overall more stable movement when driving over trenches or rough terrain. There is still room for further improvements in the future, but the changes here should provide a noticeably better driving experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/948781d374f7ba14f0016aebe00d25d5fa32ce10.gif[/img]

[h1]Client Optimization[/h1]
Several optimizations have been made to the client, which should result in an overall smoother gameplay across the board. The most significant improvements have been made around loading in large Bunkers and interacting with large Squad lists. There should be less hitches and improved FPS in these two areas of the user experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/800764cd4af6760b48ed2f421f150a0e6f1e97ed.png[/img]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
There are plenty of other low key changes in this update, including:

[list]
[*] More flexibility around demolishing structures
[*] More flexibility around Squad permissions
[*] More text localized
[*] Game balance pass
[*] Lots of bug fixes
[/list]
[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
For a complete list of changes in this update, read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-49-release-notes]release notes[/url].

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://youtu.be/Mjk_QYJCBJU]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

[h1]I SAW A BEAR VIDEO[/h1]
For a detailed video walkthrough of this update, watch this video from community member I Saw A Bear:

[previewyoutube=FQfl99n_NcI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 48 - New Uniforms, Grenade Launchers, and Quality of Life
notes.content:
[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/d53ff8e5ac23d80e48c135d3abe0eb01ae5448fb.png[/img]

[h1]New Uniforms[/h1]

[h2]Velian Flak Vest[/h2]
A heavily reinforced vest designed to protect grenadiers from shrapnel back blasts. As such, the Flak Vest reduces cuts and scrapes on top of dampening bullet impacts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/e6a0b0b096a438a592cebf1bd435e2d8d6709d37.gif[/img]

[h2]Gunner’s Breastplate[/h2]
Repurposed from ancient wars, these armour plates are highly effective at stopping enemy small arms fire. That protection comes at the cost of weight, and the wearer will feel quite restricted and encumbered. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/ff4c2be6536ce2f28cc3c39a20677a081cb39690.gif[/img]

[h2]Officialis’ Attire[/h2]
This uniform can only be worn by officers of a Regiment. Allows the wearer to discipline their own Regiment members without friendly fire penalties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/415cc5e4867a4aca55156d2fc44056f72f2169ff.gif[/img]

[h2]Officer’s Regalia[/h2]
The Warden's version of the officer's uniform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/fe8c2337a469e2eab46878fa800809b8b8102914.gif[/img]

[h1]Grenade Launchers[/h1]

[h2]KLG901-2 Lunaire F[/h2]
A weapon designed to launch specialty grenades over long-distances.  This modern Kraunian firearm uses advanced propulsion designed for increased efficiency due to the overall weight of the weapon and projectiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/97aa3ec318e453174a61e8f2dd95ceb59cff26c5.gif[/img]

[h2]The Ospreay[/h2]
A rifle attachment that fires grenades with pneumatic force. Along with specialized grenades, it can launch standard grenades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/9d613adab565919a20c1fb54823d90cc3ef972e4.gif[/img]

[h1]Quailty of Life[/h1]
This update adds dozens of quality of life and other "low key" improvements. A few of them are listed below but there are many more.

[h2]Logistics Improvements[/h2]
Many improvements have been made to logistics, including the addition of new production queues, new map tooltips, stockpile changes, and more. For full rundown of logistics improvements, watch our latest devstream.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bQEVGWOd2ek
[h2]Crane Rotation[/h2]
Crane payloads can now be rotated using the 'A' and 'D' keys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/16fea27eeb6de477f37a950b744142d68bc0ee59.gif[/img]

[h2]Dynamic Wall Scaling[/h2]
Walls can now be dynamically scaled just like Sandbags and Trenches can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b3211d2eee5df848b23b5e7be2051dd67244c866.gif[/img]

[h2]New Heavy Weapons Animations[/h2]
Several visuals have been updated in the game, including the heavy weapon equip animation which feels much less sluggish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/92a524f41e2b2e113bfd7e721e906eebc29291ef.gif[/img]

[h2]Seat Selection Menu[/h2]
Players can now directly select which vehicle seat they want to enter by pressing Shift-Q. This menu also shows which existing seats are occupied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/859d6b5b0760246ccad300fc9fcf7de0a5dcd847.gif[/img]

[h2]Stockpile Retrieval Cancellation[/h2]
Players will no longer be "stuck" when retrieving from the stockpile since the action can now be cancelled by movement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/5428e749773482adf25950a90acb4c39896e857e.gif[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There many other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-48-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

notes.title: Logistics players in MMO wargame Foxhole 'go on strike'
notes.content: The wise general knows that wars are not won on the battlefield, but that supply and planning truly make the difference. The hyper-granular realism of counting every bullet and ration favored by old wargames usually doesn't find its way to videogames; it's typically much more fun to zoom around Mars at 60mph vaporizing cacodemons with both barrels than to try and keep your battalions well-stocked through a winter march... Read more.

notes.title: Update 47 - Field Bridges, Modular Half-Tracks, Tripod Weapons, and More!
notes.content:
[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f670974f71fc83b544ed714ffc2d93f0fe92d4e9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Field Bridges[/h1]
Combat Engineers can now use [i]Metal Beams[/i] to build [i]Field Bridges[/i]. [i]Field Bridges[/i] are used to allow infantry and logistics operations to cross difficult terrain. They can be built over water, destroyed bridges, small valleys, and other areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f6ff81a5bf7f80089c5cf8fa654b1e2b3f3a5a4b.gif[/img]

[i]Field Bridges[/i] are provisional and must be replaced over time. Armoured and other heavy vehicles are unable to cross [i]Field Bridges[/i] without them taking significant damage. The only exception are Armoured Car class vehicles, which can effectively cross bridges, giving them a unique role on the battlefield.

[h1]Modular Half-Tracks[/h1]
The base Half-Track has been redesigned into a modular vehicle. It now has a universal mount that can be refitted with any Tripod weapon, transforming the Half-Track's role while on the field.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/06a016e65c6b224be828ee9eed17f97d4e1d9c30.jpg[/img]

The new Half-Track rear has also been redesigned, giving it an additional role as an infantry carrier. It can now hold up to 4 passengers in the rear, in addition to the gunner and front seats on the vehicle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/77ca9908148ecd6fda2d4156ea6fceacbdf2018a.gif[/img]

[h1]New Tripod Weapons[/h1]
To compliment the new Modular Half-Tracks, four new Tripod weapons are being introduced, including new machine guns, a mounted AT Rifle, and a dual barreled RPG.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/19b290f0778cb09c86f54495fa39696b5d9781f4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Cinematic Camera[/h1]
In [i]Update 46[/i] the [i]Tactical Camera[/i] was introduced to Foxhole, giving players greater visibility on the battlefield. In this update, we're introducing the [i]Cinematic Camera[/i], which gives the players a cinematic view of the action, enabling them to create even better community content like screenshots and videos.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update47_cinematic2_small.gif[/img]

[h1]No Man's Land Improvements[/h1]
In Foxhole, the landscape can be dynamically altered over time if it's been shelled by artillery for long enough. Some improvements were made to the visuals and gameplay for these areas. Most significantly, the Trench husks have been completely redesigned to provide cover and with higher visual fidelity.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update47_nomansland_small.gif[/img]

[h1]O’Brien V.113 Gravekeeper[/h1]
A slight variation of the [i]V.110, the Gravekeeper[/i] comes fitted with an embedded Bonesaw launcher, transforming the humble armoured car into an effective indirect anti-armour vehicle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/9da3714b112c7a9c292e8b8ab69b8e2bef3b5eef.jpg[/img]

[h1]T8 “Gemini”[/h1]
Fitted with twin RPG launchers, the [i]T8[/i] employs hit-and-run assaults against enemy structures and emplacements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/957a710559b3e452fb2cb73cbce4c323072540d5.jpg[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There many other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-47-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/289f5b02b9162536d463a816cbf00dd56ceb6119.jpg[/img]

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://youtu.be/Mjk_QYJCBJU]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

notes.title: MMO war game Foxhole gets huge update with new content and 3,000-player wars
notes.content:
Five years and 46 updates later, massively multiplayer war game Foxholejust got its biggest update yet. Landing on the beaches tooday, the hefty Entrenched expansion brings the campaign map to its final form, making it 60% larger with an additional 14 hex areas. This will allow for a persistent battlespace that can handle up to 3,000 players fighting at the same time.

In Foxhole, players choose to enlist in one of two fictional factions that are fighting each other in a dynamic, persistent war. There are no classes, but there are a variety of skills, and you simply need to pick the tools and gear you want to fill the role you desire. If you want to be a frontline soldier, great, but you can also be a simple supply truck driver, a medic, or even a builder or combat engineer.

Builders are getting a lot of love with this new update, with new frontline fortifications you can use to quickly fortify a key point. Foxhole also has an extensive base-building component as well, and this is getting overhauled with new mechanics, tools, modifications, and customisation options.

Read the rest of the story...
