notes.title: Entrenched is LIVE
notes.content:
[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [/i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/][i]review[/i][/url][i] on Steam. Thanks.[/i]

[h1]ENTRENCHED[/h1]
[i]Entrenched[/i] is Foxhole's most expansive update of the year and includes a massive world expansion, player uniforms, a building overhaul, a new tactical camera, and much more!

[previewyoutube=jzVfHZImijk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]WORLD EXPANSION[/h1]
After years of development, the world of Foxhole has finally expanded to it’s fully realized scale and is now capable of supporting thousands of players in the same war at once. Fourteen new hexagon regions have been added, which will provide the space needed for larger scale wars, greater strategic depth, and a more dynamic frontline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/cda60ea37ff3913274fd2e70f5f3755036cc52fe.gif[/img]

[h2]NEW ENVIRONMENTS[/h2]
The persistent war will reach new battlefields taking place in fresh environments with never before seen towns, villages, and other points of interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/12532d70f5ab0eed4b2a791c4bbfd7635076303b.png[/img]

[h1]UNIFORMS[/h1]
[i]Entrenched[/i] brings another highly requested feature to Foxhole: Player Uniforms. Like all other aspects of the war in Foxhole, Uniforms are produced and supplied to the front line by logistics players.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update46_uniforms_w.gif[/img]

Uniforms will provide visual distinction to players on the battlefield and will provide one or more gameplay benefits, such special inventories, camouflage to circumvent enemy intelligence, or protection from harsh weather conditions

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update46_uniforms_c.gif[/img]

[h2]COLONIAL UNIFORMS[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/d209db8f44625dc10463a8946ec377d020a46925.png[/img]

[h2]WARDEN UNIFORMS[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/3c47577b26b4157ee00fd12eb82b538d731675f2.png[/img]

[h1]BUILDING[/h1]
[i]Entrenched[/i] includes a comprehensive building update, adding new content, features, and quality of life improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/12f1411818ca8dffecc95276ae2f0842d21424da.png[/img]

[h2]TRENCHES & BUNKER[/h2]
Trench mechanics have been updated with a variety of improvements, allowing Tanks to traverse over Trenches, Trenches to be filled in, and more. New tools, modifications, and customization options will enable builders to be more creative than ever before when designing their Bunker Bases and Trench networks in the future.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update46_driving.gif[/img]

[h2]POWER[/h2]
Engine Rooms in Bunkers can now be used to power lights on top of Bunkers, giving them greater visibility at night or Observation Bunkers, which provide even more intelligence coverage than existing Watchtowers do.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update46_power.gif[/img]

[h2]INTELLIGENCE CENTER[/h2]
Dedicated builders can now construct a new type of super weapon, the Intelligence Center, which can be deployed to intercept enemy transmissions, providing strategic data that can help your faction win the war.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/82e6ed8a8387ba07c850cc9063afb3fd606929a5.png[/img]

[h2]FRONTLINE BUILDING[/h2]
Builders can now utilize Sandbags, Barbed Wire spools, and Metal beams to build elaborate frontline fortifications. These new fortifications offer several key benefits over conventional structures in Foxhole, including the ability to dynamically scale, bend, and snap, as well as being able to be built in strategic locations like bridges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a96c8b6450260d9a13447ec46877b550884063f5.png[/img]

[h2]FOXHOLES[/h2]
Soldiers can now use their shovels to dig out small dug outs in the ground that can be used for basic cover against enemy artillery and gunfire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/193c527fcc628be4418543f2797acabb7b3f3d9d.png[/img]

[h2]PILLBOXES[/h2]
New stand alone garrisoned defenses are available, allowing even more flexibility when fortifying the front line. These include Rifle, Machine Gun, and AT Pillboxes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/da25ddcc87a88295f7de4c881c3974c8ed681d2b.png[/img]

[h1]NEW TANKS[/h1]
[i]Entrenched[/i] introduces new tank classes for each faction.

[h2]COLONIAL HEAVY LINE TANK[/h2]
Unlike the 85-series, the Bardiche sports a heavier, more durable build and is fitted with a coaxial heavy machinegun along with a powerful, short-barrelled 68mm turret. Modern Kraunian engineering allows for a fast reload, making it an ideal tool to combat enemy armour.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/265c31f1f07e1381021b00f29b367291feab54cc.png[/img]

[h2]WARDEN CRUISER TANK[/h2]
Originally designed in response to increasing swarms of Mesean armour, the Outlaw is an exceptionally capable medium tank armed with a long-range 40mm turret and includes a built-in storm rifle support position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f0d705855eed2c119967851e8276fa492a3e7a64.png[/img]

[h1]NEW RIFLES[/h1]
New rifle classes have been added for each faction, including new Long Rifles, Heavy Rifles, and Automatic Rifles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/4042b60dff7f3245abb57d0648f8d523bc29d628.png[/img]

[h1]TACTICAL CAMERA[/h1]
The in-game camera has been completely redeveloped from the ground up. The new camera removes the need to corner aim and provides better situational awareness, giving players the information they need to make better tactical decisions on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/45acee27c011c32d1273550b0c0d67f72f4797c8.png[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There many other features, content, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-46-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

notes.title: Update 45 - Infantry Support Tank, 250mm Assault Tank, Tank Combat Rework
notes.content:
[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/cd5af3fd3950fc31f600b8ab7472e5e52e8d1fb8.png[/img]

[h1]HC-2 “Scorpion”[/h1]
The “Scorpion” HC-class tank is a moderately armoured infantry support vehicle with twin, high-powered heavy machine guns and short-range radios for improved intelligence support.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update45_ist.gif[/img]

[i]This is the first tank in the game that supports hull seating. Infantry can sit on the tank's hull, using it for transport.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/4d32ebd6a611d94174e6cbf00a0e94555fbe4989.jpg[/img]

[h1]Silverhand Chieftan - Mk. VI[/h1]
The Chieftan assault tank is fitted with asymmetrical armaments, including a 250mm mortar cannon and a twin-barrelled 12.7mm turret.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update45_250mm.gif[/img]

[i]This is the heaviest vehicle in the game that is armed with a 250mm gun.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/ae055fd0d0d5d95406555e50fd11226fa463eeb4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Tank Combat & Balance[/h1]

notes.content:

A bombastic variant of the T12 Tankette, the “Ixion” provides its crew with more support and a mounted Infantry Support Gun. Added weight from the armour results in reduced overall speed.

[i]This is a closed top variant of the original Tankette that is equipped with a 30mm gun.[/i]

[h1]King Gallant MK-II[/h1]
A heavily armoured variant of the King Spire, the Gallant MK-II boasts a weighty 30mm cannon at the cost of top speed.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update44_scouttank.gif[/img]

[i]This variant is more durable than the original King Spire Scout Tank.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/d577841f5b7eac829911e7e087a3699f7b14274c.jpg[/img]

[h1]68-45 “Smelter” Heavy Field Gun[/h1]
Armed with heavy anti-tank rounds, the Smelter is perfect for engaging  enemy armour. The frontal blast shielding providers operators with ample  cover in heated skirmishes.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update44_hvfat.gif[/img]

[i]This field gun variant has a damage bonus and an extended range of 45m.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/249c2112e9afdba2cdbe02966b627a1c2cc07b78.jpg[/img]

[h1]Balfour Rampart 40mm[/h1]
The Rampart is a high-velocity, anti-armour field cannon capable of  dealing devastating damage to all but the heaviest armoured vehicles  while providing its crew with comprehensive ballistic shielding

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update44_hafc.gif[/img]

[i]This field gun variant has a damage bonus and an extended range of 45m.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/4ec818dd0c180af3688bb3264dea9dd32d39a563.png[/img]

[h1]Other Highlights[/h1]

notes.title: Update 43 - Heavy Tank Destroyer, New Weapons, New Explosives, and more!
notes.content:
[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/8bea98f1d38bc84b741c183f849cf5dc9bf6a998.jpg[/img]

[h1]Noble Widow MK. XIV[/h1]
This deadly tank turns predator into prey. A tank Destroyer, the Noble Widow specializes in ambush tactics, waiting for its quarry and striking with destructive high-velocity shells.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update43_tank1.gif[/img]

[i]This tank is equipped with a high velocity barrel that deals additional damage and has special armour that has an additional chance to deflect incoming shots.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/7999913b823ce6ba546bd373ed907504931174e9.jpg[/img]

[h1]85K-a “Spatha”[/h1]
The “Spatha” assault tank features a special high velocity 40mm gun turret that is not as well suited to mass-production as its more refined counterpart, the “Falchion.”

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update43_tank0.gif[/img]

[i]This tank is equipped with a high velocity barrel that deals additional damage.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f99f0a93abd121e453e49137bf907b79822bad81.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hydra’s Whisper[/h1]
This unique demolition tool is a long, metal tube packed with explosives. The Hydra’s Whisper is designed to destroy out-of-reach movement impairing structures and detonate any mines along the length of the tube.

[i]This weapon is capable of destroying obstacles like Barbed Wire, Tank Traps, and Anti-Tank Mines.[/i]

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update43_explosive.gif[/img]

[h1]BF5 White Ash Flask Grenade[/h1]
An explosive flask used for melting enemy armour. This carefully designed liquid bomb explodes into a dazzling flash of molten debris upon impact.

[i]This is an anti-tank grenade that has a high chance to track enemy armoured vehicles.[/i]

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update43_atgrenade.gif[/img]

[h1]“Lionclaw” mc.VIII[/h1]
A heavier, modern variation of the Pitch Gun, the Lionclaw performs well as a decent, all-around submachine gun designed as a primary firearm in urban and close-quarters combat operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/3570f79c793a63404ef8d0bb87fbfb762e55eea6.jpg[/img]

[h1]No.1 “The Liar” Submachine Gun[/h1]
This unique, heavy-duty submachine gun is not very useful on the run, but with careful aim and adequate cover, becomes a razor blade in the night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/3ecd9eee8468b9b983b141cfe6a3b05910071405.jpg[/img]

[h1]“Dusk” ce.III[/h1]
This unique assault rifle includes a high-capacity drum magazine designed for sustained Rapid fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/56b6dceeb687885ef62e1038f2d5064a5f7667d6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Booker Storm Rifle Model 838[/h1]
The Booker is a high-impact three-round burst Storm Rifle for those who like to shoot first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/59f712f8aa43c1412a0cf79fe47f2bc22a5df914.jpg[/img]

[h1]Squad & Regiment Map Posts[/h1]
Players can now create posts on the world map that are exclusive to their Squad or Regiment only. This will allow players to better coordinate operations in these smaller groups.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/275ed075402406b1b56f7cb1149ee4ecf24c74fe.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Winter Army is LIVE
notes.content:
[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [/i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/][i]review[/i][/url][i] on Steam. Thanks.[/i]

[h1]WINTER ARMY[/h1]
[i]Winter Army[/i] is Foxhole's big semi-annual update and includes a ton of game changing features like a new dynamic weather system, an overhauled artillery game, new weapon tech trees, a Regiments system, and much more!

[previewyoutube=cLnT8Phmccs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]DYNAMIC WEATHER EVENTS[/h1]
Winter Army introduces a fully dynamic weather system into the persistent war. Weather varies in intensity and can affect one or more regions at a time, turning lush landscapes into snowy wastelands or muddy battlefields.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update42_snow.gif[/img]

[h2]SNOW STORMS[/h2]
Armies must now be equipped to fight in snow storms. Taking shelter, building fire pits, and deploying the right equipment are key to surviving the harsh conditions of winter. Snow storms can also freeze rivers, lakes, and other bodies of water, opening up new supply lines or attack routes.
[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update42_snowstorm.gif[/img]

[h2]RAIN STORMS[/h2]
There are also Rain Storms, which will disrupt intelligence operations, limit artillery effectiveness, and cause other front line challenges that players must contend with.
[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update42_rainstorm.gif[/img]

[h1]ARTILLERY REVAMP[/h1]
Winter Army includes a sweeping revamp of artillery in Foxhole.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update42_artillery.gif[/img]

[h2]NEW ARTILLERY[/h2]
There are four new types of artillery being introduced, including both emplaced and field variants.

[h3]COLONIAL ARTILLERY[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f9fa790fa9bcdc37779698d67e4092ace18bd03d.jpg[/img]

[h3]WARDEN ARTILLERY[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/9253c5d6494a174ab12eb7a1e1d0dcc605b5b272.jpg[/img]

[h2]ARTILLERY BASES[/h2]
With deployable artillery and the existing modular bunker system, builders can now construct the artillery base of their dreams, complete with ammunition rooms for stockpiling hundreds of shells for bombardment.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update42_ammo.gif[/img]

[h1]NO MAN'S LAND[/h1]
To compliment the new artillery game is a feature called No Man’s Land, which allows players to unleash devastating artillery bombardments transforming the very landscape of the world.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update42_bombardment.gif[/img]

Bombardments can devastate grass, bushes, and even trees, turning a once beautiful landscape into a desolate no man’s land. Towns that have been under artillery fire over long periods of time eventually crumble into permanent ruins.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update42_nomansland.gif[/img]

[h1]NEW WEAPON TECH TREES[/h1]
Winter Army introduces dozens of new or redesigned weapons to the battlefield.

[h2]NEW SMALL ARMS[/h2]
There are many new small arms weapons, some with new features such as burst shot rifles and secondary slot Submachine Guns that can be fired from tank commander positions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/121a7951ec01f0c17a3f5b07261d73156583a49d.jpg[/img]

[h2]ANTI-TANK WEAPONS[/h2]
Since the [i]Arms Race[/i] update last year, many of new armoured vehicles have been introduced into the game. To counter such threats, many new AT weapons have been added to infantry arsenel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/dc9c4b7a8f79f939a8ba03b488b48eef2729fb48.jpg[/img]

[h2]TRIPOD WEAPONS[/h2]
Tripods allow for even heavier infantry weapons. Tripods require 2 player teams to deploy as the Tripod and Weapon must be carried separately. For the extra effort, Tripod weapons have superior range and damage over handheld variants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/5f775bf7c60e4c611e5434317fdf33bc550a5ca2.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW TANKS[/h1]
It wouldn't be a big Foxhole update without the introduction of new tank classes.

[h2]COLONIAL MASS PRODUCED TANK[/h2]
Designed for mass-production in Kraunia, this medium tank features a modular turret system for maximum versatility. The “Falchion” class features a powerful if understated, 40mm cannon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/bd9ecd9dbc149279f45d524ca43d1fd6b63bbdb4.jpg[/img]

[h2]WARDEN SCOUT TANK[/h2]
This small tank is recently recommissioned to the Warden arsenal. It boasts high maneuverability and an antenna that allows for long-range communications during high-stakes recon operations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f95044f91b386b9db5b3888e1dfbb1bacb6ce2cc.jpg[/img]

[h1]REGIMENT SYSTEM[/h1]
Regiments is a new organization tool that allow commanders to organize a permanent unit of players. This is the "clan" system that players have been waiting for. The Regiments system features support for tags, roles, dedicated chat channel, a real time view of regiment player status, and more.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update42_regiments.gif[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There many other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-42-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

[h1]I SAW A BEAR VIDEO[/h1]
For a detailed video walkthrough on all the changes in [i]Winter Army[/i], watch this video from community member I Saw A Bear:

[previewyoutube=1IUMN-RZXfE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 41 - Amphibious Vehicle, New Bridge types, Tank Combat Changes
notes.content:
[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/03ec92866722be32659bececd588495dd9bc7a0a.png[/img]

[h1]Drummond Loscann 55c[/h1]
This amphibious Light Utility Vehicle has been heavily modified to cross rivers and lakes with ease. Venturing out into the open sea is ill-advised, however.

[i]This vehicle is the perfect partisan tool, allowing enemy backlines behind bodies of water to be infiltrated and sabotaged.[/i]

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update41_ampluv.gif[/img]

[h1]Balfour Wolfhound 40mm[/h1]
This destructive short-ranged cannon is designed for direct engagement with enemy fortifications. The Wolfhound is fitted with reinforced shielding and a 40mm barrel.

[i]This field weapon will be useful for dismantling enemy structures during early periods of the war when heavy explosives are difficult to come by.[/i]

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update41_fieldcannon.gif[/img]

[h1]R-5b “Sisyphus” Hauler[/h1]
This variation of the standard R-5 Hauler is fitted with an improved suspension and axle system resulting in better overall handling. However, these improvements may not hold up under severe weather conditions.

[i]This unique truck variant can boost it's speeds for short bursts of time, making it the perfect blockade runner.[/i]

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update41_fasttruck.gif[/img]

[h1]UV-5c “Odyssey”[/h1]
This simple, modified Utility Vehicle is fitted with a reinforced hatch to provide one crew member with increased visibility for intense recon operations.

[i]This variant provides map intelligence and is heavily armoured, making it great for delivering emergency supplies to active front lines.[/i]

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update41_luvcommand.gif[/img]

[h1]New Bridges[/h1]
New drawbridge types have been added to the world. Each bridge has distinctive features, bringing more variation to prolonged bridge battles. In addition, several of these bridges now have two lanes which allow for traffic in both directions, which makes bridge crossing a smoother experience for supply line drivers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/acd79fc1f2e8679f213b01c4872999ffceff09f5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f4fc221f695b87fafee597914fc91c8ecb4ff051.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/9f2fe5a4deec22a3ff6bb9c669e60c56655b36cb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Carrying Wounded Players[/h1]
Live players that have been wounded on the battlefield can now be picked up and carried to a safe location. While a player is being carried, their death countdown timer will be paused, allowing them to be revived when they are brought to location behind friendly lines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b74f486684bdbb9cae7fb7e54abe410aa3dc109c.gif[/img]

[h1]Tank Combat[/h1]
Some new mechanics have been introduced to provide more tactical options during tank engagements. 
Shot angles and range now play factor in tank armour penetration, making speed and maneuverability more important than ever before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/3cdbde096c78159728d45707763cc049323db12d.gif[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-41-dev-branch-released-1]release notes[/url] for the details.

notes.title: Update 40 - Tank Destroyer, Field Mortar, & Suppression
notes.content:
[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/6e7842ceb35ada3ead633ec12113f62d74da290a.jpg[/img]

This update adds new faction vehicles, changes to structure suppression and damage, field weapon hiding, expanded win conditions, and more!

[h1]H-10 “Pelekys”[/h1]
The [i]“Pelekys” H-class[/i] light tank is heavily modified with an open top chassis and equipped with a devastating long-range anti-tank cannon.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update_40_atlt.gif[/img]

Armed with 68mm AT ammunition and with extended sight range from the open top design, the Pelekys is ideal for sniping enemy armour at a distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/239154b49e68a777b7a44000b9d93c202be896d5.png[/img]

[h1]Balfour Falconer 250mm[/h1]
A heavy mobile mortar platform fitted with a thick frontal shield for assaulting fortified locations.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update_40_fieldmortar.gif[/img]

Combined with the new ability to hide Field Weapons, this siege weapon can be used to knock down heavy structures under the cover of smoke or heavy foliage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b5a2cd94c8b903157b066b7e701851248d284287.png[/img]

[h1]Field/Emplaced Weapon Hiding[/h1]
Field Guns and Emplaced Weapons can now be hidden in foliage and smoke, giving them a new distinct advantage on the battlefield. They also now can be hidden behind obstacles in the environment like hills and town structures.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update_40_hiding.gif[/img]

[h1]Structure Suppression[/h1]
The suppression system on structures has been revamped. There is now a visual indicator when an AI structures has been suppressed, helping players coordinate more effectively.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update_40_suppress.gif[/img]

[h1]Expanded Win Condition[/h1]
The win conditions have been expanded to ensures that faction effort is rewarded throughout the war and not just at the end. There is still one victor in a war, there are varying degrees of success that can be earned through War Achievements, which are faction wide goals that can be completed by players. For example, making a "last stand" will result in a better outcome for a faction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/0f68b2c85e2186f4870ed494921babce48f25139.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
There are numerous other features and improvements in this Update including
[list]
[*] Server optimizations that bring the region capacity up to 200 players per region
[*] Border Bases - New base type to help a players gain a foothold in enemy locked down regions
[*] Comms Rating - A new communications system to help improve the quality of text chat\
[*] Open Top Vehicle mechanics - Gunners in open top vehicles now gain a buff to their sight range
[/list]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-40-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

notes.title: Update 39 - Dead Harvest Reckoning
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/d53f5b69f244233fb1be6f0f6d4f34f8f38c867b.jpg[/img]

[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks![/i]

It's that time of the year again! The annual Dead Harvest event is back. In this year's event, the Colonials and Wardens have weaponized the Cursed, allowing players to resurrect themselves as 1 of 3 undying soldier types from the underworld. In addition, each faction will be able to research powerful end game mechanized walkers to take on the Cursed.

Read on for details on all the content included in this limited seasonal event!

[h1]Font of Balor[/h1]
A stablized portal to the underworld. Present offerings to entrap deadly spirits into obsidian stones. [i]This structure produces Soulstones, which can be used to resurrect players into Cursed Soldiers.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/859ecb931bb0eb5ec9515f1e1cc299b3926afb4b.gif[/img]

[h2]Cursed[/h2]
The vengeful soul of a long dead soldier. Twisted by the underworld, these undying Cursed have unnatural strength and are overwhelming in large numbers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/8ac94bf9167fcb9c0c2ed20e88823813fbb5a071.gif[/img]

[h2]Avartach[/h2]
The damned spirit of an unholy blood drinker. The Avaratach is quick and can spit gobs of cursed ichor, draining the lifeforce from those unlucky enough to become submerged in the substance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f99505322aa56f098ae76ba6ec9d7495836b67c7.gif[/img]

[h2]Balor Spawn[/h2]
The sinister brood of a great demon king. The Balor Spawn taints the very ground on which it walks. It conjures cursed obsidian spires to impale mortal flesh and feast their very souls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/87b33735b7c2c590af9077d7e26133c95540bc48.gif[/img]

[h2]Centurion (Colonial)[/h2]
Designed for the sole purpose of fighting back the cursed undead, the “Centurion” Mechanized Utility Vehicle is equipped with two high powered, heavy machine guns and a deadly, front-facing cannon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/2d0fe5619d21010c051eb291291a309a130e1e37.gif[/img]

[h2]Scourge Hunter (Warden)[/h2]
Built in response to the ongoing use of the Cursed in military skirmishes, the Scourge Hunter class Quadruped Mechanized Walker is equipped with a quad-barrelled rocket launcher, accompanied by a specially designed quad-barrel machine gun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/4762ca9cc07a3a78753fafad349d14471ca43110.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 38 - Mortar Half-Track, New Bunker & Trench Tools

[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/335821bd4b887cad12b0295835bc07e8858b5e2c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mortar Half-Track[/h1]
The [i]HH-d “Peltast”[/i] is a new Colonial Half-Track Variant that has a 360 degree mounted Mortar. Similar to the hand held Mortar, it is capable of loading different shells including Standard, Smoke, and Flare rounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/940cab3f54db432b493c1d338c0757a9f0582a39.jpg[/img]

In addition, the Mortar Half-Track can exclusively a new special type of ammunition: [i]Mortar Armour Piercing Shells[/i]. With these shells, the Half-Track becomes upgraded into a late war, long range Anti-Tank platform, which is perfect for countering enemy armour.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update38_mortarht.gif[/img]

[h1]Base Building Tools[/h1]
A few new things have been added to base builders' toolbox. These should provide even more flexibility when building out Bunker and Trench networks.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update38_bunkercorner.gif[/img]

[h2]Bunker Corner[/h2]
The [i]Bunker Corner[/i] enables diagonal bunker walls to be built. This allows attached Bunker and Trench segments to be angled in new ways, making it easier to build around obstacles in the environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/6ca206510b476e23346b2b005e91721c59593f26.jpg[/img]

[h2]Trench Stairs[/h2]
This new modification allows soldiers to get in and out of Trenches without having to vault. Stairs are available on all 3 tiers of Trenches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/ebdcfe4bdbe04d161a56b390db810e56ac5359a4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Lots of Bug Fixes[/h1]
A lot of effort was spent in this update fixing bugs. We even managed to knock off some really old issues that have been stumping us for awhile. Below is just a subset of all bug fixed. See the release notes for the full list!

notes.title: Arms Race Update is LIVE
notes.content:
[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [/i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/][i]review[/i][/url][i] on Steam. Thanks.[/i]

[h1]ARMS RACE[/h1]
[i]Arms Race[/i] is Foxhole's big summer update and includes a ton of game changing features like an overhauled vehicle system, 24+ new modular variants, the siege and assault tank classes, seaports, a new technology system, and much more!

[previewyoutube=iwj1nTm6MZk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]NEW TANK CLASSES[/h1]
For the first time in almost two years, brand new tank classes are finally being added to the game. This time, they are unique to each of the two factions.

[h3]COLONIAL SIEGE TANK[/h3]
The HC-7 "Ballista" is a heavy tank designed to obliterate opposition defenses with its 250mm Hades Mortar Cannon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/0aa1bd84715402e7c4f81971c443411861b1ead9.jpg[/img]

[h3]WARDEN ASSAULT TANK[/h3]
The Silverhand Mk. IV assault tank is fitted with destructive dual-barrel armaments, and heavy frontal and rear armour. Its 68mm frontal cannon is paired with a lighter 40mm turret. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/dd0400169e433383d1028716e10562f37d174751.jpg[/img]

[h1]24+ NEW MODULAR VEHICLES[/h1]
A new modular vehicle system has been implemented, which enables dozens of new vehicle variants to be prototyped and mass produced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/eb8b83e9ec6017691aa212e633e37884febd02bc.jpg[/img]

Every vehicle type now has several faction specific variants, featuring different armaments, hull configurations, and other unique attributes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/17cb9c85859a9c4bf1c8f1e22b5ecae0066c5073.jpg[/img]

[h1]VEHICLES 2.0[/h1]
The vehicle system in Foxhole has been overhauled and now includes many new features, mechanics, and improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/0cf426c5c1287c7473502a31c63c302e6f26e571.jpg[/img]

[h3]NEW VEHICLE PHYSICS[/h3]
A new physics engine has been implemented from the ground up, which features a physically accurate driving model that allows for realistic handling, drifting mechanics, and more.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update37_physics.gif[/img]

[h3]ROAD REVAMP[/h3]
To complement the new physics, every road in the game has been reconstructed with new visuals and new surface types that can impact the speed and handling of your vehicle. The before and after screenshots of the roads can be seen below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/8493535a422cc0f3bdd28e4d0e7a07a8b36ec798.jpg[/img]

[h3]TANK ARMOUR[/h3]
Vehicles now includes a new armour plating system, which supports deflection and penetration mechanics, increasing the depth of tank combat in the game.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update37_deflect.gif[/img]

[h3]VEHICLE SUBSYSTEMS[/h3]
Furthermore, individual subsystems on vehicles can now be disabled. For example, a Tank’s fuel tank can be ruptured, resulting in fuel being rapidly depleted, or it’s track can be disabled, crippling it’s movement capability on the battlefield.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update37_subsystem.gif[/img]

[h1]SEAPORT[/h1]
The Seaport acts as a storage and shipping facility for water logistics operations over. Available at every major logistics hub at the coast, the Seaport can store almost any type of crate, vehicle, or mobile structure.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update37_seaport.gif[/img]

[h1]COASTAL GUNS[/h1]
Players can now build and reactivate old Coastal Guns at logistics towns near the sea. They will protect Seaports and shipping lanes against naval attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/91f7267b3bf2ef845842803cf06472fe2ac562b8.jpg[/img]

[h1]EMPLACEMENTS[/h1]
New manned weapon emplacements now can be produced and deployed at the front for additional defensive measures. These are manned weapons that can be deployed on the ground or inside new emplacement dugouts that connect to trenches for extra cover.

[h3]68mm Anti-Tank Cannon[/h3]
A defensive emplacement against heavily armoured vehicles.
[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update37_emplacement.gif[/img]

[h3]14.5 Anti Infantry Flak Gun[/h3]
An anti-aircraft flak cannon repurposed as a defensive emplacement against infantry.
[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update37_emplacedmg.gif[/img]

[h1]FIELD ANTI-TANK CANNON[/h1]
These 68mm Field AT guns are the ultimate support weapon for infantry going up against enemy armour. They are a low cost way of countering heavy vehicles at the front line.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update37_fieldat.gif[/img]

[h1]REACTIVE TECHNOLOGY SYSTEM[/h1]
Arms Race brings replaces the Tech Tech with a new system that is player directed and non-linear. Players will now choose what technology gets prioritized and can decide to research more advanced technology with a chance of failure. This will help make every war feel unique as the technology you will see on the battlefield will vary each time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b61e7ed36b61bdebc29f17ccee16efe47819493b.jpg[/img]

[h1]BASE UPGRADES[/h1]
A new Base Upgrade system replaces the old Facility and Efficiency systems. This new system does not require Upgrade Parts or any other grind, and allows base to be upgraded naturally based on existing player activities such as supply, combat, and structure building.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b316b405d917edab8d983c0eaa9a4e8e77564353.jpg[/img]

[h1]INDUSTRIAL DISTRICTS[/h1]
All the large towns in the game now have an industrial wing, include all new environmental assets. This includes 2 new Garrisoned building types, a brand new Safe House type, and many other small set pieces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a5a7fd964c485656e6d8ae0540f554fd7b8d7c36.jpg[/img]

[h1]OTHER NEW FEATURES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
Besides the features shown above, there are tons of other improvements, features, and tweaks packed into this update. Here's a few more highlights of what's new in Trench Warfare:
[list]
[*] [b]Reserve Stockpiles[/b] - A new flexible way to stage and organize equipment for operations or logistics efforts
[*] [b]Vehicle Tiers[/b] - In long running wars, more durable versions of vehicles can be researched
[*] [b]New Mining Experience[/b] - Mining has been updated with new animations and visuals, making resource gathering a more pleasant experience
[*] [b]Dynamic Fuel[/b] - Any vehicle can now use either Diesel or Petrol, giving more flexibility for fielding high end vehicles like tanks
[*] [b]World Map Revamp[/b] - Every region in the game has received some changes, specifically to better support water logistics operations
[/list]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=https://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-37-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

notes.title: The 7 best couriers in PC games
notes.content:
One Off The List is our weekly list feature. Is there something you think doesn’t deserve to be on this list? Comment with your reasons why, and next week it may be struck off.

Death Stranding

, the walking simulator about the sad Deliveroo man, is finally out on PC, allowing thousands of keyboard clackers to decode the complex metaphors embedded within such characters as “Mama”, a woman with a baby, and “Heartman”, a man with a pacemaker, played here by an aging and tired Danny Wallace. Look beyond the sub-textual nuance of such masterful creations, however, and you will find a half-decent delivery ‘em up. But is reliable postboy Sam Porter Bridges (a transporter who builds bridges) one of the 7 best couriers in PC games? You can find out by reading closely between the lines of this list.

notes.title: Update 36 - Bicycles, Deadlands, & Prototyping
notes.content:
[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/aaae0461840ebebba02380cbf8b0ce0ed66c1251.png[/img]

[h1]World Bicycles[/h1]
Bicycles can now be found on the streets of villages and towns. They can be used as a faster alternative to walking when travelling between towns.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/worldbicycles.gif[/img]

[h1]Return of Relics[/h1]
Relic Vehicles are back for a limited time and they are now producible via the new experimental prototype system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/8fb88df57b47fdec6231eac3421f5801fba8c1b3.jpg[/img]

In addition to Staff Cars, Repurposed Trucks, Armoured Fighting Tractors, and Storm Tanks. The Volta Repeater, the Relic Rifle from the Winter Update is also available.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/reliclighttank.gif[/img]

[h1]Prototypes[/h1]
Prototypes can now be created at the new Engineering Center using Research collected from the front and special advanced resources collected through mining operations. Prototypes allow Relic Vehicles to be produced, as well as vehicles and weapons [b]before[/b] they are unlocked in the Tech Tree. This is an experimental feature that is being tested in the upcoming war.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/5600e73f62b49f7ab0bec8b31ccf15a758d6cb1f.gif[/img]

[h1]Deadlands Revamp[/h1]
Foxhole's most pivotal region has received some big changes. First, Callahan's Gate, one of the oldest towns in the game, as been restored to it's prior glory. Second, Brine Glen has been relocated to the south east corner of the map, giving it renewed strategic importance. The rest of the region has been tweaked to support more flexible starting conditions in future wars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/024e0b4732f1b364e364b446050bd3ace3ddd92c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Spring Update is LIVE
notes.content:
[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/829d763b02db2ef5c2f4860f9fcf512b1211bced.jpg[/img]

[h1]MASS PRODUCTION FACTORY[/h1]
These massive Factories exist at the largest industrial towns in the world and are used to produce large batches of equipment cost efficiently. They are also able to produce large quantities of vehicles such as trucks and various tanks with less resources than usual.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update35_massproduction.gif[/img]

[h1]STATIONARY CRANES[/h1]
To help improve logistics workflows, Stationary Cranes can now be found in logistics towns and docks. These Cranes are larger version of the mobile crane, with further reach and a special Loading Area that's specifically designed for transferring equipment and resources directly into Shipping Containers from structures like Storage Depots and Refineries.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update35_stationarycrane.gif[/img]

[h1]VEHICLE LOGISTICS[/h1]
Thanks to the new Mass Production Factory, vehicles can now be produced in crates of 3. This not only allows logistics players to transport vehicles around the world more efficiently, but it also allows larger quantities of vehicles to be stored at depots for future operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/6033af3df7135c5d3339d6994bf9aca168bd8aea.jpg[/img]

[h1]BASE BUILDING TOOLS[/h1]
Over the last few updates, players have been able to build larger and more complex bases using the new Bunker and Trench system. Several tools have been introduced to help players maintain their bases more effectively. First, additional maintenance statistics has been added to base tooltips, making it easier to for players to supply their structures. Second, a new type of supply, Bunker Supplies has been added to help keep Bunker networks up and running when regular supplies are short.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update35_bases.gif[/img]

[h1]LOGISTICS CONTEXT MENU[/h1]
A new context menu is now available on all logistics structures that enables more flexible and granular workflows to be performed. For example, players can now submit to stockpiles from multiple inventory sources not just one. Exact quantities of supplies can be distributed into bases using a new slider interface. These are just two of many examples of these new workflows.

[img]https://clapfoot-image-host.s3.amazonaws.com/gifs/update35_contextmenu2.gif[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-35-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

notes.title: Update 34 - Trench Warfare Part 3
notes.content:
[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks![/i]

[h1]BUNKER BASES[/h1]
Bunker Bases is the big feature that we've been building towards since the introduction of Trench Warfare. It finally lets players build their own custom Forward Bases in the world in the form of fortified underground Bunkers. These Bunkers can be improved with Infrastructure to eventually become significant Strongholds in the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/9744090f82997f0cd5f87f8a4a4e062266af5b02.jpg[/img]

[h1]BUNKER INFRASTRUCTURE[/h1]
Infrastructure allows defensive lines to "tech up" over time, enabling new defenses and capabilities to be unlocked within the network. Players can increase the rate of Infrastructure growth by building Infrastructure modifications like Bunk Beds, Lockers, Desks, Maps, and more. These modifications also allow players to visually customize their Bases over time.

[h3]GARRISON INFRASTRUCTURE[/h3]
Garrison Infrastructure unlocks new types of AI structures over time, such as Howitzer or AT Gun Garrisons. The available Infrastructure modifications are: [i]Bunks, Lockers, Dish Wash Station, Latrine, Kitchen, and Pantry[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/516b11a808e6a6b81f919882c0013b43c7dae0f8.jpg[/img]

[h3]COMMAND INFRASTRUCTURE[/h3]
Command Infrastructure unlocks special capabilities and super weapons for Bunker Bases. For example, the Deployment Point Facility allows players to deploy direction to this base to quickly defend against enemy incursions. The available Infrastructure modifications are: 
[i]Workstation, Computer Module, Radio Station, Chalk Board, Strategic Map[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a52e6af26564ae3293ae46fe8e1185e5ebb8be1e.jpg[/img]

[h1]BUNKER RAMPS[/h1]
The Ramp is a new modular structure that allows players to build access points from the surface to underground Bunkers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/018b84eae1ad92dbe7ebdfa0b7a308d7ba657bda.gif[/img]

[h1]SQUAD STORAGE[/h1]
This is a new EXPERIMENTAL feature that we hope to expand on in coming updates. Squad Storage enables groups of players to securely stage Crates and Vehicles for logistics or combat operations. We hope this tool will add a sense progression and management to the logistics game that didn't previously exist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/0e2b9cc83326edafe89cdd76a959d3c935cf809f.gif[/img]

[h1]SIGN POSTS[/h1]
The Sign Post is a new sandbox tool that allows players to communicate to each other through physical signs built in the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/97c2db994f88d20c8a0f1e7dd6bfc166c29d7cc9.gif[/img]

[h1]REVAMPED BULWARK[/h1]
The Bulwark environment assets have been completely redesigned from the ground up. This complements the Weathered Expanse keep asset refresh from the recent previous update. Players can now climb up into the Bulwark itself and use it as a defensive position to fire on incoming invaders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/de6488aa8ea967813f11ec04db75b3aaf01416f9.jpg[/img]

[h1]REVAMPED LORE[/h1]
The interface for viewing Lore in the game has been redesigned to support features like extra visuals, improved formatting, and pagination. Much of the Lore in the game has been revised to support this new interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a5142c1a984095fa2d0cd5077f5aba1e062feb96.jpg[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-34-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

notes.title: Update 33 - Trench Warfare Part 2
notes.content:
[h1]A BRAND NEW YEAR[/h1]
Welcome to our first update of the year. Now that we're back in the swing of things, expect us to return to our monthly update schedule. In the next two updates (Trench Warfare Part 2 & 3), we will be wrapping up the work that began with Update 32. After that we will be moving on to focus on other parts of the game like logistics. You can see our near term roadmap below.

[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/66ee2149fa06eccdbf317da4a4b2cc417440512a.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW BUNKER STRUCTURES[/h1]
As we continue to expand on the Bunker/Trench system, we're adding two new Garrison structures (AI defenses).

[h3]HOWITZER GARRISON[/h3]
The Howitzer Garrison is the first AI based artillery in the game. However, it behaves differently from other defensive structures. While it has a very far detection range, it will only perform reaction fire to aggressors. It's designed to keep a Bunker safe from solo or small raiding parties attempting to attack with heavy ranged weapons like Mortars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b229015d9d62f6b3f5c7d7f8345d96ae0e594bee.jpg[/img]

[h3]MACHINE GUN GARRISON[/h3]
The MG Garrison is the Bunker equivalent of the Pillbox. It has a narrow field of view, but is capable of dishing out sustained rapid fire in a single direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/173a9525bb38894164ce926182feafe6e2a7f11e.jpg[/img]

[h1]TRENCH CONNECTOR[/h1]
The new Trench Connector structure allows for a lot more flexibility when building Trench lines. It can resize itself dynamically to connect two Trench / Bunkers, allowing more organic looking Trench networks to be built. Check out the results in the screenshot below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/1e375d8e75680a1a6b00a44740eef44edaa84957.jpg[/img]

[h1]ADVANCED RANGEFINDER FACILITY[/h1]
This new facility enables the Storm Cannon to fire across entire region borders in the world. It also extends the range of the artillery by 33%, allowing it to reach distant targets on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/ec7d39ef94eeb6226bced6a9b124c9f8efb25a0b.jpg[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-33-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [/i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/][i]review[/i][/url][i] on Steam. Thanks.[/i]

[h1]TRENCH WARFARE[/h1]
[i]Trench Warfare[/i] introduces a whole new base building game that lets you create intricate defensive lines of trenches, bunkers, and underground bases.

[previewyoutube=ZHGnNzgmOZs;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]MODULAR TRENCH SYSTEM[/b]
Combat Engineers have been given a new tool, the [b]Shovel[/b], which allows fully functional [b]trenches[/b] to be built in the world. Trenches are made up of individual segments that snap together to form larger trench networks. There is no limit so one can built a trench line across an entire region!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/596302f4889349a55ef0bdfba125d2662df81221.jpg[/img]

[b]CUSTOM BUNKERS[/b]
Players can now design their own underground [b]bunker[/b] networks that can be customized with different shapes, sizes, and upgrades. They can also be modified with [b]Doorways[/b] and [b]Firing Ports[/b]. Bunkers can also connect seamlessly to trenches, forming the ultimate fortification!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/d288519cd2f2b0dd2f5174cea81426e9fb2dc54c.jpg[/img]

[b]BASE MODIFICATIONS[/b]
Both Trenches and Bunkers can be customized further with [i]modifications[/i]. For example, Trenches can be modified with [b]Barbed Wire[/b] to slow down invading enemies, or [b]Bridges[/b] to allow vehicles to pass over from above. Bunkers may be upgraded with garrisons, such as this [b]Rifle emplacements[/b] and massive [b]Anti-Tank Guns[/b]. There's more modifications to discover and more to come in future updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a7d239ea92b59f91b339d4d37aabaa3dd6066a49.jpg[/img]

[b]WALL & SANDBAG CONSTRUCTION SET[/b]
Engineers also have access to a redesigned set of [b]Walls[/b], [b]Sandbag Walls[/b], and [b]Gates[/b]. There are three tiers of Walls and Gates, as well as straight and curved variants for Sandbags. All of these pieces are modular and can now snap to one another with ease.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/323e505f8f90d7c3eae8c48aaa7632a56ddb143b.jpg[/img]

[h1]STORM CANNON[/h1]
Trench Warfare introduces a new super weapon to Foxhole, the [b]Storm Cannon[/b]. The Storm Cannon is a heavy class artillery. Constructed from the foundations of large bunker bases, it can unleash devastating firepower on distant enemy targets. This weapon requires immense manpower to build and a firing crew to load [b]300mm shells[/b] into it's ammunition chamber.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/ec7d39ef94eeb6226bced6a9b124c9f8efb25a0b.jpg[/img]

[b]ENGINE ROOMS[/b]
This massive weapon must be powered by nearby engine rooms, connected with player assembled pipe networks. Engine rooms are also used to power other structures in the underground base, such as AT gun turrets and garrisoned emplacements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/7b383af8412269b49307522d0799e60a27660938.jpg[/img]

[h1]MEDICAL EXPANSION[/h1]
Trench Warfare expands on the role of the medic with new features, mechanics, and content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/426f33180927b10739f11c9d100ca52f73c1ecaf.jpg[/img]

[b]AMBULANCE[/b]
Medics now have their own dedicated vehicle, the [b]Ambulance[/b], which is used to transport medical equipment and to deliver incapacitated soldiers to hospitals in the back line.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/fc7547b41723962ccc9d94bf5cc7a02b82431d52.jpg[/img]

[b]HOSPITALS[/b]
Hospitals are where incapacitated soldiers recover, which results in more player spawns being available at the front line. There are two Hospital types, the [b]Field Hospital[/b], which can be built anywhere, and [b]Town Hospitals[/b] which exist in urban areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/66fd46adfbe9a2fba73d3656a88719c385a91d5f.jpg[/img]

[b]MEDIC EQUIPMENT[/b]
New equipment is now available for Medics. Blood Plasma is the resource now used to revive wounded players with Trauma Kits, while bandages are required to heal players using the First Aid Kit. All medic equipment is now visible on the actual player, allowing medics to be properly identified on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/2042c11c1f9d18871d23e844d02d0f235bb5367c.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW WEAPONS[/h1]
New weapons have been added. The [b]Light Machine Gun[/b] and [b]Machine Gun[/b] are now available, with the new [b]Heavy Deployable Machine Gun[/b] and [b]Infantry Support Gun[/b] arriving in January's update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/73b8690bfa1135999c06c5acfac54499e87ddff9.jpg[/img]

[h1]RELIC BASES[/h1]
Old Bunkers left behind from past wars are can now be found across the war torn world. They will act as world bases outside of towns, providing intelligence, garrisons, and equipment stockpiles. The structures themselves serve as fortified positions from where players can take cover and defend themselves against approaching enemy forces. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/06b024673afb2c89ae66bee36fb5f8e436877513.jpg[/img]

[h1]REDESIGNED HOME REGIONS[/h1]
The Colonial and Warden Home Regions have been redesigned from the ground up with new visuals and a new layout that supports more players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/9e83c485b3536f9ee1499a8dee75c261505f8479.jpg[/img]

[h1]20+ OTHER NEW FEATURES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
Besides the features shown above, there are tons of other improvements, features, and tweaks packed into this update. Here's a few more highlights of what's new in Trench Warfare:
[list]
[*] Portable Concrete Mixer structure has been added!
[*] All equipment is now visible on the player character model (Fuel cans, Satchel Charges, etc)
[*] Many weapon sound effects have been redesigned
[*] Squad user interface has received several quality of life improvements
[*] HUD now shows structure statistics, including the builder, health, etc
[*] Frame rate has been improved overall, but especially when playing near region borders
[*] Interior lighting of structures has been improved
[*] Wounded timer has been increased, but players are now given an option to give up early
[*] View range of all small arms weapons has been increased and unified
[/list]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-32-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

For a detailed video walkthrough on all the changes in [i]Trench Warfare[/i], watch this video from community member I Saw A Bear:

notes.title: Update 31 - Squads Revamp, Cover & Suppression
notes.content:
[h1]WINTER UPDATE IS COMING SOON[/h1]
Consider this update as the prelude to the big Winter Update that's coming in December. We've added some features here to test the waters for bigger things coming in the next update. To find out what's coming in the Winter Update, be sure to tune into our Devstream next Tuesday, November 19th on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/foxholegame]Twitch[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/ea55525b8caddf6ebef4e27ba0256c46cc31e477.jpg[/img]

[h1]SQUAD SYSTEM REVAMP[/h1]
The Squad system has received a major overhaul that includes many new features. There is now a dedicated UI for Squad Management which can be used to manage Squad members across any region. Squads can now be named, support voice chat, and Squad members are uniquely coloured on the HUD.

There is also a new Squad Leader functionality. Squad Leaders have a unique colour designation on the HUD and there is also a special marker on the compass that will always point to the leader if he/she is nearby.

For a full list of new Squad features, please read the [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-31-release-notes]release notes[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/80d5ae4323af4a881083ee75f6fb4118d1df9f7b.jpg[/img]

[h1]COVER & SUPPRESSION[/h1]
The new cover and suppression system is designed to make combat more tactical and encourage more teamwork in general, but specifically to make cover more valuable in the game in preparation for some new base building features coming in the Winter Update.

When a player is behind cover now, they will receive a chance to mitigate incoming gunfire and their aim will also steady much faster than if they were out in the open. Players can also be suppressed by nearby gunfire, which will negate the bonuses given by cover and will also make steadying aim slower for players that are out of cover.

A shield icon will appear on your HUD when you are cover and it will being to turn red when you are getting suppressed.

For more details on the cover and suppression system, please read the [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-31-release-notes]release notes[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/5a75f2074fee93734c92265578b00e476ebc1ce8.jpg[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-31-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

notes.title: Dead Harvest Halloween Update
notes.content:
If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url] on Steam. Thanks.

[h1]DEAD HARVEST IS BACK[/h1]
Foxhole's annual Halloween event is back and better than ever. This year's event includes some big changes including multiple Undead classes, Undead Bases, World Conquest metagame, and a Bipedal Mechanized Vehicle (aka Mech).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/0553075ac40869a9d8837b9937b663f05a272e5c.gif[/img]

To get started with event, please read our [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/post/what-is-dead-harvest]Dead Harvest[/url] guide. Remember that Dead Harvest is a fun sandbox event that is meant to be wild and unpredictable. Expect the unexpected.

[h1]WORLD CONQUEST[/h1]
Dead Harvest takes place in World Conquest this year. The Undead have returned and their objective is to corrupt as many Forts across the world. They act as a third faction in the war that can attack both the Colonials and the Wardens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/e9d83a7190b035195f9621b63b4aff5baaca85fb.gif[/img]


[b]CURSED FORTS[/b]
The Undead have bases this year in the form of Cursed Forts. Once a Fort is destroyed by the Undead, they can be used as spawn locations. If enough Forts become cursed, the Undead can bring forth the Endless Night, which prevents the living from winning the war.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/2c8e5deb4c795f6d41ee73e03d9813e3d532808a.jpg[/img]

[b]TOTEMS[/b]
The living can produce Totems at Factories to protect themselves from the Undead curse. Once equipped, the wearer will be immune from conversion in an Undead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/22612b34ec6a7d71807624e05dd9cd0c87735281.jpg[/img]

[b]WARDS[/b]
The living have setup ancient Wards at critical towns in the world, which protect the area with a large barrier. Any Undead that passes through the barrier is instantly killed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/916dd6718a9616dfde84c177e0cabd357a03745c.jpg[/img]

[h1]UNDEAD EVOLUTION[/h1]
The Undead can now evolve into 3 distinct classes. Each Undead class can level up through 10 tiers and can evolve once they reach max level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/83272a2536c48564e6e9ba45920d86338f90dba6.jpg[/img]

[b]CURSED[/b]
The Cursed are merciless undead creatures that grow in strength and number with each soul they consume.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/9425962ecf2dc5bed31fe94360e31f79afc4c57e.gif[/img]

[b]THE AVARTACH[/b]
Faster than other undead, it would be wise to fear the Avartach. If you blink you might miss the moment this horrid beast tears into your flesh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/1e697fc43e662c07335dcee7a77b45f54debe3ab.gif[/img]

[b]BALOR SPAWN[/b]
Evil incarnate, a single Balor Spawn has the ability to stop a tank in its tracks. Imagine what an army of them could do?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b21ea15f34dfcb957df244d480a0fc81d7a3d957.gif[/img]

[h1]CENTURION MECH[/h1]
The living have dug up an ancient weapon used to fend off the Undead: The Centurion. This bipedal mechanized vehicle is capable of shredding through hordes of Undead, cleansing the world of Caiva.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/34721103b1d08b3eedd072dcc5bbd91457c9f907.gif[/img]

The Centurion is equipped with 2 independent machine guns and a frontal gun turret. It requires a crew of 5 to operate: a driver, 2 MG operators, 1 gun turret operator, and a commander.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/4e35a6af8b81bec156b3a595739841a74d9c2c66.jpg[/img]

[h1]SHIPPING CONTAINER CUSTOMIZATION[/h1]
High level logistics players can now colour code their Shipping Containers for more organization. Choose from seven different colours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b84ec57d5da4181a1915ba1bf00ed34739f59d98.jpg[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-30-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

notes.title: Big Fall Update is LIVE
notes.content:
If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url] on Steam. Thanks.

[h1]FALL ROADMAP[/h1]
The Fall Update kicks off a new season of new features and content. Check out the schedule below to know what to expect over the next few months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/75bffbf407b586622451d9d2bcb7178320f40698.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW FIELD WEAPONS[/h1]
New faction variants for the Field Artillery and Field Machine Gun have finally been added. Check them out below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/09025711c374c094c018f0424efb85d9732e415c.png[/img]

[h1]REGION ZONES[/h1]
Each region in the world is now divided into zones that can be claimed by either faction. Zones will make the world feel denser and will add more points of interest for players to conquer. Region zone perimeters are shown on the map, visually denoting the front line and all the territory owned by each faction into the world map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/39f6f03d16b05c0103f2a0987af3c03a17a7ab9c.png[/img]

[h1]TROOP BUS[/h1]
By popular demand, we've brought back the bus, but this time each faction has it's own variant. Buses are useful for shuttling players to the front as quickly as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/c37121fa72c164a82755aa684ecaee2059575c2c.png[/img]

[h1]ARTILLERY AMMO TYPES[/h1]
Six new diverse ammo types have been added. Mortars have Shrapnel and Flare Shells, Howtizers now have Smoke and Green Ash (Poison Gas) shells, Field Artillery has Armour Piercing and High Explosive Shells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/c8d827b8a6cb280dde538541a8429e781f633002.png[/img]

[b]GREEN ASH SHELLS[/b]
Chemical Warfare is making a comeback with Green Ash Shells. These enable a Howitzer crew to pelt a large area with poisonous fumes, killing anyone not equipped with a Gas Mask.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/f7af4b24f09efb1692931d844535ce91ca5446d1.gif[/img]

[b]MORTAR FLARE SHELLS[/b]
Flare shells can be used to light up the battlefield after nightfall. They also reveal targets for defensive structures to fire at night.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/94157fc261cbf4acc1d3b2a82307e2f2510ffdda.gif[/img]

[b]HOWITZER SMOKE SHELLS[/b]
Smoke Shells are used to provide cover for infantry during town assaults. They also cause Shrapnel damage any infantry caught in the blast.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b9ac4afcf01f307df6d93bcc81c6d2695f4e1c1f.gif[/img]

[h1]DEPLOYMENT SYSTEM[/h1]
The entire spawn system has been reworked such that there's far less walking required to get to the front on average. It's also been designed around the idea of strategic movement of troop: Players can only spawn where other players have moved to in the world. The confusing and often unfair star base system that allows players to infinitely respawn without supplies has finally been removed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/8b809652cc99938d906b6e99c667cfa9aa49fdc0.png[/img]

[h1]ECONOMY REWORK[/h1]
The economy has been changed to have much less of a grind for vehicles like Tanks and for more choice in play style. Production Parts have been removed so vehicles can be produced individually again. All heavy weapons like Mortars, Howitzers, and Tanks now have ammo types that can be produced without needing rare resources so these weapons can be used in any scenario. It's more viable now to play in short sessions, long sessions, solo, or grouped up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/b60a8c784cdcfa6ce1c71d35e9df91141cd5bad7.png[/img]

[h1]RESTRUCTURED LOGISTICS TOWNS[/h1]
The major logistics hub towns in the world have been redesigned for improved logistics workflow. Dedicated shipping "lots" have been added to each industrial area and roads layouts have been redone for less congested traffic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/ad61c2b082670401946bcc7b18e27a1c5e3bf3ba.jpg[/img]

[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE[/h1]
Several important quality of life changes have been made in the UI:
[list]
[*] Item Crate icons now have a subicon identifying the contents within
[*] Hovering over an Item Crate will now show you the quantity of items contained within
[*] The title on top of the stockpile panel shows you the total number of items as well as the  capacity
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/a4a1da4d639b80b9a441a2646fbb11cae43e8781.png[/img]

[h1]HOME REGION TUTORIALS[/h1]
The tutorials in the Home Regions have been refreshed, providing a better experience for new players. There are clearer directions to the various training locations and more tools have been added for veteran Foxhole players to train new recruits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25880686/7e7cb64099fe35fce2b48a49b83b8c208068041b.png[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-29-pre-release-notes]release notes[/url] for the details.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

For a detailed video walkthrough on all the changes in Update 29, watch this video from community member I Saw A Bear:

[previewyoutube=L_pLy0hlgYk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 28 - The Harvester is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/25c37af0a678015193106168153ff497f27de6f0.jpg[/img]

[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a review on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]Steam[/url]. Thanks[/i].

[h1]HARVESTER[/h1]
After several years of waiting (no joke), the Harvester has finally arrived! The Harvester is a high end logistics vehicle that can be used in mining operations to gather resources more effectively. It can also be used to cleanup battlefields after a conflict has taken place.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/b4592734f88cae1cc9e29a99fd82378eee1f7fa9.jpg[/img]

[b]HARVESTER FUNCTIONS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Mining[/b] - Hold LMB to gather resources
[*] [b]Dismantle[/b] - Hold LMB to dismantle AT Mines, Barbed Wire, and other defensive structures
[*] [b]Break[/b] - Hold RMB to split resources into multiple nodes so they can be gathered more efficiently by a mining team
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/3b4cfa5f924d68aadaad0adfb502a3366d0c6427.jpg[/img]

[h1]SPECTATOR CAMERA[/h1]
A proper spectator camera has been added to the game. No longer will you be staring at a blank screen while you wait to spawn after death. You will now be able to spectate other players (with some restrictions of course to prevent exploits). In addition, you will now also be able to use text chat and access the world map while you wait to spawn.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/c6ffa8eb7c8f4ddc413ee841d0b8fc838f17f86b.jpg[/img]

[h1]GODSCROFT & TEMPEST ISLAND REVAMPS[/h1]
The island maps on the east side of the world have received some design changes so that they work better with the new hex world.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/f5d866566bc26546f9ea288922a541c2f8958855.jpg[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full release notes for the details: http://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-28-release-notes

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NfExAJxHVOc

notes.title: Update 27 - Resource Containers, Operation Stockpiles, and Map Posts
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/5c105affe84852c06b25ec61fbbb4e97ade33d19.jpg[/img]

[h1]RESOURCE CONTAINERS[/h1]
This is a large dumpster used to ship large quantities of raw resources. You can visually see the resources pile up in the container as it is filled, without needing to open up the UI. Resource Containers can be submitted directly to a Refinery, where their contained resources can be processed.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/8cda9e134b75b52eccaa7b36a11f6e3bb7b6ea79.jpg[/img]

[h1]OPERATION STOCKPILES[/h1]
This structure is used to securely store weapons and vehicles for an operation in the future. Once an operation start time and description are defined, equipment can only be submitted but not removed from the stockpile. We hope this will not only allow dedicated groups of players to prepare more effectively for long term operations, but will also allow other random players to contribute and participate.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/69da620b7de214832652e17de68b9125347d1a8d.jpg[/img]

[h1]MAP POSTS[/h1]
We are introducing a new map tool for posting shared persistent messages on the world map. Posts can be used to communicate a variety of information including reports of enemy positions and requests for supplies at a base. Other players can reply to a post to respond to a request for example. Map Posts can also be upvoted/downvoted so only the most relevant posts are surfaced to other players.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/845c449bdaadce3e0f2f3561185557744e63a1c2.jpg[/img]

[h1]GAME BALANCE[/h1]
We've also made a number of game balance changes to help address some of the feedback we've received. While there are more changes that are being considered for future updates, for now you can expect the rare resource cost to be decreased for several key weapons and vehicles. Here is a [b]sample[/b] of the changes:
[list]
[*] Armoured Cars now consume Diesel instead of Petrol
[*] Howitzer Shell HE Material cost reduced by 50%
[*] Light Tank Production Part cost reduced by 30%
[*] Light Tank Ammo rare resource costs reduced by 40%
[/list]
Please refer to the release notes for additional changes.

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full release notes for the details: http://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-27-release-notes

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

[h1]I SAW A BEAR VIDEO[/h1]
