notes.title: Update 26 - War Machine is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/5dd612efd74ebe1c20d39872333bb2655cb0cd28.jpg[/img]

Foxhole’s big summer update is live and includes a reimagining of World Conquest mode and a comprehensive overhaul of the logistics game. This is the most expansive update we’ve developed yet. To get a sense of what the sheer scale of the persistent war now, head over to this community made interactive [url=https://foxhole-interactive-map.glitch.me/]world map tool[/url].

https://youtu.be/9VHjj7M-V4k

[h1]LOGISTICS REVAMP[/h1]
Logistics have been reimagined to be more immersive, more cooperative, and to have far more depth than before. We've given players an entirely new toolset for organizing their production chains and supply lines.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/f35c802e9388dce0ec71a7be6a652d375d4c25bd.jpg[/img]

[b]CRANE[/b]
The Crane is used to lift vehicles and heavy equipment, making it an advanced logistics support vehicle. It has a variety of applications, like loading a Field Artillery onto a Flatbed Truck or stacking Shipping Containers on top of each other.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/7f726ab33ab3c6cd410fe5da26151deb48d0641b.jpg[/img]

[b]FLATBED TRUCK[/b]
The Flatbed Truck is used to transport light vehicles and heavy equipment like Production Parts. With the Flatbed Truck, players will finally be able to mobilize Field Artillery to set up firing positions at remote locations that were previously too far to reach.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/6c358e2d376bf9b8d26b70148e23dacb72211709.jpg[/img]

[b]FREIGHTER[/b]
The Freighter is the ultimate vessel for transporting massive amounts of equipment over long distances. It's capable of storing over 200 crates of supplies or up to five heavy vehicles like Battle Tanks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/36b9d7aa88c55decd99499e15957188be133a62f.jpg[/img]

[b]LOADING DOCK[/b]
With the introduction of the Crane and Freighter, we needed to give players a larger area to organize their water logistics. To that end, we added Loading Docks, large areas where players can load their vehicles and equipment onto Freighters, Landing Ships, and Barges. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/e40460161a3701877e4797b47ec3bd720b201c16.jpg[/img]

[b]FUEL TANKER[/b]
The fueling system has been completely overhauled to be more immersive and realistic. All vehicles now have a dedicated fuel tank, which require more effort to refuel. To help optimize the fueling process, we have added a new vehicle, the Fuel Tanker which can be attached to vehicles, ships, and structures for automatic fueling. Fuel Tankers are also capable of moving tons across a supply line.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/383266c5e360b025b381f3133cb6fb9be8f54048.jpg[/img]

[b]OIL WELL[/b]
The new fueling system includes a new type of fuel called Petrol, which is used to drive high end vehicles like tanks. The only way to obtain Petrol is by extracting it from Oil Wells and processing it at a Refinery.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/859f2fa4e119cb77a0dc2901667bd55d78cc5b65.jpg[/img]

[b]SHIPPING CONTAINER[/b]
Shipping Containers can now be built to store and transport stockpiles of equipment over long distances. They must be loaded onto a Flatbed Truck or Freighter before transport. Shipping Containers can also be stacked for players that are obsessed with organization.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/972ca5efc8270bf2d6a7e09a9fc42d9a7fe8670a.jpg[/img]

[b]CONSTRUCTION YARD[/b]
This new structure enables the production of an entirely new class of equipment in Foxhole: Shippable Equipment. These are large pieces of equipment that have various uses, such as a Shipping Container or a large crate of Production Parts.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/d0337976027f0bb79745a31c9f136373f01674ff.jpg[/img]

[b]PRODUCTION PARTS[/b]
We’ve gotten rid of the old Blueprint system, which was previously used for producing high end vehicles and relied on timer mechanics. Instead, players now build physical Production Parts at a Construction Yard, which must be transported to Vehicle Factories for mass assembly.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/4f128d72b22b63b984fb35e6d14ab76bd2a0c987.jpg[/img]

[b]RESOURCE MINES[/b]
Resource Mine mechanics have been revamped. They are now communal structures that behave more realistically. As long as they are kept fuel, they will continually produce raw resources. They take two types of fuel: Diesel and Petrol. Diesel produces a baseline amount of resources per cycle while Petrol produces a higher yield.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/3edf5d6c8e6c311fdfbf5407fec5ac664a92dfc0.jpg[/img]

[h1]WORLD CONQUEST 2.0[/h1]
The persistent war has been completely redesigned to be more expansive, cohesive, and player driven than ever before. We've removed the Port Bases, which means no safe zones or predetermined battle lines. The front line is now truly dynamic and can be oriented in any direction.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/7bd51f3c2ba0c6853530d954bb0a5185dffdc6b6.jpg[/img]

[b]HEXAGON REGIONS[/b]
The world is now one unique, designed land, accurately split into 23 hexagon shaped regions. Because the regions are now hexagon shaped, the front line is fully dynamic and can go in all directions depending on how armies choose to position their forces.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/906b4b8d83f1f45152568aca7fe1e6b07cb18e9a.jpg[/img]

We’ve also revamped the border travel system and the way that regions are connected. Neighbouring regions are now streamed in, allowing players to see the actual landscape on the other side of a border before travelling.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/d47432a6d5644ea371136bec6cc5278c9bf7d976.jpg[/img]

[b]EXPANDED WORLD[/b]
The world has been significantly expanded and there are many new interesting locations for you to explore like The Linn of Mercy, an intimidating whitewater river that flows between icy northern falls and abandoned forest villages, The Drowned Vale, a vast wetland home to murky waters and twisting wooden pathways, and The Viper Pit, a mountainous region where an ancient garrison once stood strong.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/144c9c794654fad74c37fb2cf01b010e46d0b9d0.jpg[/img]

[b]NEW GARRISONED HOUSES[/b]
With the introduction of the new village themed buildings, we’ve added 6 entirely new Garrisoned House types like this Pub building below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/2c64474fedf937fb3e1b3ac515e8eb26dd5524a5.jpg[/img]

[b]PROCEDURAL RESOURCE LOCATIONS[/b]
Resources are no longer in fixed positions. At the beginning of each war, the location of all resources are shuffled, creating a unique starting condition every time. In addition, rare resources are now only located in certain regions, making them strategic objectives on the world map.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/0ff720b652d5f3574390f9e14a095c0ab98da205.jpg[/img]

[h1]UNIFIED MAP SCREEN[/h1]
The regional and global map screens have been combined into one unified view that lets you observe the entire persistent war at once “Google Maps” style. Global intelligence from remote regions is now visible, enabling you to keep track of friendly and enemy troop movements from anywhere in the world in real-time so long as you have a radio equipped.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/548412b15b8a9a2192863f02a9c9d8182ef7ce9c.jpg[/img]

[h1]GARRISONED HOUSE UPGRADES[/h1]
All garrisoned buildings in a town can be upgraded by up to 3 tiers now. Each successive tier has additional armour and the highest tier activates anti-tank defenses.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/80b15a8edb34733113f6fc0f6aae3b6c78c2183f.jpg[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
In addition to the highlight features above, we've made numerous other changes in this sweeping update. Read the full release notes for the details: http://www.foxholegame.com/post/update-26-release-notes

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

[h1]I SAW A BEAR UPDATE VIDEO[/h1]
For a video walkthrough of all the changes in Update 26, check out community veteran [i]I Saw A Bear's[/i] video.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K2zLwQ2-ljA

notes.title: Update 25 - Staff Car, Supply Caches, and More!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/d361e2cf6eadb6dd371817571ec68b458b796d2f.jpg[/img]

[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a review on Steam.

The next World Conquest begins at 11AM EDT on Thursday, April 25th.[/i]

[h1]STAFF CAR[/h1]
The last update for Relic of War brings us our final relic vehicle. The Staff Car is used by officers to reach the front line quickly and to deliver emergency supplies. The fastest vehicle in the game with storage has a boost feature (same as the Motorcycle) that allows it to move even faster at the expense of additional fuel consumption.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/2cfd0528b3b580dc2cd5ef09f2cb2459df60c316.jpg[/img]

[h1]SUPPLY CACHE[/h1]
This structure is an underground storage bunker used to preserve items for future conflicts. The Supply Cache is going to be the first structure that will persist between wars. It will store up to 15 crates (of select items) that can be retrieved at the start of the next war. Supply Caches can only be built during the resistance phase and requires special resources called [i]Strong Materials[/i], which are rewarded for claiming towns during this phase.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/6b9af5d3d5c9dc6cb09885e465b94c57dcda7049.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW LOGIN EXPERIENCE[/h1]
The main menu has been redesigned to provide a login experience that is more relevant for present day Foxhole. Changes include a new faction select screen that no longer gets shown after you've committed to a faction and a brand new lobby screen that provides some context of the war before you join it. Right now, the lobby screen shows war stats and profile information, but in the future we want to show players how the war has progressed since they last logged in.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/051d8962cb01e49d544059864422682eee815e98.jpg[/img]

[h1]EXPERIMENTAL WIN CONDITION[/h1]
We are continuing to experiment with the Win Condition. Our goal is to make the win condition achievable at various points in the war, not only when the tech tree is nearly exhausted. To that end, facility costs for Town Halls have been reduced by up to 95% in some cases so it should now be much more viable to claim victory towns in the early to mid stages of a war.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/7848267c4b5ab28b6794e3d300525285ede243dd.jpg[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full release notes for the details: http://www.foxholegame.com/blog-1/update-25-release-notes

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

[h1]I SAW A BEAR UPDATE VIDEO[/h1]
For a video walkthrough of all the changes in Update 24, check out community veteran [i]I Saw A Bear's[/i] video.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0fGi21PcIO4

notes.title: Update 24 - Transport Bus, Gas Mask Filters, Game Balance
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/472459f648db5b359127f9d309c156d21e4aada5.jpg[/img]

[i]If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a review on Steam.[/i]

[h1]TRANSPORT BUS[/h1]
This Relic Vehicle is used to shuttle troops to the front line. It can carry up to 12 players at a time, making it the highest capacity vehicle in the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/84e0309cfda8f304f1c4a71083c6bc5067f6aa87.jpg[/img]

[h1]GAS MASK FILTERS[/h1]
When attached to a Gas Mask, this filter provides fresh air to the wearer. Gas Masks now require Filters to absorb Green Ash damage. Filters get consumed when players are standing in a gas cloud. The days of being completely invincible against a gas attack are over! Remember that gas is effective against vehicle passengers so infantry now have another weapon to fight against end game tanks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/ccda01e7c73848164c3dd394bdce38a70be14e0d.jpg[/img]

[h1]RETURN OF AT MINES[/h1]
After a long absence, AT Mines are now back except with some key gameplay changes. Mines are now visible by friendly players, players on foot, and when placed on roads. However, enemy vehicles will not be able to see them, forcing tank columns to rely more heavily on infantry support in their attacks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/77d7d3ecc53ac5aa0eb91040eb7269f87d01b098.jpg[/img]

[h1]BIG GAME BALANCE PASS[/h1]
After collecting feedback from the community, we've made a really big pass on game balance. The changes were focused on buffing defensive structures and other underutilized weapons and vehicles. In addition, the Sunken Pillbox has been repurposed as the AT Pillbox since it now fires anti-tank rifle shots. For the full list of balance changes, see the [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/blog-1/update-24-release-notes]release notes[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/b087dc5195ae436befe742ca1b8583d2e701a206.jpg[/img]

[h1]ADDITIONAL HIGHLIGHTS[/h1]
In addition to the highlight features above, we've made many other improvements and tweaks:
[list]
[*] Stockpile sorting can now be toggled
[*] Various visual improvements in environment assets
[*] RPG aim indicator has been improved
[/list]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full release notes for the details: http://www.foxholegame.com/blog-1/update-24-release-notes

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

For a video walkthrough of all the changes in Update 24, check out community veteran [i]I Saw A Bear's[/i] video.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gtUszewOe8I

notes.title: Have You Played Foxhole?
notes.content:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

Look lively soldier, the country is at war. There are grey-uniformed murderer-men spilling over our barbed wire. Enemy motorcycles zooming around our roads, uncontested. They re killing your comrades soldier, are you just going to stand there and take it? Good! Glad to see that iron resolve flaring up, glad to see y JESUS CHRIST put that rifle down. No, no. That s not what I meant. No. We need truck drivers. You re a truck driver, Brian. That s how you help the war effort. What, you think these giant steel bars are going to deliver themselves?

Foxhole is a game about being a bullet delivery boy.

(more…)

notes.title: Update 23 - Relics of War is LIVE! 40% OFF SALE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/c242fad1b8f6f37676e29c4a01f302193ed8bbed.jpg[/img]

[i]Update 23 brings lots of new content, a more unified persistent world, and a more continuous experience between wars. If you are enjoying these updates please take the time to leave a review on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]Steam[/url]. Also remember that Foxhole is currently 40% off![/i]

[h1]RELIC VEHICLES[/h1]
Relic vehicles are unique vehicles left over from the Great Wars of the past that can be restored and used in the current war. The primary way to get Relic Vehicles is to find them in the world and excavate them. Keep in mind that these vehicles are really rare so don't expect to use them regularly.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/77c0e0d5b7d4f3de1588243d399117e9d7adf2b9.jpg[/img]

Relic Vehicles can also be obtained by finding Blueprints. There is a random chance to find a Relic Vehicle Blueprint when gathering Components. There are 3 Relic Vehicles in Update 23 with more coming in Update 24 & 25. The set of Relic Vehicles available will rotate in each war.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/353c0eed192f59edcdd51b01008e5afa70a194da.jpg[/img]

[b]ARMOURED FIGHTING TRACTOR[/b]
A Colonial tracked vehicle from the old era used for escorting infantry and larger armoured vehicles at the front. This vehicle acts as an early war light tank and a late war tank column escort. It can absorb a ton of damage and has a 100 round clip.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/fa2e2a2f053e33f537191719513aeaaf219b3b25.png[/img]

[b]STORM TANK[/b]
An armoured mechanized vehicle from the Great Wars that was commonly used in wide line formations to overwhelm enemy forces. This vehicle is effective in wide Phalanx like formations. It's forward armor plating is extremely durable and it can move quickly in reverse.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/0533f6c58915f9dbcf90d743ec78cb8afb1e9122.png[/img]

[b]REPURPOSED TRUCK[/b]
An old agricultural truck that has been repurposed for military use. This old supply line runner can carry up to 25 items, but is slightly slower and more frail than normal Trucks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/c5607deabb62fabea4094b60ef8fba2f7da9af5c.png[/img]

[h1]A FULLY CONNECTED WORLD[/h1]
Reaching Trail and Great March have been merged into the mainland, creating a larger and more dynamic World Conquest map. Every region in the world of Foxhole is now connected, which means that you can traverse from any point in any region to any other point in any other region.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/1d515403739f3215eac6564217a1362632ca09ad.jpg[/img]

[b]REACHING TRAIL & GREAT MARCH[/b]
Design changes have been made to these two maps to connect them to the mainland. In the north, Reaching Trail now has travel connections to Mooring County, Callahan's Passage, and Weathered Expanse and in the south, Great March now connects to Westgate, Heartlands, and Umbral Wildwood.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/85396b20f21a7ef8ecb04f86ddbbc98fa08f11b9.jpg[/img]

[h1]RESISTANCE PHASE[/h1]
The Resistance Phase is a new phase of the conflict that closes the loop between wars. When World Conquest ends, instead of switching to Skirmish Mode (which is now gone), the conflict continues in the same persistent world. In the Resistance Phase, the side that lost World Conquest will convert to the [i]Resistance Faction[/i].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/f7957b6599a7e818f9f31ad79b7a8f94153f1299.jpg[/img]

When the Resistance Phase starts, several things will happen. First, the Resistance faction will gain access to a new structure called the Resistance Camp, which is essentially a mini-FOB that can be built without a Construction Vehicle. Second, for a short duration after the Resistance Phase starts, Uprisings will occur at random towns in the world, which results in the Town Hall and Garrisoned Houses being flipped to the Resistance faction (defenses will be disabled as well). Finally, the Tech Tree will slowly decline, resulting in vehicles, structures, and weapons becoming Lost Technology. Keep in mind that Resistance Phase is VERY EXPERIMENTAL and BARE BONES at this point. We hope to expand on it in the future. For details on the motivations behind Resistance Phase and on where it's heading, read the latest [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/blog-1/devblog-62]Devblog[/url].

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full release notes for the details: http://www.foxholegame.com/blog-1/update-23-release-notes.

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

For a detailed video walkthrough on all the changes in Update 23, watch this video from community member I Saw A Bear:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D-unj5VJHa0

notes.title: Update 22 - Logistics Tools, Civic Centers, Quality of Life
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/651670ec0779816bdee1da6b8de8ced2f9820662.jpg[/img]

[i]The majority of this update is dedicated to addressing player feedback regarding logistics tools, quality of life, and addressing recent griefing issues. We've also introduced a new experimental win condition for World Conquest to mix things up! If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to leave us a review on Steam.[/i]

[h1]LOGISTICS TOOLS[/h1]
Several new features have been introduced to help users play a more effective and fun logistics game.

[b]MAP TOOLS[/b]
Players will now be able to hover over Bases, Factories, Refineries, and other objects on the map screen to get detailed information about their status. This will allow logistics players to improve their production efficiency and make informed decisions on what needs to be supplied where. For example, hovering over a Base will show the content's of it's stockpile and hovering over a Factory will show the progress of it's facilities.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/0a1f58e72337fbba3135fafb2e2567e6feb3ca16.jpg[/img]

[b]STOCKPILE LOG[/b]
The stockpile log will show all critical retrievals and submissions that happen at a stockpile. This log will allow players to monitor activity at a base. Clicking on a log entry will open up a contextual menu that can allow you to perform various actions on the player associated with each transaction, including commending and/or reporting.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/ccad5084a0147704f84872b5172b8c2c4c5af675.jpg[/img]

[b]GLOBAL OPERATIONS[/b]
Global operations that are not coupled to any single region can now be created. This will allow players from multiple regions to collaborate on global tasks like logistics. In addition, all operations are now visible from any region.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/2fd71aa74336a09f36d7916de6648233b1b971cf.jpg[/img]

[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE[/h1]
Based on player feedback, we've added numerous quality of life improvements to help address some of the pain points in the game's interface.

[b]INTERACT CONTEXT MENU[/b]
Pressing 'Shift-E' will now bring up a menu that lets players select exactly which item/structure they want to interact with when they are within the vicinity of more than one. For items, the size of the stack is shown in the menu. The days of having to pick up multiple items just to keep one are over.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/fdbb0f546bea8050fb5e262ffef0d14d3935f230.jpg[/img]

[b]STOCKPILE SORTING[/b]
Items that are actually stocked in a stockpile are now displayed at the top of the grid. This should reduce the average amount of scrolling required to retrieve items.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/1815ec97e2a58d03e684dc2a22c8da87f2359e72.jpg[/img]

[b]AMMO COUNT DISPLAY[/b]
When hovering over an item in your inventory, if the item is a weapon that consumes ammo, the quantity of remaining ammo is now shown. It's no longer necessary to equip each item just to find the one that is usable.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/5f05f20931196f5182d7b5d8da4322c34d4cac46.jpg[/img]

[b]BLEEDING STATUS ICON[/b]
A status icon is now displayed on the HUD, indicating when the player is in the bleeding state. This should help reduce the number of cases where a player did not know they were in danger of dying from wounds.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/b64aa4b97fde89725b31aec945c43af07f6b9af3.png[/img]

[h1]CIVIC CENTERS[/h1]
This update will introduce a new experimental win condition to the game. To claim a victory town, a Civic Center facility must first be built at that town's base. Furthermore, each region now has a single "Capital City" victory town instead of multiple ones. This will hopefully reduce the linear grind required at the end of a war and will help concentrate the final conflict.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/2874ea1f5f1ffff30358ecdc355e70be91629488.jpg[/img]

[h1]ADDITIONAL HIGHLIGHTS[/h1]
In addition to the highlight features above, we've made many other improvements and tweaks:
[list]
[*] All chat channel can now be muted
[*] Motorboats are now available to build in any region with shores
[*] New tools for the moderators
[*] Additional server optimization
[/list]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full release notes for the details: http://www.foxholegame.com/blog-1/0-22-release-notes

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

[i]The next World Conquest begins at Thursday, Feb 21st at 11AM EST[/i]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AjvPzcGfiUE

notes.title: Update 21 is LIVE! Motorboats, Island Warfare, and More!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/6e5e40354de494d0945b2496d4e193d6f88af966.jpg[/img]

[h1]MOTORBOAT[/h1]
The Motorboat provides a versatile, fast form of infantry transport across water. This lightweight vessel allows players to easily hop between islands and cross rivers without needing a Shipyard. Built at any shore on the island regions, the Motorboat is incredibly flexible, capable of driving through destroyed bridges and underneath built ones.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/b4d76f80cc4bc4f264b72dd043ea58dcc75409b0.jpg[/img]

[h1]ISLAND WARFARE[/h1]
The theatre of war over water has gotten a major revamp. We've redesigned all 3 island regions, connected them to the mainland, and added new mechanics to make the islands strategically vital to the war.

[b]WATER SUPPLY LINES[/b]
Players can now freely travel between all island regions and the mainland. This means that vehicles and supplies can be ferried from the islands to the mainland and there will be more opportunities for cross region amphibious invasions. With the inclusion of the new Salvage Mines on the islands (see below), it's even more important to secure a supply line over water.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/861439d4215b03154a8d92422c4173c99c9927d6.jpg[/img]

[b]REDESIGNED ISLAND REGIONS[/b]
The island regions have been redesigned to encourage more amphibious assaults within and between regions. We've tightened the distance between shores on Oarbreaker Isles and Fisherman's Row and added major port towns that can be used as offshore logistics bases.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/2e87de092a276a4c5253f9ddeef59bd85127a5d1.jpg[/img]

[h1]SALVAGE MINES[/h1]
These are special variants of Scrap Mines that gather Upgrade Parts instead of Scrap. With a new source of Upgrade Parts available, there is an opportunity to build more Facilities in the early part of the war without sacrificing progress on the Tech Tree. However, since Salvage Mines are currently only located on the Island Regions, a supply line must be setup over water in order to take advantage of this.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/cd45c5f0ed961214e9bae82571aa14ef24c18c23.jpg[/img]

[h1]ADDITIONAL HIGHLIGHTS[/h1]
In addition to the highlight features above, we've made many other improvements and tweaks:
[list]
[*] Text chat window can be minimized
[*] Garrisoned Church structure has been completely redesigned
[*] Status icon is now shown on the HUD indicating when your character is hidden in foliage
[*] Server optimizations
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/c8cffcb57ee62f7efa46b0245a8edeb5bbde5906.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Foxhole s persistent battlefields get a major overhaul today
notes.content:
Strategic MMO shooter Foxhole is an interesting beast. Clapfoot’s isometric shooter MMO is equal parts Running With Rifles and World War 2 Online, with hundreds of players (over a thousand at peak) sharing a persistent battlefield over the course of weeks. It’s been in early access for a while, but today’s update – Foundation Of War – is the biggest change yet for it. On top of a visual overhaul making it far nicer to look at, the game now features building interiors, more complex urban combat, huge tanks that need up to five players to fully crew and a bunch more. The game is also 40% off – see the update trailer below.

(more…)

notes.title: Update 20 - Foundation of War is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/dd8c89925264f5a6d0631e46d51adf5ce41c2776.jpg[/img]

The biggest update in Foxhole history is live! The entire game has been revamped with a Visual Overhaul, World Redesign, Urban Warfare, and full fledged end game content like Battle Tanks and Ballistic Rocket super weapons.

Welcome to the new Foxhole...

https://youtu.be/FKWCmW6h1I8

[h1]URBAN WARFARE[/h1]
Fully realized town environments that have been built from the ground up, taking urban combat to a new level. Players can now enter the interior of buildings to take cover or climb on top of ruined houses to gain a high ground advantage, resulting in prolonged street battles. Abandoned buildings can be garrisoned and built into mortar emplacements or outposts, providing even more tactical options for town sieges.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/86306bdb5771f40b0c26e7f3005270dbe8888bc5.jpg[/img]

[b]MORTAR EMPLACEMENT HOUSE[/b]
A fixed Mortar built on top of a house that can be used to directly target and fire at attackers during a siege.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/1bfc5508c96cec85995560af63bf95b4875c1063.jpg[/img]

[b]SAFE HOUSE[/b]
 Special Garrisoned Houses in towns that act as support bases in the case of a siege.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/661989287a26a850a927941ef1538475e461a2cb.jpg[/img]

[h1]BATTLE TANKS[/h1]
The heaviest armored vehicle to date, the Battle Tank requires a crew of 5 to operate and a strong supply line to deploy effectively. This devastating machine of war introduces the unique role of the tank engineer, that is tasked with repairing and ammunition management.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/4ebddd64c6766f04f2bb56d82c629c4b1c01964c.jpg[/img]

[b]LANCE-36[/b]
[i]Tested and iterated and meticulously designed in the heart of the Velian capital of Damokratos, the Lance is the absolute workhorse of the storied Colonial armour division. Each bolt inspected with utter perfection. Every gear carefully calibrated, greased and maintained. Additional plates of armour were added after identifying several distinct vulnerabilities. Its Weight, speed, and ballistics are designed and produced with rigorous efficiency. Despite fleeting Warden efforts to plagerise the design, there isn’t another vehicle so capable as the Lance; There isn’t another army like the Colonial Legion. Both are destined for glory. [/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/b9667ac30f2e2daa7be9bde125d86ed906b018ff.jpg[/img]

[b]FLOOD MK-1[/b]
[i]When Cormac Flood designed this, the Warden’s newest armour, they knew it needed to compete with what was, at the time, a far more versatile Colonial assault division. During the burnout of the Great Wars, Flood tore apart an abandoned Colonial Lance. With new knowledge gained, he applied his skill as craftsman and engineer to design a vehicle that was more efficacious and could out-maneuver or out-gun anything the Colonials could throw at it. [/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/f19ced3f29401206150f7d737764ed88bb62488e.jpg[/img]

[b]AMMUNITION FACTORY[/b]
New unique factories have been added to the world that are capable of producing specialized shells for tanks. Factions that capture and hold these strategic objectives in the world will be able to add high explosive, armor piercing, and shrapnel tank shells to their arsenal.

[h1]BALLISTIC ROCKET SUPER WEAPON[/h1]
Reactivate ancient Ballistic Rocket Sites in the world. These end game super weapons demand the highest level of team effort to achieve, requiring logistics, recon, and combat roles to all work together. Rockets are capable of leveling entire towns, permanently changing the landscape of war.

For more information on how the Rockets Function, see this fantastic walkthrough video from community member [i]I Saw A Bear[/i]:
https://youtu.be/hrMJ6WKcmW8

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/3670229dcb5592be0c563fbaeefa501853f9ebb3.jpg[/img]

[h1]VISUAL OVERHAUL[/h1]
Every square kilometer of the world has been recreated with higher fidelity assets, improved lighting, and densely populated environments, creating a richer battlefield.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/c14142c1c56c40ed10f22cb5cea6d37d88d8621f.jpg[/img]

[h1]ADDITIONAL HIGHLIGHTS[/h1]
In addition to the highlight features above, we've made numerous other changes in this sweeping update.
[list]
[*] Tier 2 Sandbag Walls for fortifying urban environments
[*] New Dynamic Camera system that zooms for a strategic view
[*] Radio Backpack now automatically generates map intelligence
[*] New Garrisoned Building features like mountable windows
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/1a9e68cb0ae5bac2a81d6b885bce18b56a941e4c.jpg[/img]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]

There other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full release notes for the details: http://www.foxholegame.com/blog-1/0-20-release-notes

Don't forget to follow the Foxhole [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAaVV_lemfZWZ3VJFI42clQ]Youtube Channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/foxholegame]Twitter Feed[/url] for the latest news on upcoming updates.

In future updates, Refined Fuel will be used to power new advanced vehicles and structures.

notes.title: Update 0.18 : Dead Harvest (Zombie Mode)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/9d3e3ee393d1ef6b7d674c46cf6c7f3e4a8b3969.png[/img]

[i]Our goal is to continue to deliver regular content and feature updates on a monthly basis. If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to write us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks for continuing to support the development of Foxhole.[/i]


[h1]DEAD HARVEST EVENT[/h1]

Prepare for our first Halloween exclusive game mode, The Undead Harvest! Play as the undead or survive against them! Watch the video below to get all the details on this limited time event.

https://youtu.be/kO9_5JBILVo
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/9b236dba22275bc105a57cf92397d34c4b601a50.jpg[/img]

[b]The event goes live on Thursday at 11AM EDT and will last for a week. The devs will be joining the Dead Harvest when it starts so this will also be your chance to play with the team![/b]

After the event goes live, it will be accessible from the Travel Map screen.

[img=https://s3.amazonaws.com/clapfoot-image-host/gifs/deadharvest_anim.gif]


[h1]SNIPER RIFLE[/h1]

A long anticipated weapon has arrived! The Sniper Rifle is a scoped, bolt action firearm that has extreme range, high accuracy, and one shot kill damage. While this may seem overpowered, it also has some trade offs. It's heavier than most other small arms, has a slow rate of fire, and takes a very long time achieve a steady aim.

Initially, the Sniper Rifle will only be available in Skirmish and the Dead Harvest event. Based on your feedback, we may consider adding this to World Conquest in the future.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/5418da341479d9a44acfba560e9bea2bb0a564a7.jpg[/img]


[h1]COLLABORATIVE LOGISTICS[/h1]

We're adding some new tools to help logistics players work together and manage their supply chains more effectively. First, Factory orders can now have three permissions:
[list]
[*][b]Private[/b] - You can pick up this order
[*][b]Squad Only[/b] - Squad members can pick up this order 
[*][b]Faction Wide[/b] - Faction members can pick up this order
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/5608fde76b2fd76419e8b4cc0b04d2be02b2144e.jpg[/img]

The Factory screen has tabs that show production queues for all three categories. This allows collaborating players to see each other's orders and schedule their orders accordingly. The number of available inventory slots for Factories has also been increased, allowing for more crates to be left behind for others to use.

Finally, the same permission system also applies to Resource Mines, which will allow Scrap and Sulfur Mines to be operated communally as previously requested by players.


[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]

There are a bunch of other improvements, changes, and bug fixes in this update. Read the full release notes for the details: http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2018/10/24/018-Release-Notes

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/35ad955d135eea6b802432024c1ed23d72910537.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Major Update 0.17 : Industry of War is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/2a8c2195eef8929d431d7e85cde0f6072382214d.jpg[/img]

[i]Our goal is to continue to deliver regular content and feature updates on a monthly basis. If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to write us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks for continuing to support the development of Foxhole.[/i]

[i]Due to the complexity of Foxhole, whenever we make big updates to the game like this there is always the risk that we break something or introduce new problems. Please let us know on [url=http://discord.gg/foxholegame]Discord[/url] or [url=https://reddit.com/r/foxholegame]Reddit[/url] if you encounter any issues. We’re always open to feedback and conversation :)[/i]


[h1]Facilities[/h1]

Facilities can now be constructed at certain world structures to extend their functionality. For example, [i]Garrison Facilities[/i] can be added to Forward Operating Bases to allow non decaying structures to be built nearby. When Facilities are built, new visuals are added to the structure to indicate the new functionality. This currently only happens on the redesigned structures like the Refinery and Factory, but it's a feature that will eventually come to all structures. In the future we hope to add new facility types to enable even more customization to structures.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/b355edffa4cd2694a4deee692d86598a7ba90cb1.jpg[/img]


[h1]Industry & Economy Improvements[/h1]

We've made many changes to the economy that we hope will enable more choice, progression, and dynamic situations for players. Instead of having logistics predefined by the level designer, players are now free to choose where their logistics centers are and when they will be there. Every single town in the game now has an industrial wing that can be built up for production, refinement, and storage. This allows players to define their own supply lines and to make strategic decisions on whether to risk having their logistics power closer to the front or to slowly build up safely behind friendly lines. We've also redesigned the logistics structure assets as part of our ongoing visual refresh.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/7ea3fc5534c65d8081b652e0583b832277fa6fb7.jpg[/img]

To support this new economy, new resources have been introduced. Tech Parts now refine into Research Parts, which are used to advance the Tech Tree, and Upgrade Parts, which are used to build Facilities.


[h1]Redesigned User Interface[/h1]

For the first time since the start of the project, we’ve done a complete redesign of the user interface. Our goal was to preserve the utilitarian and immersive nature of the existing UI, while adding in flexibility for future expandability and improving the overall cohesiveness and visual polish. In short, we wanted to make it easier for us to add new gameplay and quality of life features in the future (the old UI architecture often made it difficult to make any changes) and also to add a new coat of paint to the visuals. We’ve been very cautious, but let us know if any workflows have been broken and we can fix them in future updates.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/df16242d0b43925858b91fec095f749d4583efa0.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Improvement Highlights[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Item Categories[/b] - Tabs to organize item categories on Production and Stockpile screens.
[*][b]Faster Item Retrieval[/b] - The stockpile screen no longer closes when retrieving items.
[*][b]Factory Screen[/b] - One screen displays all production information so all orders and queues can be managed in one place. Items can now be individually removed from an order before submission without the need to cancel the entire order first.
[*][b]Structure Build Screen[/b] - Build menu is now located on the bottom of the screen, leaving more space on screen for placement planning.
[*][b]HUD[/b] - HUD elements have been pushed to the corners of the screen, removing the clutter from the player's view of the world.
[/list]


[h1]Storage Facility[/h1]

This is a new logistics structure that acts as a staging area for produced items at major logistics centers. It behaves like a “stockpile for crates”. Initially this will be useful at Port Bases, where produced crates can be efficiently stored until a supply line driver can come by pick them up. This essentially allows producers to be decoupled from delivery and generally allows for more logistics flexibility and planning.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/896b05c16b6fdc718df7d97cd37a32ae6e96506c.jpg[/img]


[h1]Friends List[/h1]

You will now be able to mark other players you meet on the battlefield as friends. You can do this either through the ALT-click player context menu or via the operations player list. Friends are always displayed on the HUD player list so it’s easy to know when they are online and convenient to whisper to them.

We’ve seen many players share incredible war stories about meeting strangers on the battlefield and working with them to overcome incredible odds. Players will now be able to get in touch with these prior comrades in future wars.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/d8d4df86fcbc8d46e15f411d960550b6cb528652.jpg[/img]


[h1]Fisherman's Row V2[/h1]

Fisherman's Row has received a complete redesign and has been expanded to be a full conquest region. This will allow us to support more players in the Conquest during high population situations. Much like Great March and Reaching Trail, it will exist as a stand alone region but there are plans to connect it to the mainland via water travel in the future.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/8ee05b7a43060051cbc12e38ba333aec7a8d35bc.jpg[/img]

Land and sea are married in the new layout, with the inner body of water being surrounded by observation towers, so the more of the ring that either faction controls will directly affect the radio intelligence of their navy. Our hope is that this will lead to more pivotal naval engagements and exciting amphibious landings across the map’s many beaches.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/669df0536e32f3fa878b4f1330189d3017be4b8e.jpg[/img]


[h1]FCL Season 3[/h1]

Season 3 of the community run Foxhole Competition League starts this update. For this new season, a new custom map has been created that is tailor made for these events. To register a team, head to the  [url=https://discord.gg/PU7crv3]FCL Discord[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/b989ebba97bb6a7e652a9a56caa0e78b40f55673.jpg[/img]


[h1]Other Key Changes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Forward Bases now leave behind a "husk" when destroyed that can be claimed by the enemy with Facilities intact
    [*]Structure decay can be prevented by building a Garrison Facility at a nearby Base and stockpiling it with Garrison Supplies
    [*]Garrison Timer has been removed and replaced with a requirement to build Garrison Facilities
    [*]Bases now have a large fixed AI radius and Tunnel Networks are removed
    [*]Local voice chat is now muted on the death screen
    [*]Foliage visibility rules have changed to make it clearer when a player is hidden
    [*]Port Base layouts have been redesigned for more efficient logistics
    [*]Vehicles moving at slow speed can no longer be blocked by enemies
[/list]

[h1]Key Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Character jittering making it nearly impossible to hit players
[*] Players no longer spawn in unplayable areas during Home Region or Skirmish lobby rollovers
[*] Local voice chat is now muted on the death screen
[*] Water travel issues resulting in Amphibious vehicles getting onto land
[/list]


[h1]Release Notes[/h1]
There's a ton of other changes, game balance, and bug fixes! Refer to the release notes for all the details: http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2018/09/26/017-Release-Notes

Due to the big changes in this update, we've also provided an [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2018/09/26/Update-017-FAQ]FAQ[/url] to help clarify why certain changes have been made.

[b]The next World Conquest starts on Thursday, Sep 27th at 11AM EDT.[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.16 is live! Resource Mines, Operations Voice Chat, Combat Revamp
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/3be804c879098d451940114386fe2363b3dd88e6.jpg[/img]

[i]Our goal is to continue to deliver regular content and feature updates on a monthly basis. If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to write us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks for continuing to support the development of Foxhole.[/i]


[h1]Resource Mines[/h1]

Mines are a new world structure that provide a brand new way to gather resources. For a nominal amount of Fuel, Mines will gather raw resources automatically over time. Players can kick off an order of raw resources from Mines along a supply route on the way out and then pick them up on their way back. This won't replace Hammer gathering, but will allow logi players to increase their overall efficiency when multitasking.

Since this is a brand new mechanic, we hope to hear your feedback on how it works in the live environment and are open to making improvements to it in the future.

[img]https://s3.amazonaws.com/clapfoot-image-host/gifs/mines_anim.gif[/img]


[h1]Operations Voice Chat[/h1]

Player [b]Operations[/b] is a brand new tool to help players organize and communicate. Operations are essentially a group of players that work towards an objective. Players in an Operation can also see each other in a persistent player list on the HUD and also share dedicated communication channels.

Speaking of communication, we've completely revamped in-game voice chat. Operations enable players to form a group voice chat in-game. In conjunction with this, we've also ripped out our old voice engine and have replaced it with [b]Vivox[/b], the industry standard technology for voice chat.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/cdb7dcfe93e741975791f40b33f498230159e77d.jpg[/img]

In the future, we hope to add even more features to Operations, such as dedicated roles. Give us your feedback on what you want to see added in future updates!


[h1]New Combat Mechanics[/h1]

We've completely overhauled the combat mechanics in Foxhole. There's several key areas of improvements:
[list]
    [*][b]Stability System[/b] - Player movement and shot recoil both significantly reduce the aim of a player, makes running and gunning tactics much less viable
    [*][b]Damage Falloff Indicator[/b] - Aim line now fades out at the location where your weapon damage falls off, clarifying how far you can effectively shoot
    [*][b]Aim Height Indicator[/b] - An additional orange line is now drawn to show exactly how far away from the ground the aim is, clarifying the target location
    [*][b]Firing Range[/b] - The firing range (target dummies) on the Home Islands now provide additional stability and range statistics
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/3051d1d523579b158a3f9af3fcccffba4e307caf.jpg[/img]

In addition, we've reworked the stats every single small arms weapon to take the new Stability system in to account. We will be continuing to tune these weapons in future updates.

For a full breakdown on the new combat mechanics, read our latest [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2018/08/21/Devblog-48]Devblog[/url].


[h1]World Updates[/h1]

There's been several big updates to the World in this update. First, the entire east coast of the Conquest mainline has been updated to support amphibious landings. Deadlands has been opened up to water travel as well which means you can now travel all the way from Farranac Coast to Endless Shore (through Deadlands) on a Barge for example.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/cf72460bd6bfec9317d1ebe2a317b06f547ddc36.jpg[/img]

Two regions in the world have been completely overhauled. Umbral Wildwood has been redesigned to include a shore so that amphibious landings can be made. Reaching Trail has also been completely revamped from the ground up and now offers a more balanced experience.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/1b4f75bbf15e72945d6b386a660f7dbd77ec83e2.jpg[/img]

Every Conquest region has also been refreshed in some way, providing additional improvements. More natural barriers have been added to region borders to prevent free access to partisans. Certain towns have been pushed further from the region border.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/3649dc8d861a6a6353f54090e93bd17f201b3555.jpg[/img]


[h1]Other Key Changes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Bug that causes ammo to not refill after a reload animation has been fixed
    [*]Tunnel Networks no longer decay
    [*]Camera now dynamically moves ahead for the driver of a vehicle, making it easier to avoid obstacles in front
[/list]


[h1]Release Notes[/h1]
There's a lot of other changes, features, and bug fixes packed into this update! Refer to the release notes for all the details: http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2018/08/16/016-Release-Notes

[b]The next World Conquest starts at 2PM EDT on Tuesday, Aug 28th at 11AM EDT.[/b]

[i]Update: After rolling out the 0.16 update to the live environment, we found a server bug that will affect the operation of World Conquest. As a result, there is a high chance that the start time for Conquest will be delayed to later tomorrow. We will keep everyone updated on [url=http://discord.gg/foxhole]Discord[/url]. Skirmish mode will continue to operate without issues. Thanks for the patience.[/i]

[i]Update 2: World Conquest start time has been delayed to Wed at 11AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Update 0.15 is live! Quality of Life, Emotes, and Footsteps

We've made several important quality of life improvements. First, map icons can be toggled on and off based on type. notes.title: Update 0.14 is live! HUGE Amphibious Warfare Revamp
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/55657d40aebe8dbf3dcc6ab2eb6ccc9fa2f0415e.jpg[/img]

[i]Our goal is to continue to deliver regular content and features updates every 3-4 weeks. If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to write us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks for continuing to support the development of Foxhole.[/i]

[h1]Amphibious Warfare 2.0[/h1]

This update brings amphibious warfare to a new level. The Cargo Ship has been added, existing amphibious vehicles have been redesigned, an island based map has been added, and water based game mechanics have been overhauled to make amphibious invasions a big part of the persistent war.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/0a4e589126fff43c56a3222491776b9e1cd583b2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Amphibious Vehicles[/h1]

The Cargo Ship is a brand new water vehicle that is used to support shore landings. They can deploy into a forward base on beachheads, providing a stockpile and spawn point for the invading party.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/a1ec5f8b98eaf78be09c10b9da2a43ae7c9e9938.jpg[/img]

Gunboats have been revamped to better support amphibious assaults. The gunners are now enclosed within the vehicle, protecting them from flanking maneuvers during an invasion and the dual MG turret's range has been extended.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/a9b4c417b4fb8ab973fb3f9e4fce18a5110b8db4.jpg[/img]

Gunboat visuals have also been completely redesigned. The Warden variant has also finally been added to the game. Warden players rejoice!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/01f76fffa8c97da41b1b51e2fc05d63300d3bd44.jpg[/img]

[h1]Oarbreaker Isles[/h1]

To accompany this amphibious revamp, the first "islands" map has been added. Oarbreaker Isles contains one large island to the west, where a continuous land battle can occur between the Port Bases. The rest of the map is a series of small to large fragments of land that contain Forts, victory towns, and other world structure. The east end connects to the mainland via water border travel, so amphibious invasions on Farranac Coast can be staged from this region in World Conquest.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/2e867a469ebbe6d9265a4b05dbc13f6d5c1bf0d6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Strategic Structures[/h1]

New strategic structures have been added to the world, which creates new objectives for players in both World Conquest and Skirmish modes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/6b735bd27f29b61b60e732bbbff9d739f380aaf3.jpg[/img]

Forts are strategic bases that are located in remote areas of the world. You can consider them to be "Mini Town Halls". They will serve as strategic points for staging invasions into new regions in World Conquest.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/fc14b2cd4375f0d6966b140a0a48f2d7091d57ff.jpg[/img]

Observation Towers are giant lookout structures used to gather map intel over large areas. They have triple the detection radius of conventional Watchtowers and have tier 3 level armor.

[h1]Expanded World[/h1]

Both World Conquest and Skirmish have been scaled up for larger more expansive wars. In World Conquest, three extra regions can optionally be included in the conquest, one of them being an exclusive water zone. As a result, cross region amphibious incursions and water supply lines are now key parts of the war effort.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/50fb5fc85d58b022af1bc5aa3a03732110959b0b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Release Notes[/h1]
There's a lot of other changes, features, and bug fixes packed into this update! Refer to the release notes for all the details: http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2018/06/14/014-Release-Notes

[b]The next World Conquest starts at 2PM EDT on Tuesday, June 19th at 11AM EDT.[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.13 is Live! AT Rifle, North-South Conquest, and Game Balance
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/6e0ec3d3d9b270c41ae3c2ad611b730e316f0b8e.jpg[/img]

[i]Our goal is to continue to deliver regular content and features updates every 3-4 weeks. If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to write us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks for continuing to support the development of Foxhole.[/i]

[h1]AT Rifle[/h1]

The AT Rifle is effective at suppressing armored vehicle attacks. It's the first weapon in Foxhole that deals armor piercing damage, which means double damage against armoured vehicles like Light Tanks and Half-Tracks. The AT Rifle takes 13.5mm Ammo (new) and has a clip size of 8. It has a long range, equivalent to a normal Rifle and incurs heavy encumbrance.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/d41b4ff3dd691dab2a9e44ea1f988c6918c6ffbe.jpg[/img]

[h1]Improved Foliage Visuals[/h1]

The art team has been slowly chipping away at improving the environments in Foxhole. They started with the revamp of rocks (which is still being integrated into the game) and now they're taking a look at foliage. Many trees and bushes in the world have been replaced with higher fidelity versions that are more realistic and immersive. We've also added a decay effect that allows the player to still see their character when traversing through dense forests.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/9df7553c0278dca80c1c5331aceffc594ae4dc4a.jpg[/img]

[h1]North South Conquest[/h1]

The World Conquest mainland has been revamped to support the North-South orientation. This means that Wardens start in the North and Colonials start in the Southern regions. There are two big map changes to highlight. The Upper Heartlands got a major expansion and will be renamed to Heartlands. Second, Weathered Expanse has been extended to include a coastline. Some of these changes are being made to support additional gameplay features coming to Conquest in the future.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/5745710c5d28a9babda8f52fb396a7f234ee8f44.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/ae37eb130ae7c4dfa0ad53aac8b31b2089cdc9c8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Big game balance pass
    [*]Improved spawn point rules (incl. cross region spawn points)
    [*]Lots of Bug Fixes
[/list]

[h1]Release Notes[/h1]
For the full details on this update, please refer to the release notes: http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2018/05/18/013-Release-Notes

[b]The next World Conquest starts at 2PM EDT today and will run throughout this weekend.[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.12 is live! Armoured Car Urban Combat Vehicle
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/474d453f37e8eef41f6e51f9495e84e0b1a4a243.jpg[/img]

The latest Foxhole update includes a brand new vehicle, a new skirmish map, new features, and a boat load of bug fixes. Our goal is to continue to deliver regular content and features updates every 3-4 weeks. If you are enjoying these updates, please take the time to write us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505460/Foxhole/]review[/url]. Thanks for continuing to support the development of Foxhole.

[h1]Armoured Car[/h1]

The Armoured Car is highly effective against infantry in urban combat scenarios. Its frontal turret position allows for peeking around corners of buildings and has 360 degree firing capability. This allows it to defend against soldiers approaching from hidden areas within densely packed towns. In addition to urban combat, it can provide escort support for logistics vehicles like Trucks and CVs and is useful for patrolling supply lines.

The Armoured Car is available early in the Tech Tree and in Skirmish.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/89e2a2bc27d75e9c87d714af8007401ed46a2c11.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/237e81d7e7690b042884d419988cb0f069795848.png[/img]

[h1]Great March - Skirmish Map[/h1]

Deep into The Heartlands, The Great March is a central highway that runs between the southern regions of Veli up towards Sunhaven. This tense skirmish map revolves around two small roadside settlements featuring open field combat. Measured coordination and infiltration tactics will be required when approaching the central towns.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/c3a403cde323945a52cbfd6c2d2163759fd2964e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Improved Team Balance features
    [*]Monument Park showing the permanent results of every historical war
    [*]Over 40 bug fixes
[/list]

[h1]Release Notes[/h1]
For the full details on this update, please refer to the release notes: http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2018/04/25/012-Release-Notes

notes.title: Update 0.11 is Live! Trench Warfare Skirmish Map, Supply Drops, and More!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/4731a9de561ec6c867d1407f7d52c2dfa9eb4e66.jpg[/img]

[h1]Reaching Trail[/h1]

The Reaching Trail is a brand new skirmish map that features trench warfare and a unique asymmetric layout. [i]A few miles north of Mooring County lies The Reaching Trail, a rural village that built up around a mountainous path between Callum's Cape and the Reaching River. Colonial Paratroopers cut off Warden soldiers fleeing to the north and set up camp, establishing their own northern base of operations.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/d28e90da6ec973cb3cd8dcfdcc9bf91d2c11bc6c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Supply Drops[/h1]

Supply Drops integrate the results of Skirmish with Conquest, enabling all players to working towards the same ultimate objective. When a Skirmish is won, a supply of weapons and equipment is determined based on the Win Condition and the number of friendly players present at the end. The supply is then transferred to and accumulated at a Shipping Facility structure on the Home Island. Before the Conquest starts, the Shipping Facility will grow to a large arsenal that will be shipped to the three friendly Port Bases when the mainland invasion begins. After that, shipments will be made on a regular interval. Supply Drops are just the first step into integrating all game modes into the same unified war. Stay tuned for more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/b4b5a6cc9155707167141ecf084a192ec53544d6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Players can play Skirmishes now while waiting in a queue to join Conquest
[*]Queues have been tweaked to reduce wait times
[*]Skirmish battles now have their own mini Tech Tree, adding a sense of progression to each battle
[*]Skirmish battles now have more varied win conditions
[/list]

[h1]Full Release Notes[/h1]
For the full details on this update, please refer to the release notes: [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2018/04/04/011-Release-Notes][/url]

notes.title: World Conquest Update is Live! Join the Persistent War Now
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/41a4b0c4bc74ba003fb56461cc4c45acc67c8d46.jpg[/img]

This is a massive update that overhauls the main game modes for Foxhole and provides a new foundation that the future of the game will be built on. Our work is far from over, but the first pieces of the new and improved Foxhole are in place.

[h1]World Conquest[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/245b8889c40392fa84336d0aeb92f5043517d1d0.jpg[/img]

World Conquest mode is one of the new ways to play Foxhole. It enables a large scale war that takes place on an interconnected world. Instead of wars taking place on a single region at a time, it will be happening on 9 simultaneously and involves hundreds of concurrent players! From logistics officers operating in behind friendly lines to soldiers fighting on the front, the feeling of being just one soldier in a massive war is more realized now than ever. Be part of Foxhole history and join the first official World Conquest now.

[h1]One World Experience[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/7f0cc65d00f9654b2a70160f348d631b0c66555e.jpg[/img]

Instead of joining individual battles through a server browser, players will now instantly enter the game world and join Skirmishes or World Conquest through a Hub World known as the Home Island. Both game modes contribute to the ultimate combined win condition, which rewards the winning faction with a special War Monument that displays top player standings.

[h1]Mooring County[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/dfea5e0f42b6a0840a757c72c8f82db086454d9d.jpg[/img]

This update introduces the 9th region of the World Conquest mainland, Mooring County. Inspired by the Battle of the Bulge and Northern European woodlands, this region features winding trenches, dense woods, and wide clearings.

[h1]Faction Specific Trucks[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/3eeba8c85632e997daf13298b8bbf0f13c21f36b.jpg[/img]

Colonials and Wardens now have their own unique designs for Trucks! We hope to continue to add more faction specific vehicles in the future.

[h1]Release Notes[/h1]

That's just the tip of the iceberg. Check out the full release notes to see what else is new in this update: [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2018/03/14/010-Release-Notes]0.10 RELEASE NOTES[/url]

notes.title: World Conquest Event #2 is Live! Foxhole 30% OFF
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/17d8670eb23b61a553f4d9bd62979e107501e66d.jpg[/img]

[h1]0.9.26 HOTFIX RELEASED![/h1]

This hotfix contains bug fixes and game balance changes for World Conquest. To find out what's changed, read the [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2018/02/15/Foxhole-09-Release-Notes]release notes[/url].

[h1]WORLD CONQUEST TEST EVENT #2[/h1]

[h1]WORLD CONQUEST TEST EVENT[/h1]

The World Conquest shard will have a limited capacity and players will be allowed to join on a first come first serve basis. We will be monitoring the event closely but please be aware that it may end at anytime if any unexpected issues occur. We will be iterating rapidly on World Conquest in the coming weeks so expect more Test Events in the near future. This test is just the [b]first step of many[/b] in our ongoing One World revamp.

notes.title: Communications Update LIVE! Jeeps, Radio Backpacks, Map Intel, New Map, and More!!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/7a0fe387eba2a528a12c3b511f06d1445868c33f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Light Utility Vehicle aka "Jeep"[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/78f1bb9ae7df75b0df3f5a65073390ba0dad7662.jpg[/img]

The L.U.V. is a multipurpose vehicle with great off-road performance. It carries 4 passengers, has 6 inventory slots, and automatically scouts the area around it making it useful for fast transport, light logistics, and reconnaissance. Each faction will have it's own version of the Light Utility Vehicle.

[h1]Radio Backpack[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/a6f4677b73d1aecc7188a8bb53bb056258e1d66b.jpg[/img]

Radio Backpacks are perfect for players want to take on the role of a dedicated scout. Once equipped, players will be able to use Binoculars to scout enemy vehicles, structures, and infantry, revealing them on the map for everyone (see Map Intel below).

[h1]Map Intel[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/8891918bab88a4503d71e324bf02404f35b8677a.jpg[/img]

Map Intelligence is a new feature that completely revamps the way that reconnaissance works in Foxhole. Any structure, vehicle, or infantry that is spotted in the world by a Watch Tower, Light Utility Vehicle, or Scout (Radio Backpack carrier) is now marked  on a shared map. Targets are represented on the map with special symbols and will fade depending on how long ago they were spotted. Map Intelligence is time sensitive, so players may be operating on outdated information depending on when they last updated their map.

[h1]Tempest Island[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/6512657ed89e78f38153c4eec111809cbcd13a0d.jpg[/img]

This is a brand new Skirmish map, that works well with our latest improvements to Skirmish mode. It is designed to be a much faster paced map with tighter battles. It takes place on an island with a large urban area at it's center. Prepare for epic town battles!

[h1]Release Notes[/h1]

This update is packed with lots of other new features that changes that can be found in the full [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/12/14/Foxhole-08-Release-Notes]RELEASE NOTES[/url].

If you rather watch a video than read release notes, community member [i]I Saw A Bear[/i] walk's through all the changes in this excellent video: [url=https://youtu.be/d2vG8tqhl68]UPDATE VIDEO[/url].

notes.title: Communications Update Preview & One World Revamp
notes.content:
The end of the year is coming soon and we have two important announcements to share!

[h1]Communications Update - Coming December 14[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/3917a38641d487626d799ca20d65415003452260.jpg[/img]

A HUGE update is coming next Thursday. It will contain a new vehicle for both factions (Light Utility Vehicle aka "Jeep"), Radio Backpacks, Map Intelligence, and even more features not yet revealed!

You can read more about these features on our latest [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/12/07/Devblog-34]DEVBLOG[/url]


[h1]One World Revamp - Coming Early 2018[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/58181395e87956844596376d09dde181ab506de1.png[/img]

To read more about the [i]revamp[/i], check out this [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/12/05/One-World-Revamp]BLOG POST[/url]

There is now a special map called the [i]Lobby World[/i] that serves as a base camp for each faction. It can be used for learning how to play, training, or just hanging out. In addition, when wars end (Campaign or Skirmish) players now transfer to the Lobby World instead of rolling directly into the next map. notes.title: Update 0.6 Released! Gunboats, New Map, and More!
notes.content:
[h1]Gunboat[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/455f2fab9b7d817f7562918d63d4f14e7b6c76f9.jpg[/img]

Ever since we introduced the Amphibious Update, players have been asking for ways to make shore landings more viable. One of the top suggestions has been to add a way to bombard a shore before a landing takes place. The Gunboat is our answer to this problem!

The Gunboat has a forward medium range artillery that is effective at taking out stationary targets. At the stern, there is a dual barrel machine gun that is used to fend off raiding parties.

[h1]Westgate[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/41226fe702456613d50dd0d35885cb0129c64ffc.jpg[/img][IMG]http://i68.tinypic.com/xldnhv.jpg[/IMG]

Westgate is a brand new map that features a large vertical coast, a long wall dividing the north and south areas, and a small neutral island to the west. Our goal with this map was to provide multiple strategic options for each side at the start of each game. It's definitely one of the more symmetrical maps we've designed, but after Farranac Coast we were ready for some change.

[h1]Keep[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/7c1cc01e69d133fc1d8c9a9a7b0895e2306092ef.jpg[/img][IMG]http://i68.tinypic.com/2604q4x.jpg[/IMG]

Westgate will be the first map to have a unique structure that players can interact with. Near the center of the map there will be a large keep that players can claim like any other world structure. Once claimed, it will provide the same functionality as an Outpost (spawning and stockpiling), but will much more heavily armored and difficult to take down making it a perfect contention point in the region.

[h1]New Game Modifiers[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880686/53e55ccc5a333b7a69c0b7c58c5cecd7738f14c8.jpg[/img]

We added a couple of new game modifiers to War Games mode. Remember that the next war games event is this Saturday! [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/505460/discussions/0/1479857071253097094/]Event Details[/url]
[list]
[*][b]Supply Line[/b] - Defensive structures can be built anywhere, but require Garrison Supplies
[*][b]Refinery[/b] - Sulfur respawns quickly, but must be processed at a player build Refinery
[*][b]Beachhead[/b] - Barges can lower ramp at any location
[/list]

[h1]Additional Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Multiple separate Campaigns
[*]Faction specific server queues
[*]Server Browser improvements
[*]Dynamic resource yield to alleviate team imbalance
[/list]

This is a very big update with tons of other balance changes, improvements, and bug fixes. Full release notes can be read here: [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/11/02/Foxhole-06-Release-Notes]Release Notes[/url]
