notes.title: Foxhole Autumn Update Live & 25% OFF sale!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i64.tinypic.com/2u4386s.jpg[/IMG]

If you haven't gotten Foxhole yet, you can grab now for 25% off [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/505460]HERE[/url]. We've also just released the Autumn Update which contains new content, a new game mode, new features and more!

[h1]New Half-Tracks[/h1]

[IMG]http://i63.tinypic.com/hx5j6w.jpg[/IMG]

[IMG]http://i64.tinypic.com/s0xu0y.jpg[/IMG]

We've completely revamped Half-Tracks in this update. Each faction now has a custom model redesigned from the ground up. In addition, they have a physical cargo bed at the back that players can vault onto and walk on. This allows an additional passenger (besides the gunner) to ride at the rear of the vehicle and provide cover.

[h1]New Game Mode: Weekly War Games[/h1]

[IMG]http://i63.tinypic.com/t884ro.jpg[/IMG]

The Weekly War Game mode will offer players a fresh take on wars every week. One or more gameplay modifiers will be applied to these wars, which will change one or more rules in the game. Modifiers will change on a weekly basis. Here are a few examples of modifiers: 
[list]
[*]No Man's Land - Outposts and Barracks are unavailable
[*]PvP - No AI inside structures
[*]High Tech - Technology Part yield rate is accelerated
[*]Engineers - CVs can be used to build any structure
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]

We've spent a lot of time and effort on quality of life improvements in this update. Here's some highlights:

[u]Structure Visual Damage States[/u]

[IMG]http://i64.tinypic.com/6xvy4y.png[/IMG]

Structures will now change their appearance when they take enough damage. This will help players attackers identify weak points in a base and allow defenders to easily identify what needs to be repaired.

[u]Treading Water[/u]

[IMG]http://i68.tinypic.com/2v0hcua.jpg[/IMG]

Players will now be able to tread water for a few moments instead of instantly dying. Players will be able to survive being in water for quick periods of time which should reduce the strain in certain situations, such as jumping off a Landing APC prematurely or accidentally walking off the edge of a shore.

[u]Character Context Menu[/u]

[IMG]http://i63.tinypic.com/nwal9l.jpg[/IMG]

The character context menu will help players access functionality like squads, whispering, muting, and more by simply clicking on a character with the ALT key held down. Players can avoid having to scroll through the F1 screen to find players, which should make working with others nearby easier.

[i][b]There are other gameplay changes, game balance, improvements, and bug fixes in this update[/b][/i]. Full release notes can be found here: [URL=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/10/12/Foxhole-05-Release-Notes]HERE[/URL].

[b]Remember that we will be continuing to update Foxhole on a regular basis. Look forward to more content and features in the coming months![/b]

notes.title: Amphibious Warfare Update is HERE! Huge Content Drop
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i65.tinypic.com/2n8a3dd.jpg[/IMG]

We've just released the biggest update in the history of Foxhole. We've added a whole new map, new vehicles, new structures, and a whole new form of warfare!

[h1]Landing APC[/h1]

[IMG]http://i66.tinypic.com/m7rhfp.jpg[/IMG]

The Landing APC is an amphibious warfare vehicle designed to transport infantry across both land and sea. This is an all terrain carrier that can carry soldiers and has a moderate amount of storage space. Capable of resisting small arms and explosives, this vehicle is effective at ferrying troops into combat zones at the front line.

[h1]Barge[/h1]

[IMG]http://i64.tinypic.com/2mmsdnb.jpg[/IMG]

The Barge is a lightly armored, slow moving ship that can ferry heavy cargo like vehicles, equipment, or infantry across rivers and canals. Unlike the Landing APC, the Barge must dock at a Shipyard to load/unlock cargo. Due to it's lack of armor and defenses, it should only be brought through shipping lanes that have been fully secured.

[h1]Tank Traps[/h1]

[IMG]http://i63.tinypic.com/2r6l3pi.jpg[/IMG]

An anti-tank obstacle that prevents vehicle access to an area. Gameplay wise, Tank Traps will will act much like "Barbed Wire for vehicles". They will be extremely difficult to take out with conventional weapons and will only be removable quickly with a wrench.

[h1]Farranac Coast (NEW MAP)[/h1]

[IMG]http://i67.tinypic.com/xnroyo.jpg[/IMG]

Farranac Coast is a brand new coastal map with islands, rivers, and beach landings. This is the largest map in Foxhole yet. To the east of the region we have a large coastal area with farmlands and towns. To the west we have a large offshore island with abandoned villages and flooded marshes. The two sides are separated by a river and several large bays that can only be crossed with Landing APCs and Barges.

[i][b]There are many other gameplay changes, improvements, and bug fixes in this update[/b][/i]. Full release notes can be found here: [URL=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/09/15/Foxhole-04-Release-Notes]HERE[/URL].

notes.title: Foxhole 0.3 Update Released! Anti-Tank Mines, Slow Wounds Ability, and More!
notes.content:
[u][b]Anti-Tank Mines[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i65.tinypic.com/33uv89c.jpg[/IMG]

Anti-Tank Mines will detonate when heavy vehicles like Half-Tracks and Light Tanks drive over them. They will be fully visible by infantry on foot. More than ever, it will be important for heavy vehicles to be escorted by foot soldiers. Mines can be dismantled using a wrench.

[u][b]Slow Wounds[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i67.tinypic.com/avreip.gif[/IMG]

[i]Slow Wounds[/i] is a new ability that will allow players to aid critically wounded friendlies and keep them alive for a couple of more moments in battle, hopefully long enough for a medic to arrive. The ability is stackable, meaning that mulitple players can apply pressure to the wounds of a downed player, keeping that player alive for even longer. Hold the left mouse button when facing a critically wounded player to apply the Slow Wounds effect.

[i][b]There are other gameplay changes, improvements, and bug fixes in this update[/b][/i]. Full release notes can be found here: [URL=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/08/30/Foxhole-03-Release-Notes]HERE[/URL].

notes.title: Foxhole 0.2 Update! Bayonets, Large 140 Player Servers, and More!
notes.content:
[IMG]https://s3.amazonaws.com/foxhole-updates/updates/update_bayonet.jpg[/IMG]

[u][b]Bayonets[/b][/u]

[IMG]https://s3.amazonaws.com/foxhole-updates/updates/update_bayonet.gif[/IMG]

The Bayonet is a bladed accessory that attaches to the muzzle of a Rifle or Carbine and is used to perform a long range melee attack. It is relatively cheap to produce and is useful when ammo is scarce or in close quarters. It instantly kills player, unlike the default melee attack where damage scales with the attackers health.

[u][b]140 Player Servers[/b][/u]

[IMG]https://s3.amazonaws.com/foxhole-updates/updates/update_140players.jpg[/IMG]

For a very long time now, players have been asking for increased player capacity. We're finally taking some small step towards larger servers, with 140 player support. We will be rolling this out on Campaign and other select servers. We're excited to see what kind of battles these expanded servers will bring.

notes.title: In Foxhole s war the truck drivers are the real heroes
notes.content:
For the third day in a row, our outpost was under attack. Some enterprising yanks had discovered they could take opportunistic raiding parties through an undefended snowy field and get within grenade-throwing distance of our forward operating base a walled-in barracks full of tiny toy soldiers all sitting around grunting that they didn t have enough rifles, ammo, or best friends to clutch to their breasts as they died in the snow. Someone lowered the iron gate for me and I drove the truck into the compound, during a mercifully quiet and shrapnel-free moment.

Who wants b-mats! I shouted, employing the shorthand for basic materials I d learned from wiser, fightier men. Get your b-mats here!

Everyone in the compound rushed to the truck.

Oh YES, said an engineer, as he unloaded the essentials he needed to build up defences and do his own job. Buddy, you are the real MVP.
(more…)

notes.title: Podcast: The Electronic Wireless Show talks Inside, Foxhole and TV show adaptations
notes.content:
What sound drips forth from the audio tubes? It’s just the latest RPS podcast, the Electronic Wireless Show. Our topic this week is: “which TV show deserves a good videogame adaptation?” Maybe you feel Gordon Ramsay’s Kitchen Whatever could make a good survival game? Or perhaps The Handmaid’s Tale could be a great FPS? Probably not. Graham is convinced that road trip anime Kino’s Journey is a contender, while I’m yearning for a good The Wire or Wolf Hall game full of intrigue and politicking.

Meanwhile, Graham caught up with the sad boy brigade and played Limbo follow-up Inside, while I’ve been hunkering down in the top-down persistent multiplayer war of Foxhole. It’s just us two this week because Adam is gone and Pip has been possessed by a flu demon that makes her voice sound like it’s trapped in hell.
(more…)

notes.title: MMO sandbox war Foxhole marches on early access
notes.content: Foxhole [official site], a massively multiplayer sandbox war where players act like units in an RTS, has invaded Steam Early Access. A war has raged for yonks, see, and now hundreds of players play every part from building bases and running supplies to, you know, fighting. After a stretch in open pre-alpha (which I downloaded but didn’t play because Plunkbat happened), Foxhole has now officially launched into paid early access. A bit like PlanetSide 2, World War 2 Online, and other persistent wars, it’s all one big throwdown across many fronts with grand schemes and grander failures. I hear good things from chums who are more resistant to Plunkbat’s siren call. (more…)

notes.title: Foxhole 0.0.33 Update Released! Rifle Grenade Launcher and Fisherman's Row
notes.content:
Foxhole 0.0.33 Update Released! Rifle Grenade Launcher and Fisherman's Row Skirmish Map!

[IMG]http://i67.tinypic.com/2b9uux.jpg[/IMG]

[u][b]Rifle Grenade Launcher[/b][/u]

The Rifle Grenade Launcher is inspired by the M1 Grenade Projection Adapter, which was able to load and launch regular hand grenades. In Foxhole, the Rifle Grenade Launcher will be an accessory that can be equipped to Rifles. Once equipped, the Rifle can be switched to fire Grenades by toggling it's Fire Mode via a key press. Grenades thrown with this accessory can reach distances further than those thrown by hand. Initially, the Rifle Grenade Launcher will be compatible with Frag Grenades, but were exploring the idea of allowing it to be used with other grenade types like Smoke and Green Ash.

[u][b]Fisherman's Row[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i63.tinypic.com/25q63rc.png[/IMG]

We are introducing the first ever 60 player "skirmish" style map to Foxhole. This map will be designed for faster paced gameplay that will be appropriate for new players and veterans that are interested in training exercises or smaller skirmishes. Fisherman's Row is an island off the West coast of the old Warden Empire and features beaches, farm lands, and hilly areas.

[i][b]There are other gameplay changes, improvements, and bug fixes in this update[/b][/i]. I highly suggest reading the full release notes [URL=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/07/07/Foxhole-0033-Release-Notes]HERE[/URL].

notes.title: Foxhole 0.0.32 Update Released! Construction Vehicle, Gun Nest, and Campaign Metagame
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i67.tinypic.com/bhb0o2.jpg[/IMG]

[u][b]Construction Vehicle[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i65.tinypic.com/15ogx6o.jpg[/IMG]

The Construction Vehicle is now required to build large structures in the game like Town Halls, Outposts, Weapon Factories, and more. It requires two players to operate, one driver and one operator. It builds 40% faster than Hammers. The Construction Vehicle is slow moving, easy to disable, but hard to destroy. While it is currently limited to building a few specific structures, we hope to expand it's capabilities in the future.

[u][b]Gun Nest[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i65.tinypic.com/rtlq0x.jpg[/IMG]

The Gun Nest isn't technically a new structure, but is an upgrade of the Foxhole. One of our goals with Gun Nests is to allow players to further fortify an area in the mid to late game without having to add clutter/Foxhole spam to their already crowded bases. We also wanted to extend the structure upgrade system beyond just walls. The Gun Nest will not only have a faster rate of gun fire than the Foxhole, but it will also lob Frag Grenades at enemies.

[i][b]There a ton of other gameplay changes and improvements in this update[/b][/i]. I highly suggest reading the full release notes [URL=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/06/23/Foxhole-0032-Release-Notes]HERE[/URL].

notes.title: Foxhole 0.0.31 HUGE UPDATE! New Character Models, Sunken Pillbox, Tunnel Network, Sulfur Resource
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i66.tinypic.com/4fkhl.jpg[/IMG]

[u][b]Sunken Pillbox[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i64.tinypic.com/ht9uma.jpg[/IMG]

The Sunken Pillbox is a new defensive structure that will help with defending towns against long ranged weapons. Inspired by the Retractable Turrets used in the Maginot Line, this fortification will retract into the ground when there aren't any targets in sight. When enemies are inside it's forward facing firing arc, it will slowly rise and open fire. In it's retracted state, the Sunken Pillbox will be near invulnerable.

The Sunken Pillbox was designed to help players secure their towns against long ranged weapons used by small groups of raiders or during low population situations. However, it's slow startup time makes it essential to complement it with other defensive structures.

[u][b]Tunnel Network[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i65.tinypic.com/2d9ofn7.jpg[/IMG]

Inspired heavily by the vast underground structures built for the Maginot Line in World War 2, players will need to build out networks of tunnels to supply their passive defense structures like Pillboxes and Foxholes. Players will build Tunnel Network structures in the form of concrete hatches, which will automatically connect to nearby structures. Networks must be connected to Town Halls or Outposts to work. Only connected passive defenses will have an active AI. This new mechanic will decrease the significance of early game rushes and will enable more organic front lines to form.

[u][b]Sulfur Resource[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i67.tinypic.com/2823y4k.jpg[/IMG]

This is a new resource that is used to produce the more powerful explosive weapons in the game. Sulfur is a depletable, rare resource available in contested areas away from towns. Players will initially gather Sulfur in relatively secure areas, but once those nearby nodes are depleted they will have to venture out to the front line or beyond for more. Sulfur is refined into Explosive Material at the Manufacturing Plant.

There are LOT of gameplay changes in this update. I highly suggest reading the full release notes [URL=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/06/09/Foxhole-0031-Release-Notes]HERE[/URL].

[IMG]http://i66.tinypic.com/4fkhl.jpg[/IMG]

[u][b]Sunken Pillbox[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i64.tinypic.com/ht9uma.jpg[/IMG]

The Sunken Pillbox is a new defensive structure that will help with defending towns against long ranged weapons. Inspired by the Retractable Turrets used in the Maginot Line, this fortification will retract into the ground when there aren't any targets in sight. When enemies are inside it's forward facing firing arc, it will slowly rise and open fire. In it's retracted state, the Sunken Pillbox will be near invulnerable.

The Sunken Pillbox was designed to help players secure their towns against long ranged weapons used by small groups of raiders or during low population situations. However, it's slow startup time makes it essential to complement it with other defensive structures.

[u][b]Tunnel Network[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i65.tinypic.com/2d9ofn7.jpg[/IMG]

Inspired heavily by the vast underground structures built for the Maginot Line in World War 2, players will need to build out networks of tunnels to supply their passive defense structures like Pillboxes and Foxholes. Players will build Tunnel Network structures in the form of concrete hatches, which will automatically connect to nearby structures. Networks must be connected to Town Halls or Outposts to work. Only connected passive defenses will have an active AI. This new mechanic will decrease the significance of early game rushes and will enable more organic front lines to form.

[u][b]Sulfur Resource[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i67.tinypic.com/2823y4k.jpg[/IMG]

This is a new resource that is used to produce the more powerful explosive weapons in the game. Sulfur is a depletable, rare resource available in contested areas away from towns. Players will initially gather Sulfur in relatively secure areas, but once those nearby nodes are depleted they will have to venture out to the front line or beyond for more. Sulfur is refined into Explosive Material at the Manufacturing Plant.

There are LOT of gameplay changes in this update. I highly suggest reading the full release notes [URL=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/06/09/Foxhole-0031-Release-Notes]HERE[/URL].

notes.content:

[u][b]Bunker[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i65.tinypic.com/2e6au8g.jpg[/IMG]

The Bunker will be a new structure that will allow base builders create more complete defense perimeters that will be harder to penetrate without a long range weapons crew like a Mortar or Field Artillery team. The Bunker will be the most heavily armored passive defense structure in the game yet, and will have a 180 degree firing arc. This will make it near impossible for players to take out a Bunker or neighboring walls with Satchel Charges, unless someone else is drawing it's fire. Players will be able to enter the structure through a back door and fire at enemies below.

[IMG]http://i63.tinypic.com/24vuuyd.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: WORLD CONQUEST TRIAL #1 IS LIVE!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i63.tinypic.com/jpamxj.jpg[/IMG]

We just launched an update (0.0.28.12) last night, which supports the first version of World Conquest mode. World Conquest is a feature we've been working on for awhile that allows hundreds of players to fight in the same persistent war that spans multiple regions. Players will be able to travel in between regions from in-game and the war won't be won until a win condition is met across multiple regions simultaneously. Join now to be a part of the biggest Foxhole event yet.

[u][b]Trial #1[/b][/u]

This event will be the first test for World Conquest mode. We will be running additional tests in the coming weeks.

[u]Event Details[/u]
[list]
[*]World Conquest war will take place across 4 regions: Deadlands, Upper Heartlands, Endless Shore, and Umbral Wildwood
[*]Win Condition will be to claim all towns in 3 of the 4 regions
[*]When a region has all towns claimed by one faction, the opposing faction will only be able to enter the region through travel (and not from the World Conquest screen)
[*]Region travel will be enabled
[*]Upper Heartlands will initially be claimed by Colonials and Endless Shore will be initially claimed by Wardens. The image below illustrates the starting conditions of this war.
[/list]

[u]Known Issues (Important)[/u]
[list]
[*]If you travel to a neighboring region and your faction is full, you will be put back to your previous region but at a random travel point
[*]If you travel to a neighboring region that is completely claimed by the enemy and die, you will spawn at a random travel point
[*]There are two region travel points in the Upper Heartlands that lead to slightly offset destination points in neighboring regions
[*]Player counts for each faction are not being reported on the World Conquest screen
[/list]

[IMG]http://i63.tinypic.com/vinxhi.jpg[/IMG]

[i]The Trial event will be running on a highly experimental version for World Conquest mode. There are many missing features, bugs, and gameplay issues with the mode at present. We intend to sort out these issues in the coming weeks. We ask for your patience and understanding in the event of problems. Thank you for your continued support.[/i]

Read the following post for further details about the event: [URL=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/05/05/World-Conquest-Trial-1]DETAILS[/URL]

notes.title: Foxhole 0.0.28 Update! Sticky Bomb, Destructible World Structures, and Prelude War Event!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i67.tinypic.com/5aq1ph.jpg[/IMG]

[u][b]Sticky Bomb[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i63.tinypic.com/a7ddj.jpg[/IMG]

This is a high yield, anti-armor explosive with a short fuse. It is covered with a strong adhesive that allows it to be attached to moving vehicles and other surfaces.

[u][b]Destructible World Structures[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i66.tinypic.com/15duk9k.jpg[/IMG]

All world structures are now destructible. This will open up new strategies like scorched-earth tactics or targeting enemy production towns. We have also redesigned the models for the Workshop, Supply Station, and Manufacturing Plant structures.

[u][b]Firing Ranges[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i67.tinypic.com/2jg8eo7.jpg[/IMG]

Firing Ranges are now located in several regions of the world. Players will be able to use these to test out weapons and get feedback on damage statistics. This will enable players to better understand how each weapon works and in the long run, improve game balance.

[u][b]PRELUDE WAR EVENT[/b][/u]

On Saturday, April 29th at 11:00 AM EDT, a special war will be taking place with a special win condition. This war will take place on the Deadlands and Upper Heartlands. The war will be won when the enemy overruns both regions simultaneously. A region is overrun by claiming a certain number of towns (6  for Upper Heartlands / 8 for Deadlands). This event will be used to test the back end functionality for World Conquest mode, which will be coming next week if things go well. Look forward to more news on World Conquest mode in the coming days!

There are also a bunch of other changes in this update. Full release notes can be read [URL=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/04/28/Foxhole-0028-Release-Notes]HERE[/URL]. If you'd rather not read release notes, community member [i]I Saw A Bear[/i] walks through the latest update in this excellent [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PXO4x6xpbZA]video[/url].

Grab the latest update [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/505460]HERE[/url]

notes.title: Foxhole 0.0.27 Update! Carbine, Callouts, and More!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i68.tinypic.com/55kp5g.jpg[/IMG]

[u][b]Carbine[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i67.tinypic.com/2lsy695.jpg[/IMG]

A new weapon has arrived! The Carbine is a lightweight semi-automatic weapon that will provide greater mobility and a faster rate of fire than the Rifle. It will fire 7.62mm rounds, that will come in special cartridges of 15.

[u][b]Callouts[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i63.tinypic.com/28svn8p.jpg[/IMG]

Callouts will allow players to quickly send predetermined messages to other players. Think of this as a shortcut for common text messages. Instead of typing "Retreat" or "Enemies sighted at J5" into text chat, you will be able to click on an overlay that appears over the HUD. There will be two types of Callouts, local and global. Local callouts are performed from the HUD view and Global ones are performed from the map screen. Some Callouts will allow you to specify a location as well. This is a feature that we will be improving upon over time.

This update contains lots of other game balance changes and bug fixes. Full release notes can be read [URL=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/04/13/Foxhole-0027-Release-Notes]HERE[/URL].

notes.title: Foxhole 0.0.26 Update! HUGE UPDATE! Howitzer, Garrisoned House, Factory System, and More!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i66.tinypic.com/316aeqq.jpg[/IMG]

[u][b]Howitzer[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i67.tinypic.com/5lcjnc.jpg[/IMG]

The Howitzer will be a buildable, static artillery emplacement that is used primarily for suppressive fire again enemy infantry. Players will be able to take direct control over this structure and use it to support infantry advances with "moving barrages" or to defend against a siege.

[u][b]Garrisoned House[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i68.tinypic.com/19bh54.jpg[/IMG]

We will be adding special houses in towns that can be Garrisoned. Once garrisoned, these structures essentially convert into multi-directional passive defenses that are naturally built into the town environment and don't take up additional space. These will make it a lot more dangerous for enemy attackers to maneuver within a town. In addition, we are designing these special town structures so that they have second floors, allowing players to occupy these buildings and gain a high ground advantage when defending against invaders. 

[u][b]Upper Heartlands Revamp[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i65.tinypic.com/2e4yyza.jpg[/IMG]

We have completed redesigned Upper Heartlands both in terms of layout and visuals. Many town locations have been moved and roads have changed as well. The environment now features a lusher landscape, with plenty of hedgerows, pastures, and sunken lanes.

[u][b]"Factory" Production System[/b][/u]

All production structures now use what we have been calling the "Factory" system. This allows players to place private orders and produce items in mass quantities. We have also made a bunch of other changes to support this, such as allowing players to dock their trucks at Town Halls and Outposts for direct access to their Stockpiles.

This update is packed with tons of other gameplay changes. Full release notes can be read [URL=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/03/31/Foxhole-0026-Release-Notes]HERE[/URL].

notes.title: Foxhole 0.0.25 Update! Patrol Motorcycle, Stockpiles, and More!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i66.tinypic.com/2s620wx.jpg[/IMG]

[u][b]Patrol Motorcycle[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i63.tinypic.com/2q0lqwy.jpg[/IMG]

The Patrol Motorcycle is the latest vehicle in Foxhole! This will be used primarily for reconnaissance and will be the fastest form of transport in the game. The Motorcycle will support a driver (on the Motorcycle) and one passenger (in the sidecar). The sidecar rider will also be able to equip and use items like the Pistol, Revolver, and Binoculars. The Motorcycle can be boosted (with Shift/Sprint key) to go even faster at the expense of additional Fuel consumption.

[u][b]Stockpiles[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i68.tinypic.com/2mqu88i.jpg[/IMG]

Items can now be stockpiled at the Town Hall in near unlimited quantities. Once submitted to a stockpile, and item takes time to retrieve. This allows for better control over item distribution at Town Halls.

There's a lot of other changes and features in this update. Full release notes can be read [URL=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/03/17/Foxhole-0025-Release-Notes]HERE[/URL].

notes.content:

[u][b]Umbral Wildwood[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i64.tinypic.com/2j3o8hv.jpg[/IMG]

The spawn system has been recreated from the ground up. When spawning in the wild, locations are chosen dynamically and enemy players/vehicles/structure will be avoided.

The next map for Foxhole is here! This new region is directly East of Upper Heartlands and is called Umbral Wildwood. This area's is filled with heavy forests and shallow rivers. Players will fight through dense foliage and trek through creeks.

[u][b]Barbed Wire[/b][/u]

[IMG]http://i68.tinypic.com/t9i0qe.jpg[/IMG]

These barricades significantly slow down the movement speed of enemy infantry. They are extremely resistant to all types of weapon damage including explosives. A wrench must be used to dismantle Barbed Wire.

[u][b]Dynamic Spawn System[/b][/u]

The spawn system has been recreated from the ground up. When spawning in the wild, locations are chosen dynamically and enemy players/vehicles/structure will be avoided.

[u][B]WEEKLY WAR SCHEDULE[/B][/u]

The Weekly War will commence on Sat, Mar 4th at 11:00 AM ET and will be active on servers [i]Able-3[/i].

Full release notes can be found [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/03/03/Foxhole-0024-Release-Notes]here[/url]

notes.title: Foxhole 0.0.20 Update! Town Hall, New Win Condition, and More!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i63.tinypic.com/16kno7r.png[/IMG]

We've made some big changes to the way wars are won in Foxhole in this update. Every town in the game will now have a Town Hall at it's center. This will be a rebuildable world structure, much like the bridges in the Deadlands. To claim a town, players will have to enter it and rebuild it's Town Hall. Your faction can capture a town from the enemy by destroying it's Town Hall, and rebuilding it again. The faction that holds all towns wins the war.

In addition to this, we've also added some additional features like advanced graphics settings and language chat channels. We've also fixed a bunch of bugs as well! Full release notes can be found [URL=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2017/01/13/Foxhole-0020-Release-Notes]here[/URL]

Remember to join us for weekly war tomorrow at 1PM ET!

Grab the latest update [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/505460]HERE[/url]

notes.content:

This is a brand new map that represents the region north of the Deadlands. It is a snowy area that is filled with rocky, mountainous terrain and tight corridors.

notes.title: Foxhole 0.0.17 HUGE UPDATE! New Map, Barracks, Coalitions, and Spatial Voice!
notes.content:
[img]http://i64.tinypic.com/b8o2ft.jpg[/img]

This is one of our biggest updates yet!

We've added an entirely new world zone to the game called the Upper Heartlands. The War will take place in this new area this week. We're also introducing Coalitions to the game, which allows players to form a temporary alliance during a war. Coalition members can share secured access to certain structures and also have a private text chat channel. We hope to add more features to the Coalition system in the future! The Barracks structure is a new buildable structure that allows for more effective forward operations. Finally, we've added spatial voice chat that allows you to speak nearby players. For detailed release notes, go [URL=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2016/12/02/Foxhole-0017-Release-Notes]HERE[/URL].

[img]http://i67.tinypic.com/2quk9dz.jpg[/img]

With this update, you can now create a fully enclosed perimeter for your base using the Heavy Gate structure. We've also made some changes that we think will make material production more dynamic than before. We're excited to see how this will change the outcome of the next War.

Don't miss the next weekly war, which starts on Saturday at 1PM EST.

Grab the latest update [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/505460]HERE[/url]

notes.title: Foxhole 0.0.9 Released! MAP EXPANSION & 120 PLAYERS!

Don't miss the next weekly war, which starts on Saturday at 1PM EST.

notes.content:

The first ever community planned war is happening this Saturday morning (Starts at 10AM CET). All Foxhole players are called upon to join in and lead their faction to victory! notes.title: New Foxhole Update Released: Open World Gameplay
notes.content:
[img=http://i65.tinypic.com/2h3x743.jpg][/img]

This release has HUGE changes that transition the prototype from a combat focused arena to more of the open world game experience that Foxhole will eventually become. New features include manufacturing, production, passive defenses, campsites, and more!

Grab the update [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/505460]HERE[/url].

Detailed release notes can be found [url=http://www.foxholegame.com/single-post/2016/08/12/Prototype-0010-Released]here[/url].
